Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

1. Savitakkasavicāraṃ [T 2.0001][M 2.0001][V 2.0001] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho[V 2.0002], dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

1. A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought through the root condition: one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko. (2)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought to arise through the root condition—the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition applied thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition applied thought. (2)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied thought and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition kamma-produced material form. (3)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ [M 2.0002] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro [T 2.0002] ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (4)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions both a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates and kamma-produced material form…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates and kamma-produced material form. (4)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (5)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought and a state devoid of applied thought and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition applied thought and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition applied thought and kamma-produced material form. (5)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. (6)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions both a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought to arise through the root condition—one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates and applied thought…pe… two aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition two aggregates and applied thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates and applied thought…pe… two aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition two aggregates and applied thought. (6)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0003] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (7)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought, a state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought, and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates, applied thought, and mind-produced material form…pe… two aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition two aggregates, applied thought, and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought conditions three aggregates, applied thought, and kamma-produced material form…pe… two aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought condition two aggregates, applied thought, and kamma-produced material form. (7)

2. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [T 2.0003] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

2. A state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought to arise through the root condition—one aggregate devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions three aggregates…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions three aggregates…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

A state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—applied thought conditions aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, applied thought conditions aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ[M 2.0003]; vitakkaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on aggregates devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought, sustained thought and mind-produced material form; dependent on applied thought, mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought, sustained thought and kamma-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, kamma-produced material form. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (4)

A state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions states accompanied by applied and sustained thought and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on applied thought, aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought and kamma-produced material form. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ [T 2.0004] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro [V 2.0004] ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (5)

A state devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought conditions states devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought, three aggregates, sustained thought and mind-produced material form...pe...dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, sustained thought and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied thought but accompanied by sustained thought, three aggregates, sustained thought and kamma-produced material form...pe...dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, sustained thought and kamma-produced material form. (5)

3. Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; vicāraṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, vicāraṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca vicāro. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

3. A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied and sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-produced matter...pe... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced matter; dependent on sustained thought, mind-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied and sustained thought, three aggregates and kamma-produced matter...pe... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, kamma-produced matter; dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on sustained thought, the base; dependent on the base, sustained thought. Dependent on one great element, three great elements...pe... dependent on the great elements, mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko. (3)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: dependent on sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with only sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, applied thought. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [M 2.0004] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca [T 2.0005] savitakkasavicārā khandhā; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter. (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe [V 2.0005] vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca. (5)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: dependent on sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought and mind-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought and kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with only sustained thought; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, applied thought; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought. (5)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca. (6)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought. (6)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (7)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter. (7)

4. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

4. A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates...pe... dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 2.0006] savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the base, applied thought. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, mind-produced matter. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced matter. (3)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ [M 2.0005] ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates...pe... dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates; dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced matter. (4)

Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0006] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (5)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the base, applied thought; dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced matter. (5)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. (6)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of root condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates and applied thought...pe... dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates and applied thought. (6)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 2.0007] hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (7)

A state accompanied by applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions states accompanied by applied and sustained thought, states with only sustained thought, and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates and applied thought; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought and the base, two aggregates and applied thought; dependent on aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-resultant material form. (7)

5. Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (1)

5. A state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state accompanied by applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the base, aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (2)

A state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and sustained thought, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and sustained thought, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and the base, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and the base, two aggregates. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo [V 2.0007] uppajjati hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe [M 2.0006] avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte [T 2.0008] khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vicāro. (3)

A state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, mind-originated materiality; dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and the great elements, mind-originated materiality; dependent on applied thought and the great elements, mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, kamma-born materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-born materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-born materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and the base, sustained thought. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā; vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

A state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought; dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-born materiality. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca. (5)

A state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and sustained thought, three aggregates and kamma-born materiality; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought, two aggregates and kamma-born materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and the base, three aggregates and sustained thought; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with only sustained thought and the base, two aggregates and sustained thought. (5)

6. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ [T 2.0009] khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

6. A state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, two aggregates. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, kamma-born materiality. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0008] avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca [M 2.0007] vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (3)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates and kamma-born materiality; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, two aggregates and kamma-born materiality. (3)

7. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

7. A state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise through the root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the physical base, three aggregates; ...etc... dependent on two aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the physical base, two aggregates. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 2.0010] rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition—dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, kamma-born materiality arises. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition states with applied and sustained thought and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the physical base, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, applied thought, and the physical base, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, applied thought, and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, kamma-born materiality arises. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

8. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

8. A state with applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ [V 2.0009] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (2)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state with applied and sustained thought conditions states with applied and sustained thought and states with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, three aggregates and applied thought arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and applied thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (3)

9. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [M 2.0008] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati [T 2.0011] ārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

9. A state with only sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with only sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on applied thought, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state with only sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on the aggregates with only sustained thought, sustained thought arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state with only sustained thought conditions states with only sustained thought and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought, three aggregates and sustained thought arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (4)

10. Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, vatthuṃ paṭicca vicāro. (1)

10. A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied and sustained thought, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate devoid of applied and sustained thought, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates arise; dependent on the physical base, sustained thought arises. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [V 2.0010] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā[T 2.0012]. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko. (3)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—dependent on sustained thought, the aggregates with only sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on sustained thought, the aggregates with only sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with only sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, applied thought arises. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā vicāro ca. (4)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions states with only sustained thought and states devoid of applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought arise. (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [M 2.0009] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca. (5)

A state devoid of applied and sustained thought conditions states with applied and sustained thought and states with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. (5)

11. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

11. A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with applied and sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought and a state devoid of applied and sustained thought condition a state with only sustained thought to arise by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, applied thought arises. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, phenomena with initial and sustained application and phenomena without initial application but with sustained application only arise by way of object condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application and the physical base, three aggregates and initial application arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates and initial application arise. (3)

12. Avitakkavicāramattañca [T 2.0013][V 2.0011] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (1)

12. Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, a phenomenon with initial and sustained application arises by way of object condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on initial application and the physical base, aggregates with initial and sustained application arise. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate without initial application but with sustained application only and sustained application, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and sustained application, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without initial application but with sustained application only and sustained application, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and sustained application, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without initial application but with sustained application only and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vicāro. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application arises by way of object condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates without initial application but with sustained application only and the physical base, sustained application arises. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ [M 2.0010] ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca. (4)

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, phenomena without initial application but with sustained application only and phenomena without initial and without sustained application arise by way of object condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate without initial application but with sustained application only and the physical base, three aggregates and sustained application arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates and sustained application arise. (4)

13. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ [T 2.0014] khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

13. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application and a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only, a phenomenon with initial and sustained application arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application and initial application, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and initial application, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ [V 2.0012] khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only, and a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application, a phenomenon with initial and sustained application arises by way of object condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application, initial application, and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, initial application, and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

(Dve paccayā sajjhāyamaggena vibhattā, evaṃ avasesā vīsatipaccayā vibhajitabbā.)

(Two conditions have been analyzed by the method of recitation. In this way, the remaining twenty conditions should be analyzed.)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

14. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

14. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, a phenomenon with initial and sustained application arises by way of dissociation condition: dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application, three aggregates arise…pe…; dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application, three aggregates arise…pe…; dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko; vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only arises by way of dissociation condition: initial application arises dependent on the aggregates with initial and sustained application; a phenomenon without initial application but with sustained application only arises dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, a phenomenon without initial and without sustained application arises by way of dissociation condition: mind-originated matter arises dependent on the aggregates with initial and sustained application by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā[T 2.0015]. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, phenomena with initial and sustained application and phenomena without initial and without sustained application arise by way of dissociation condition: dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise…pe…; the aggregates arise dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. Mind-originated matter arises dependent on the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (4)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ [M 2.0011] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca [V 2.0013] rūpaṃ. Vitakko vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, phenomena without initial application but with sustained application only and phenomena without initial and without sustained application arise by way of dissociation condition: initial application and mind-originated matter arise dependent on the aggregates with initial and sustained application. Initial application arises dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. Mind-originated matter arises dependent on the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (5)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (6)

Dependent on a phenomenon with initial and sustained application, phenomena with initial and sustained application and phenomena without initial application but with sustained application only arise by way of dissociation condition: dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained application, three aggregates and initial application arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and initial application arise; and these aggregates and initial application arise dependent on the physical base by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (6)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Khandhā ca vitakko ca vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (7)

Dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought, states with initial and sustained thought, states with only sustained thought, and states without initial and sustained thought arise by way of the dissociation condition—dependent on one aggregate with initial and sustained thought, three aggregates, initial thought, and mind-produced material form arise… and so forth… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates, initial thought, and mind-produced material form arise. The physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates and initial thought. The aggregates are a dissociation condition for mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (7)

15. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati…pe… avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

15. Conditioned by a state with only sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought arises… and so forth… Conditioned by one aggregate with only sustained thought, three aggregates arise… and so forth… two aggregates… and so forth… The physical basis is a dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā[T 2.0016]. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Conditioned by a state with only sustained thought, a state with initial and sustained thought arises by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by initial thought, the aggregates with initial and sustained thought arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for them. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vicāro vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vitakkaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vitakkaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Conditioned by a state with only sustained thought, a state without initial and sustained thought arises by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by the aggregates with only sustained thought, sustained thought and mind-produced material form arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for sustained thought. The aggregates are a dissociation condition for mind-produced material form. Conditioned by initial thought, mind-produced material form arises; initial thought is a dissociation condition for it. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ vitakkaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

Conditioned by a state with only sustained thought, states with initial and sustained thought and states without initial and sustained thought arise by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by initial thought, the aggregates with initial and sustained thought and mind-produced material form arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates. Initial thought is a dissociation condition for mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [M 2.0012][V 2.0014] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Khandhā ca vicāro ca vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

Conditioned by a state with only sustained thought, states with only sustained thought and states without initial and sustained thought arise by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by one aggregate with only sustained thought, three aggregates, sustained thought, and mind-produced material form arise… and so forth… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates, sustained thought, and mind-produced material form arise. The physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates and sustained thought. The aggregates are a dissociation condition for mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth. (5)

16. Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicāraṃ [T 2.0017] paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicāraṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, vicāraṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vatthu khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicāraṃ paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca vicāro, vicāro vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vatthu vicāraṃ vippayuttapaccayā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

16. Conditioned by a state without initial and sustained thought, a state without initial and sustained thought arises by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by one aggregate without initial and sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise… and so forth… two aggregates… and so forth… the physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates; the aggregates are a dissociation condition for mind-produced material form. Conditioned by sustained thought, mind-produced material form arises; sustained thought is a dissociation condition for it. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so forth… at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by sustained thought, kamma-produced material form arises; sustained thought is a dissociation condition for it. The physical basis arises conditioned by the aggregates; the aggregates arise conditioned by the physical basis. The physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates. The aggregates are a dissociation condition for the physical basis. The physical basis arises conditioned by sustained thought; sustained thought arises conditioned by the physical basis. The physical basis is a dissociation condition for sustained thought. Sustained thought is a dissociation condition for the physical basis. Conditioned by one great element, three great elements arise… and so forth… conditioned by the great elements, mind-produced material form, kamma-produced material form, and derived material form arise; the aggregates are a dissociation condition for this material form. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

Conditioned by a state without initial and sustained thought, a state with initial and sustained thought arises by way of the dissociation condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical basis, the aggregates with initial and sustained thought arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for them. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Conditioned by a state without initial and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought arises by way of the dissociation condition—conditioned by sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for them. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for them. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical basis, aggregates with only sustained thought arise; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for them. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical basis, initial thought arises; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for it. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā [V 2.0015] uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (4)

Conditioned by a state without initial and sustained thought, states with initial and sustained thought and states without initial and sustained thought arise by way of the dissociation condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the physical basis, the aggregates with initial and sustained thought arise; conditioned by the great elements, kamma-produced material form arises; the physical basis is a dissociation condition for the aggregates. The aggregates are a dissociation condition for kamma-produced material form. (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [T 2.0018][M 2.0013] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ vicāraṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ vicāraṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, vitakko vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (5)

Conditioned by a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena that are merely with sustained thought and phenomena without applied and sustained thought arise by way of dissociation condition—conditioned by sustained thought, aggregates that are merely with sustained thought and mind-produced materiality arise...pe... the aggregates are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Mind-produced materiality is related to sustained thought by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by sustained thought, aggregates that are merely with sustained thought and kamma-produced materiality arise; the aggregates are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to sustained thought by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the base, aggregates that are merely with sustained thought arise, and conditioned by the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises; the aggregates are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the base, applied thought arises, and conditioned by the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises; applied thought is related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the base, aggregates that are merely with sustained thought and sustained thought arise; they are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (5)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (6)

Conditioned by a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena with applied and sustained thought and phenomena that are merely with sustained thought arise by way of dissociation condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise; they are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (6)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhā ca vitakko ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (7)

Conditioned by a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena with applied and sustained thought, phenomena that are merely with sustained thought, and phenomena without applied and sustained thought arise by way of dissociation condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise, and conditioned by the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises; the aggregates and applied thought are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (7)

17. Savitakkasavicārañca [T 2.0019] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

17. Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought arises by way of dissociation condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates arise; they are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0016] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, a phenomenon that is merely with sustained thought arises by way of dissociation condition...pe... at the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the base, applied thought arises; it is related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo…pe… savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought arises by way of dissociation condition...pe... conditioned by aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, mind-produced materiality arises; it is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking...pe.... (3)

Savitakkasavicārañca [M 2.0014] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (4)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena with applied and sustained thought and phenomena without applied and sustained thought arise...pe... At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates arise...pe... conditioned by two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise. Conditioned by the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko, savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, vitakko vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (5)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena that are merely with sustained thought and phenomena without applied and sustained thought arise...pe... At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the base, applied thought arises. Conditioned by the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. Applied thought is related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (5)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0020] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (6)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena with applied and sustained thought and phenomena that are merely with sustained thought arise...pe... At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates and applied thought arise...pe... conditioned by two aggregates and the base, two aggregates and applied thought arise; they are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (6)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. Savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca [V 2.0017] paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhā ca vitakko ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (7)

Conditioned by a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, phenomena with applied and sustained thought, phenomena that are merely with sustained thought, and phenomena without applied and sustained thought arise...pe... At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the base, three aggregates and applied thought arise...pe... conditioned by two aggregates and the base, two aggregates and applied thought arise. Conditioned by the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates and applied thought are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (7)

18. Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

18. Conditioned by a phenomenon that is merely with sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied and sustained thought, a phenomenon with applied and sustained thought arises...pe... At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by applied thought and the base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise; they are related to the base by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo…pe… avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve [T 2.0021] khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only arises... Dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates, two aggregates arise... [The aggregates] are related to the base by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates, two aggregates arise... [The aggregates] are related to the base by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and the base, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates, two aggregates arise... [The aggregates] are related to the base by dissociation condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca [M 2.0015] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo…pe… avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe ca vicārañca vippayuttapaccayā. Avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Vitakkaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhe ca vicārañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Vitakkaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vicāro. Vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises... Dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, mind-originated materiality arises. The aggregates and sustained thought are related by dissociation condition. Dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. The aggregates are related by dissociation condition. Dependent on applied thought and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. Applied thought is related by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates and sustained thought are related by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates are related by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. Applied thought is related by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on the base, sustained thought arises. The base is related by dissociation condition. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ vitakkaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (4)

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only and a state without applied and sustained thought, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on applied thought and the base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. Dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to applied thought by dissociation condition. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattañca [V 2.0018] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… avitakkavicāramattaṃ [T 2.0022] ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe ca vicārañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe ca vicārañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (5)

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only and a state without applied and sustained thought arise...
