Dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Mind-originated materiality is related to the aggregates and sustained thought by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on sustained thought, three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise... The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates and sustained thought by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and the base, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates... Dependent on the aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only and on the great elements, kamma-produced materiality arises. The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only and the base, three aggregates and sustained thought arise... on two aggregates... The base is related by dissociation condition. (5)

19. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo [M 2.0016] khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

19. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only, a state with applied and sustained thought arises... Dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and on applied thought, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates... [The aggregates] are related to the base by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking... [The aggregates] are related to the base by dissociation condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only, a state without applied and sustained thought arises... Dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and on applied thought, mind-originated materiality arises. The aggregates and applied thought are related by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking... The aggregates and applied thought are related by dissociation condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0023] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti…pe… savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise... Dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and on applied thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... on two aggregates... The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Mind-originated materiality is related to the aggregates and applied thought by dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking... The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. Kamma-produced materiality is related to the aggregates and applied thought by dissociation condition. (3)

20. Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0019] avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

20. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only, and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises... At the moment of rebirth-linking: dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, on applied thought, and on the base, three aggregates arise... on two aggregates... The aggregates are related to the base by dissociation condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

A phenomenon with initial and sustained thought, a phenomenon with only sustained thought, and a phenomenon without initial and sustained thought are conditions for a phenomenon without initial and sustained thought to arise… and so on… Mind-produced materiality is conditioned by the aggregates with initial and sustained thought, by initial thought, and by the great elements. The aggregates and initial thought are dissociated conditions. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the aggregates and initial thought are dissociated conditions.

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ[T 2.0024]. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe ca vitakkañca vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

A phenomenon with initial and sustained thought, a phenomenon with only sustained thought, and a phenomenon without initial and sustained thought are conditions for phenomena with initial and sustained thought and phenomena without initial and sustained thought to arise, by way of dissociated condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates are conditioned by one aggregate with initial and sustained thought, by initial thought, and by the physical base… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… Kamma-produced materiality is conditioned by the aggregates with initial and sustained thought, by initial thought, and by the great elements. The aggregates are dissociated conditions for the physical base. The aggregates and initial thought are dissociated conditions for kamma-produced materiality.

Atthi-avigatapaccayā

The Presence and Non-Disappearance Conditions

21. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati atthipaccayā…pe… natthipaccayā, vigatapaccayā, avigatapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

21. A state with initial and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by presence condition… and so on… by absence condition, by disappearance condition, by non-disappearance condition (in brief).

Hetuyā [M 2.0017] sattatiṃsa, ārammaṇe ekavīsa, adhipatiyā tevīsa, anantare ekavīsa, samanantare [V 2.0020] ekavīsa, sahajāte sattatiṃsa, aññamaññe aṭṭhavīsa, nissaye sattatiṃsa, upanissaye ekavīsa, purejāte ekādasa, āsevane ekādasa, kamme sattatiṃsa, vipāke sattatiṃsa, āhāre indriye jhāne magge sattatiṃsa, sampayutte ekavīsa, vippayutte sattatiṃsa, atthiyā sattatiṃsa, natthiyā ekavīsa, vigate ekavīsa, avigate sattatiṃsa.

22. By root condition, thirty-seven; by object condition, twenty-one; by dominance condition, twenty-three; by contiguity condition, twenty-one; by immediate contiguity condition, twenty-one; by co-nascence condition, thirty-seven; by reciprocity condition, twenty-eight; by support condition, thirty-seven; by decisive support condition, twenty-one; by pre-nascence condition, eleven; by repetition condition, eleven; by kamma condition, thirty-seven; by result condition, thirty-seven; by nutriment, faculty, jhāna, and path conditions, thirty-seven; by association condition, twenty-one; by dissociation condition, thirty-seven; by presence condition, thirty-seven; by absence condition, twenty-one; by disappearance condition, twenty-one; by non-disappearance condition, thirty-seven.

1. The Analysis Section

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

23. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

23. A state with initial and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with initial and sustained thought, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on… dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and with restlessness, delusion associated with doubt and with restlessness arises.

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto [T 2.0025] dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with only sustained thought arises dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with initial and sustained thought, sustained thought arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state without initial and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with initial and sustained thought, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

Savitakkasavicāraṃ [M 2.0018][V 2.0021] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state with initial and sustained thought and a state without initial and sustained thought arise dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with initial and sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

A state with only sustained thought and a state without initial and sustained thought arise dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with initial and sustained thought, sustained thought and mind-originated materiality arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (6)

Dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought, a state with initial and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought arise by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with initial and sustained thought, three aggregates and sustained thought arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko [T 2.0026] ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (7)

Dependent on a state with initial and sustained thought, a state with initial and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without initial and sustained thought arise by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with initial and sustained thought, three aggregates, sustained thought, and mind-originated materiality arise… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on….

24. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā; vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ vitakkaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

24. Dependent on a state with only sustained thought, a state with initial and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on rootless sustained thought, the aggregates with initial and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, sustained thought conditions the aggregates with initial and sustained thought; dependent on sustained thought associated with doubt and with restlessness, delusion associated with doubt and with restlessness arises.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vitakkaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state with only sustained thought, a state without initial and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—rootless sustained thought conditions mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, sustained thought conditions kamma-produced materiality.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [V 2.0022] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state with only sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—dependent on rootless applied thought, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and mind-originated form arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and kamma-produced form arise. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo [M 2.0019] khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; dependent on one great element, three great elements arise…pe…dependent on the great elements, mind-originated form, kamma-produced form, and derived form arise; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…pe…dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced form and derived form arise. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 2.0027] vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko. (3)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, applied thought arises. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vitakko; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (5)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, applied thought arises; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (5)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca. (6)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. (6)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [V 2.0023] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca; mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (7)

Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (7)

25. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

25. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe…dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca [M 2.0020] avitakkaavicārañca [T 2.0028] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko. (2)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, applied thought arises. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (3)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe…dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (4)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca vitakko; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (5)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, applied thought arises; dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (5)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0024] ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. (6)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, three aggregates and applied thought arise…pe…dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates and applied thought arise. (6)

Savitakkasavicārañca [T 2.0029] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (7)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and the physical base, three aggregates and applied thought arise…pe…dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates and applied thought arise; dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (7)

26. Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (1)

26. Dependent on a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the physical base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattañca [M 2.0021] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on rootless applied thought and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā; vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied and sustained thought, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought and the physical base, the aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise; dependent on applied thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (3)

27. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe [T 2.0030] ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā; vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

27. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, two aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and applied thought, the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0025] avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates and mind-originated form arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, two aggregates and mind-originated form arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

28. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

28. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, applied thought, and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke savitakkasavicāre [M 2.0022] khandhe ca vitakkañca [T 2.0031] mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-root condition—dependent on the rootless aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on. (2)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state with only sustained thought, and a state without applied and sustained thought, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise by non-root condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, applied thought, and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, applied thought, and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (3)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

The Non-object Condition

29. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā [V 2.0026] – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

29. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-object condition—dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought, kamma-produced form arises. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vitakkaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a state with only sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-object condition—dependent on the aggregates with only sustained thought, mind-originated form arises; dependent on applied thought, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with only sustained thought, kamma-produced form arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, kamma-produced form arises. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkaavicāre khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicāraṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāre [T 2.0032] khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, vicāraṃ paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vicāraṃ paṭicca vatthu; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-object condition—dependent on the aggregates without applied and sustained thought, mind-originated form arises; dependent on sustained thought, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates without applied and sustained thought, kamma-produced form arises; dependent on sustained thought, kamma-produced form arises; dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on sustained thought, the physical base arises; dependent on one great element… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element… and so on. (1)

30. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

30. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises by non-object condition—dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and the great elements, kamma-produced form arises. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca [M 2.0023] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca…pe… kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon without initial application but with only sustained application, and a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, condition a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application not by way of object condition: the aggregates without initial application but with only sustained application and sustained application condition mind-produced materiality; the aggregates without initial application but with only sustained application and the great elements condition mind-produced materiality; initial application and the great elements condition mind-produced materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates without initial application but with only sustained application and sustained application…and so on…kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati [V 2.0027] naārammaṇapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon with initial application and sustained application, and a phenomenon without initial application but with only sustained application, condition a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application not by way of object condition: the aggregates with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, condition mind-produced materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā [T 2.0033] – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon with initial application and sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application but with only sustained application, and a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, condition a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application not by way of object condition: the aggregates with initial application and sustained application, initial application, and the great elements, condition mind-produced materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Not by way of predominance condition.

31. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā…pe… satta.

31. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition…and so on… seven.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vipākaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon with only sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on aggregates with only sustained application, predominance with only sustained application arises; dependent on one resultant aggregate with only sustained application, three aggregates [arise]…and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on initial application, aggregates with initial application and sustained application [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vipāke avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on resultant aggregates with only sustained application, sustained application and mind-produced materiality [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, phenomena with initial application and sustained application and phenomena without initial application and without sustained application arise not by way of predominance condition: dependent on initial application, aggregates with initial application and sustained application and mind-produced materiality [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, phenomena with only sustained application and phenomena without initial application and without sustained application arise not by way of predominance condition: dependent on one resultant aggregate with only sustained application, three aggregates, sustained application, and mind-produced materiality [arise]…and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (5)

32. Avitakkaavicāraṃ [M 2.0024][V 2.0028] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati [T 2.0034] naadhipatipaccayā – avitakkaavicāre khandhe paṭicca avitakkaavicārā adhipati, vipākaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

32. Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on aggregates without initial application and without sustained application, predominance without initial application and without sustained application arises; dependent on one resultant aggregate without initial application and without sustained application, three aggregates [arise]…and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates with initial application and sustained application [arise]. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vipākaṃ vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, a phenomenon with only sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on sustained application, predominance with only sustained application arises; dependent on resultant sustained application, aggregates with only sustained application [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… satta.

Dependent on a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application… seven.

33. Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca… satta (saṃkhittaṃ).

33. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application and a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application… seven (abbreviated).

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā, avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vipākaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca (saṃkhittaṃ).

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application and a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises…and so on… a phenomenon with only sustained application arises not by way of predominance condition: dependent on aggregates with only sustained application and on sustained application, predominance with only sustained application arises; dependent on one resultant aggregate with only sustained application and on sustained application, [three aggregates arise] (abbreviated).

Naanantarapaccayādi

Not by way of contiguity condition, etc.

34. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā (naārammaṇasadisaṃ).

34. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application arises not by way of contiguity condition… not by way of immediate contiguity condition… not by way of mutuality condition… not by way of decisive support condition (not similar to the object condition).

Napurejātapaccayo

Not by way of prenascence condition.

35. Savitakkasavicāraṃ [V 2.0029] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā… satta.

35. Dependent on a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises not by way of prenascence condition… seven.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati [T 2.0035] napurejātapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon with only sustained application arises not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained application…and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [M 2.0025] dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon with initial application and sustained application arises not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on initial application, aggregates with initial application and sustained application [arise]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro, avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vitakkaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained application, a phenomenon without initial application and without sustained application arises not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on aggregates with only sustained application, sustained application [arises]; dependent on aggregates with only sustained application, mind-produced materiality [arises]; dependent on initial application, mind-produced materiality [arises]. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (4)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained thought, phenomena accompanied by applied and sustained thought and phenomena without applied thought and without sustained thought arise, not by way of the pre-existence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on applied thought, aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought and kamma-originated form arise. (4)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā…pe… arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained thought, phenomena with only sustained thought and phenomena without applied thought and without sustained thought arise, not by way of the pre-existence condition… and so on… In the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought, three aggregates and sustained thought arise… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (5)

36. Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… avitakkaavicāre [V 2.0030] khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vicāraṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

36. Dependent on a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought, a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought arises, not by way of the pre-existence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, three aggregates arise… and so on… Dependent on aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought, mind-originated form arises; dependent on sustained thought, mind-originated form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought, a phenomenon accompanied by applied and sustained thought arises, not by way of the pre-existence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, aggregates accompanied by applied and sustained thought arise. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā [T 2.0036] – arūpe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (7)

Dependent on a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought, a phenomenon with only sustained thought arises, not by way of the pre-existence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on sustained thought, aggregates with only sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (abbreviated). (7)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca… satta.

Dependent on a phenomenon accompanied by applied and sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought… seven.

37. Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ). (7)

37. Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought, a phenomenon with only sustained thought arises, not by way of the pre-existence condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with only sustained thought and sustained thought, three aggregates arise… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (abbreviated). (7)

Avitakkavicāramattañca [M 2.0026] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ).

Dependent on a phenomenon with only sustained thought and a phenomenon without applied thought and without sustained thought, phenomena with only sustained thought and phenomena without applied thought and without sustained thought arise… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… (abbreviated).

(Napurejātamūlake yathā suddhikaṃ arūpaṃ, tathā arūpā kātabbā).

(In the section on the non-pre-existence root, just as the immaterial realm is pure, so should the immaterial cases be understood.)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

No post-nascence condition, etc.

38. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā…pe… naāsevanapaccayā… satta.

38. A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, not by way of the post-nascence condition… etc. …not by way of the repetition condition… seven.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… (saṃkhittaṃ). (5)

A state with only sustained thought arises dependent on a state with only sustained thought, not by way of the repetition condition—dependent on one resultant aggregate with only sustained thought… (abbreviated). (5)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [V 2.0031] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… (saṃkhittaṃ).

A state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the repetition condition—dependent on one resultant aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought… (abbreviated).

(Naāsevanamūlake avitakkavicāramattaṃ vipākena saha gacchantena napurejātasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ, avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkavicāramattagacchantena vipāko dassetabbo.)

(In the root of the no-repetition condition, a state with only sustained thought, when accompanied by the resultant, should be made similar to the no-pre-nascence condition; and the resultant should be shown when accompanied by a state with only sustained thought.)

Nakammapaccayo

No kamma condition.

39. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca savitakkasavicārā cetanā. (1)

39. A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati [T 2.0037] nakammapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā cetanā. (1)

A state with only sustained thought arises dependent on a state with only sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with only sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā cetanā. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with only sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on applied thought. (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – avitakkaavicāre khandhe paṭicca avitakkaavicārā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

A state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition without applied thought and without sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates without applied thought and without sustained thought; external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… dependent on one great element… etc. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā cetanā. (2)

A state with only sustained thought arises dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with only sustained thought arises dependent on sustained thought. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca [M 2.0027] avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā cetanā. (1)

A state with only sustained thought arises dependent on a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with only sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates with only sustained thought and sustained thought. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca [V 2.0032] avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – savitakkasavicāre khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca savitakkasavicārā cetanā. (1)

A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought, not by way of the kamma condition—volition with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought. (1)

Navipākapaccayādi

No resultant condition, etc.

40. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā…pe… naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ…pe… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… [T 2.0038] utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… namaggapaccayā… nasampayuttapaccayā….

40. A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, not by way of the resultant condition… etc. …not by way of the nutriment condition—external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… etc. …not by way of the faculty condition—external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… etc. …for non-percipient beings, the physical life faculty arises dependent on the great elements… etc. …not by way of the jhāna condition—one aggregate accompanied by the five sense-consciousnesses… etc. …external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… for non-percipient beings… etc. …not by way of the path condition… not by way of the association condition….

Navippayuttapaccayo

No dissociation condition.

41. Navippayuttapaccayā… arūpe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

41. Not by way of the dissociation condition… in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, three aggregates arise… etc. …dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe savitakkasavicāre khandhe paṭicca vitakko. (2)

A state with sustained thought only arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, applied thought arises dependent on aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (2)

Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā uppajjanti navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vitakko ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vitakko ca. (3)

States, both with applied and sustained thought and with sustained thought only, arise dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought, three aggregates and applied thought arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and applied thought arise. (3)

42. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

42. A state with sustained thought only arises dependent on a state with sustained thought only, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with sustained thought only, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vitakkaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicārā khandhā. (2)

A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with sustained thought only, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise dependent on applied thought. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ [M 2.0028][V 2.0033] dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paṭicca vicāro. (3)

A state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises dependent on a state with sustained thought only, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, sustained thought arises dependent on aggregates with sustained thought only. (3)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā uppajjanti navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ [T 2.0039] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vicāro ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vicāro ca. (4)

States, both with sustained thought only and without applied thought and without sustained thought, arise dependent on a state with sustained thought only, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with sustained thought only, three aggregates and sustained thought arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and sustained thought arise. (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

A state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate without applied thought and without sustained thought, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…pe…. (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicāraṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. (2)

A state with sustained thought only arises dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, aggregates with sustained thought only arise dependent on sustained thought. (2)

Avitakkavicāramattañca avitakkaavicārañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vicārañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vicārañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A state with sustained thought only arises dependent on a state with sustained thought only and a state without applied thought and without sustained thought, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with sustained thought only and sustained thought, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and sustained thought, two aggregates arise. (1)

Savitakkasavicārañca avitakkavicāramattañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe savitakkasavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vitakkañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vitakkañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A state with applied and sustained thought arises dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with sustained thought only, not by way of the dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and applied thought, two aggregates arise. (1)

Nonatthi-novigatapaccayā

Non-existence and Non-disappearance Conditions

43. Savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā… (saṃkhittaṃ).

43. Dependent on a state with applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and without sustained thought arises by way of the non-existence condition… by way of the non-disappearance condition… (in brief).

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Section of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Division

Suddhaṃ

Pure

44. Nahetuyā [V 2.0034] tettiṃsa, naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā sattatiṃsa[T 2.0040], naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe satta, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte sattatiṃsa, napacchājāte sattatiṃsa, naāsevane sattatiṃsa, nakamme satta, navipāke tevīsa, naāhāre ekaṃ [M 2.0029] naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge tettiṃsa, nasampayutte satta, navippayutte ekādasa, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta (saṃkhittaṃ).

44. Thirty-three are not by way of root condition, seven are not by way of object condition, thirty-seven are not by way of dominance condition, seven are not by way of proximity condition, seven are not by way of contiguity condition, seven are not by way of mutuality condition, seven are not by way of decisive support condition, thirty-seven are not by way of pre-nascence condition, thirty-seven are not by way of post-nascence condition, thirty-seven are not by way of repetition condition, seven are not by way of kamma condition, twenty-three are not by way of result condition, one is not by way of nutriment condition, one is not by way of faculty condition, one is not by way of jhāna condition, thirty-three are not by way of path condition, seven are not by way of association condition, eleven are not by way of dissociation condition, seven are not by way of non-existence condition, seven are not by way of non-disappearance condition (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike paccanīyagaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the negative enumeration is done in the wholesome triad, so should it be counted.)

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative Section

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Positive-Negative Section of Conditions

45. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta…pe… novigate satta.

45. By way of root condition, seven are not by way of object condition…pe… seven are not by way of non-disappearance condition.

(Yathā kusalattike anulomapaccanīyagaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the positive-negative enumeration is done in the wholesome triad, so should it be counted.)

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Positive Section of Conditions

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

46. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe cuddasa, anantare samanantare cuddasa, sahajāte tettiṃsa, aññamaññe bāvīsa, nissaye tettiṃsa, upanissaye cuddasa, purejāte cha, āsevane pañca, kamme tettiṃsa…pe… jhāne tettiṃsa, magge tīṇi, sampayutte cuddasa, vippayutte tettiṃsa…pe… avigate tettiṃsa (saṃkhittaṃ).

46. By way of non-root condition, fourteen in object condition; fourteen in proximity condition and contiguity condition; thirty-three in co-nascence condition; twenty-two in mutuality condition; thirty-three in dependence condition; fourteen in decisive support condition; six in pre-nascence condition; five in repetition condition; thirty-three in kamma condition…pe… thirty-three in jhāna condition; three in path condition; fourteen in association condition; thirty-three in dissociation condition…pe… thirty-three in non-disappearance condition (in brief).

(Yathā [V 2.0035] kusalattike paccanīyānulomagaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the negative-positive enumeration is done in the wholesome triad, so should it be counted.)

Paṭiccavāro.

The Section on Dependence

2. Sahajātavāro

2. The Section on Co-nascence

(Sahajātavāropi paṭiccavārasadiso kātabbo.)

(The section on co-nascence should also be done similarly to the section on dependence.)

(Avasesesu dvīsu ghaṭanesu pavatti paṭisandhi vitthāretabbā.)

(In the remaining two combinations, the course of existence and rebirth-linking should be elaborated.)

Hetupaccayo.

Root Condition.

(Hetupaccayaṃ [M 2.0032][V 2.0038] anumajjantena paccayavāro vitthāretabbo. Yathā paṭiccagaṇanā evaṃ gaṇetabbā. Adhipatiyā sattatiṃsa, purejāte ca āsevane ca ekavīsa, ayaṃ ettha viseso.)

(When analyzing the root condition, the section on conditions should be elaborated. Just as the enumeration of the conditional relations, so should it be counted. By way of predominance condition, thirty-seven; by way of pre-nascence condition and repetition condition, twenty-one—this is the distinction here.)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditional Negative

49. Paccanīye – nahetuyā tettiṃsa pañhā, sattasu ṭhānesu satta [T 2.0044] mohā uddharitabbā mūlapadesuyeva. Naārammaṇe satta cittasamuṭṭhānā uddharitabbā.

49. In the Negative: for non-root condition, thirty-three questions; in seven instances, seven cases of delusion are to be removed in the root sections themselves. For non-object condition, seven cases of mind-originated materiality are to be removed.

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-Predominance Condition

50. Savitakkasavicāramūlakā satta pañhā naadhipatiyā kātabbā.

50. Seven questions rooted in the category of 'with applied and sustained thought' are to be formulated for non-predominance.

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – avitakkavicāramatte khandhe paccayā avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vipākaṃ avitakkavicāramattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only arises by non-predominance condition. Dependent on aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only, predominance factors without applied thought but with sustained thought only arise; dependent on one resultant aggregate without applied thought but with sustained thought only, three aggregates arise... at the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā (yathā paṭiccanaye tathā pañca pañhā kātabbā).

Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only... (five questions are to be formulated as in the conditional positive method).

51. Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati…pe… avitakkaavicāre khandhe paccayā avitakkaavicārā adhipati, vipākaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… vipākaṃ vicāraṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā avitakkaavicārā adhipati, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā avitakkaavicārā khandhā ca vicāro ca…pe…. (1)

51. Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied and sustained thought arises... Dependent on aggregates without applied and sustained thought, predominance factors without applied and sustained thought arise; dependent on one resultant aggregate without applied and sustained thought, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... Dependent on resultant sustained thought, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking... dependent on the base, predominance factors without applied and sustained thought arise; dependent on the base, resultant aggregates without applied and sustained thought and sustained thought arise... (1)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro dhammo…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā savitakkasavicārā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, a state with applied and sustained thought arises... Dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (2)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [V 2.0039] dhammaṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramatto dhammo…pe… vicāraṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vatthuṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramattā adhipati, vipākaṃ vicāraṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, a state without applied thought but with sustained thought only arises... Dependent on sustained thought, predominance factors without applied thought but with sustained thought only arise; dependent on the base, predominance factors without applied thought but with sustained thought only arise; dependent on resultant sustained thought, aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only arise; dependent on the base, resultant aggregates without applied thought but with sustained thought only arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (3)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ [M 2.0033] dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0045] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā savitakkasavicārā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied and sustained thought arise... Dependent on the base, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking... (4)

Avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā…pe… vipākaṃ vicāraṃ paccayā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vitakko, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

Dependent on a state without applied and sustained thought, states without applied thought but with sustained thought only and states without applied and sustained thought arise...
