For one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the fruition-attainment with sustained application only and for sustained application by way of the contiguity condition. (4)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – avitakkaavicāraṃ cuticittaṃ vicāro [M 2.0054] ca savitakkasavicārassa upapatticittassa vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkaavicāraṃ bhavaṅgañca vicāro ca āvajjanāya vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkaavicārā khandhā vicāro ca savitakkasavicārassa vuṭṭhānassa vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ savitakkasavicārāya phalasamāpattiyā vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state without initial application and sustained application is a condition for both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state with sustained application only by way of the contiguity condition—the death consciousness without initial application and sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the rebirth consciousness with initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the contiguity condition. The life-continuum without initial application and sustained application and sustained application are conditions for adverting and for initial application by way of the contiguity condition. The aggregates without initial application and sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the emergence with initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the contiguity condition. For one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the fruition-attainment with initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the contiguity condition. (5)

82. Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattaṃ cuticittañca vicāro ca savitakkasavicārassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ bhavaṅgañca vicāro ca āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca savitakkasavicārassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. States with sustained application only and states without initial application and sustained application are a condition by way of immediacy for a state with initial application and sustained application—the death consciousness with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the rebirth consciousness with initial application and sustained application. The life-continuum with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for adverting. The aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the emergence with initial application and sustained application. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā [T 2.0074] avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0063] maggo ca vicāro ca avitakkavicāramattassa phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ phalañca vicāro ca avitakkavicāramattassa phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States with sustained application only and states without initial application and sustained application are a condition by way of immediacy for a state with sustained application only—the preceding aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the subsequent aggregates with sustained application only. The path with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the fruit with sustained application only. The fruit with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the fruit with sustained application only. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimassa pacchimassa vicārassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ cuticittañca vicāro ca avitakkaavicārassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca avitakkaavicārassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States with sustained application only and states without initial application and sustained application are a condition by way of immediacy for a state without initial application and sustained application—the preceding aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the subsequent sustained application. The death consciousness with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the rebirth consciousness without initial application and sustained application. The aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the emergence without initial application and sustained application. (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramatto maggo ca vicāro ca avitakkavicāramattassa phalassa vicārassa [M 2.0055] ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ phalañca vicāro ca avitakkavicāramattassa phalassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States with sustained application only and states without initial application and sustained application are a condition by way of immediacy for both a state with sustained application only and a state without initial application and sustained application—the preceding aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the subsequent aggregates with sustained application only and for sustained application. The path with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the fruit with sustained application only and for sustained application. The fruit with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the fruit with sustained application only and for sustained application. (4)

Avitakkavicāramatto [T 2.0075] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattaṃ cuticittañca vicāro ca savitakkasavicārassa upapatticittassa vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattaṃ bhavaṅgañca vicāro ca āvajjanāya vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca savitakkasavicārassa vuṭṭhānassa vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (5)

States with sustained application only and states without initial application and sustained application are a condition by way of immediacy for both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state with sustained application only—the death consciousness with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the rebirth consciousness with initial application and sustained application and for initial application. The life-continuum with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for adverting and for initial application. The aggregates with sustained application only, and sustained application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the emergence with initial application and sustained application and for initial application. (5)

83. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca [V 2.0064] pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomañca vitakko ca gotrabhussa… anulomañca vitakko ca vodānassa… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa… vodānañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa… savitakkasavicāro maggo ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa phalassa… savitakkasavicāraṃ phalañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa phalassa… anulomañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. States with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for a state with initial application and sustained application—the preceding aggregates with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the subsequent aggregates with initial application and sustained application. Adaptation, and initial application, are a condition for change-of-lineage… Adaptation, and initial application, are a condition for purification… Change-of-lineage, and initial application, are a condition for the path with initial application and sustained application… Purification, and initial application, are a condition for the path with initial application and sustained application… The path with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for the fruit with initial application and sustained application… The fruit with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for the fruit with initial application and sustained application… Adaptation, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the fruition-attainment with initial application and sustained application. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā [T 2.0076] savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca pacchimassa pacchimassa vitakkassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Savitakkasavicāraṃ cuticittañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa… vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa [M 2.0056]… anulomañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for a state with sustained application only. Preceding aggregates with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for subsequent initial application. The death consciousness with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the rebirth consciousness with sustained application only. Aggregates with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for emergence with sustained application only. The preparatory work for the jhāna with sustained application only, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for the jhāna with sustained application only. Change-of-lineage, and initial application, are a condition for the path with sustained application only… purification, and initial application, are a condition for the path with sustained application only… adaptation, and initial application, are a condition by way of immediacy for fruition-attainment with sustained application only. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāraṃ cuticittañca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa upapatticittassa vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā ca vitakko ca pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa vuṭṭhānassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca dutiye jhāne vicārassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… catutthassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… viññāṇañcāyatanassa [T 2.0077] parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammañca vitakko ca [V 2.0065] …pe… dibbassa cakkhussa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… iddhividhañāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… cetopariyañāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca… vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca… anulomañca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārāya phalasamāpattiyā vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and states with only sustained thought, are a condition for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of proximity condition. The death-consciousness accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the rebirth-consciousness without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. Adverting and initial thought are a condition for the five sense-consciousnesses by way of proximity condition. Aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for emergence without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. The preparation for the second jhāna, and initial thought, are a condition for sustained thought in the second jhāna by way of proximity condition. The preparation for the third jhāna, and initial thought… the preparation for the fourth jhāna, and initial thought… the preparation for the base of infinite space, and initial thought… the preparation for the base of infinite consciousness, and initial thought… the preparation for the base of nothingness, and initial thought… the preparation for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, and initial thought… the preparation for the divine eye, and initial thought… the preparation for the divine ear-element, and initial thought… the preparation for the knowledge of psychic powers, and initial thought… the preparation for the knowledge of others' minds, and initial thought… the preparation for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, and initial thought… the preparation for the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings, and initial thought… the preparation for the knowledge of the future, and initial thought… Change-of-lineage and initial thought are a condition for the path without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought… purification and initial thought are a condition for the path without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought… adaptation and initial thought are a condition for the fruition attainment without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāraṃ cuticittañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa upapatticittassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa vuṭṭhānassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa [M 2.0057] maggassa ca vicārassa [T 2.0078] ca… anulomañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattāya phalasamāpattiyā ca vicārassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and states with only sustained thought, are a condition for a state with only sustained thought and for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of proximity condition. The death-consciousness accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the rebirth-consciousness with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. Aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for emergence with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. The preparation for the jhāna with only sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the jhāna with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. Change-of-lineage and initial thought are a condition for the path with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. Purification and initial thought are a condition for the path with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought… adaptation and initial thought are a condition for the fruition attainment with only sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomañca vitakko ca gotrabhussa ca vitakkassa ca… anulomañca vitakko ca vodānassa ca vitakkassa ca… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa ca maggassa ca vitakkassa ca… vodānañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa ca vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Savitakkasavicāro maggo ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa phalassa ca vitakkassa ca [V 2.0066]… savitakkasavicāraṃ phalañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa phalassa ca vitakkassa ca… anulomañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārāya phalasamāpattiyā ca vitakkassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (5)

States accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and states with only sustained thought, are a condition for a state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for a state with only sustained thought, by way of proximity condition. Preceding and preceding aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for subsequent and subsequent aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought, by way of proximity condition. Adaptation and initial thought are a condition for change-of-lineage and for initial thought… adaptation and initial thought are a condition for purification and for initial thought… change-of-lineage and initial thought are a condition for the path accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought… purification and initial thought are a condition for the path accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought, by way of proximity condition. The path accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the fruit accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought… the fruit accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the fruit accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought… adaptation and initial thought are a condition for the fruition attainment accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought, by way of proximity condition. (5)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

84. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarapaccayopi samanantarapaccayopi sadiso).

84. A state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought by way of contiguity condition. (The proximity condition and the contiguity condition are similar.)

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

85. Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0079] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

85. A state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for three aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for three aggregates… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates…. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā vitakkassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with only sustained thought by way of co-nascence condition—the aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought are a condition for initial thought by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro [M 2.0058] dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe…. (3)

A state accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of co-nascence condition—the aggregates accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… for kamma-originated material phenomena…. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (4)

Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0067] dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā [T 2.0080] khandhā vitakkassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state that is merely sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application are a condition for initial application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (5)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (6)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (6)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (7)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application, for a state that is merely sustained application, and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates, for initial application, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates, for initial application, and for mind-originated material phenomena… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (7)

86. Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

86. A state that is merely sustained application is a condition for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate that is merely sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vitakko savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state that is merely sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—initial application is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto [T 2.0081][M 2.0059] dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā khandhā vicārassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo, vitakko cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state that is merely sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—the aggregates that are merely sustained application are a condition for sustained application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition; initial application is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0068] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vitakko savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state that is merely sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—initial application is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (4)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (5)

A state that is merely sustained application is a condition for a state that is merely sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate that is merely sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates, for sustained application, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates, for sustained application, and for mind-originated material phenomena… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (5)

87. Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Vicāro cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāro [T 2.0082] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe… vicāro kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… vicāro vatthussa…pe… vatthu vicārassa…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

87. A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. Sustained application is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena… At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena… sustained application is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena… The aggregates are a condition for the physical base… The physical base is a condition for the aggregates… Sustained application is a condition for the physical base… The physical base is a condition for sustained application… One great primary element is a condition for the three great primary elements… The great primary elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena, kamma-originated material phenomena, and derived material phenomena… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, one great primary element… the great primary elements are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena and derived material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro [M 2.0060] dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vitakkassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 2.0083] kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state that is merely sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. Sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… At the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates that are merely sustained application and for sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. (4)

Avitakkaavicāro [V 2.0069] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition. (5)

88. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

88. A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application and the physical base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vatthu ca vitakkassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and the physical base are conditions for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and the great elements are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0084][M 2.0061] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate accompanied by initial application and sustained application and the physical base are conditions for the three aggregates and for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates and the physical base are conditions for the two aggregates and for initial application by way of the co-nascence condition. (4)

89. Avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0070] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakko ca vatthu ca savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A state that is merely sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, initial application and the physical base are conditions for the aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state that is merely sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state that is merely sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate that is merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates and sustained application are conditions for the two aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate that is merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates… two aggregates and sustained application are conditions for the two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate that is merely sustained application and the physical base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena [T 2.0085] paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… vitakko ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakko ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vatthu ca vicārassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state that is merely sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—the aggregates that are merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. The aggregates that are merely sustained application and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… initial application and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates that are merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates that are merely sustained application and the great elements are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking, initial application and the great elements are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates that are merely sustained application and the physical base are conditions for sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ca vicāro ca ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve [M 2.0062] khandhā ca vicāro ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca [V 2.0071] sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state that is merely sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state that is merely sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate that is merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. Three aggregates and sustained application are conditions for one aggregate and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. Two aggregates and sustained application are conditions for the two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate that is merely sustained application and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate that is merely sustained application and the physical base are conditions for the three aggregates and for sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition… two aggregates and the physical base are conditions for the two aggregates and for sustained application by way of the co-nascence condition. (4)

90. Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0086] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

90. States with initial application and sustained application and states with only sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with initial application and sustained application and initial application are a condition for the three aggregates by way of co-nascence condition… two aggregates and initial application are a condition for the two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking….

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

States with initial application and sustained application and states with only sustained application are a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of co-nascence condition—the aggregates with initial application and sustained application and initial application are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking….

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

States with initial application and sustained application and states with only sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with initial application and sustained application and initial application are a condition for the three aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition… two aggregates and initial application are a condition for the two aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking….

91. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

91. States with initial application and sustained application, states with only sustained application, and states without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application, initial application, and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of co-nascence condition… two aggregates, initial application, and the physical base are a condition for the two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition.

Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0087] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena [M 2.0063] paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States with initial application and sustained application, states with only sustained application, and states without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of co-nascence condition—the aggregates with initial application and sustained application, initial application, and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates with initial application and sustained application, initial application, and the great elements are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition.

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutual Condition

92. Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0072] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

92. A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. One aggregate with initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…. At the moment of relinking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…. Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutual condition.

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā vitakkassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state with only sustained application by way of mutual condition—the aggregates with initial application and sustained application are a condition for initial application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking….

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the aggregates with initial application and sustained application are a condition for the physical base by way of mutual condition.

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0088] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application and for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and the physical base by way of mutual condition…. Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and the physical base by way of mutual condition.

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā vitakkassa ca vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for both a state with only sustained application and a state without initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, the aggregates with initial application and sustained application are a condition for initial application and the physical base by way of mutual condition.

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (6)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state with only sustained application by way of mutual condition—one aggregate with initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and initial application by way of mutual condition…. Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and initial application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking….

Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0073] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca [M 2.0064] vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (7)

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application, a state with only sustained application, and a state without initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates, initial application, and the physical base by way of mutual condition…. Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates, initial application, and the physical base by way of mutual condition.

93. Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ [T 2.0089] khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

93. A state with only sustained application is a condition for another state with only sustained application by way of mutual condition—one aggregate with only sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…. Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking….

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – vitakko savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with only sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition—initial application is a condition for the aggregates with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking….

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā khandhā vicārassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā vicārassa ca vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakko vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with sustained application only is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of mutual condition—the aggregates with sustained application only are a condition for sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the aggregates with sustained application only are a condition for sustained application and for the physical base by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, initial application is a condition for the physical base by way of mutual condition. (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakko savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state with sustained application only is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, initial application is a condition for the aggregates with initial application and sustained application and for the physical base by way of mutual condition. (4)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ [V 2.0074] vicārassa ca vatthussa [T 2.0090] ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state with sustained application only is a condition for a state with sustained application only and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of mutual condition—one aggregate with sustained application only is a condition for the three aggregates and for sustained application by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, one aggregate with sustained application only is a condition for the three aggregates, for sustained application, and for the physical base by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates, for sustained application, and for the physical base by way of mutual condition. (5)

94. Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa [M 2.0065] ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… vicāro vatthussa…pe… vatthu vicārassa…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

94. A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of mutual condition—one aggregate without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, one aggregate without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the three aggregates and for the physical base by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for the physical base by way of mutual condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical base… The physical base is a condition for the aggregates… Sustained application is a condition for the physical base… The physical base is a condition for sustained application… One great primary element is a condition for the three great primary elements… External… Nutriment-originated… Temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, one great primary element… (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 2.0091] vatthu vitakkassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state with sustained application only by way of mutual condition—sustained application is a condition for the aggregates with sustained application only by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, sustained application is a condition for the aggregates with sustained application only by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with sustained application only by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the physical base is a condition for initial application by way of mutual condition. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state with sustained application only and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, sustained application is a condition for the aggregates with sustained application only and for the physical base by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with sustained application only and for sustained application by way of mutual condition. (4)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa [V 2.0075] aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application and for a state with sustained application only by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, the physical base is a condition for the aggregates with initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of mutual condition. (5)

95. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

95. A state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutual condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro [M 2.0066] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vatthu ca vitakkassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state with sustained application only by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, the aggregates with initial application and sustained application and the physical base are a condition for initial application by way of mutual condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena [T 2.0092] paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application and for a state with sustained application only by way of mutual condition—at the moment of relinking, one aggregate with initial application and sustained application and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates and for initial application by way of mutual condition… Two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for the two aggregates and for initial application by way of mutual condition. (3)

96. Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vitakko ca vatthu ca savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

96. A state with sustained application only and a state without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. At the moment of relinking, initial application and the physical base are a condition for the aggregates with initial application and sustained application by way of mutual condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of mutuality condition. One aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought are a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates and sustained thought are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, sustained thought, and the base are a condition for the three aggregates…pe… two aggregates, sustained thought, and the base are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutuality condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0076] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vatthu ca vicārassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for the state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought are a condition for the base by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the base are a condition for sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto [T 2.0093] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca aññamaññapaccayena [M 2.0067] paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (4)

The state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for the state without initial thought and sustained thought, by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought are a condition for the three aggregates and the base by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates and sustained thought are a condition for the two aggregates and the base by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the base are a condition for the three aggregates and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates and the base are a condition for the two aggregates and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. (4)

97. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

97. The state with initial thought and sustained thought, and the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, are a condition for the state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. One aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates and initial thought are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The state with initial thought and sustained thought, and the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, are a condition for the state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the base by way of mutuality condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena [T 2.0094] paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The state with initial thought and sustained thought, and the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, are a condition for the state with initial thought and sustained thought, and for the state without initial thought and sustained thought, by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought, and initial thought, are a condition for the three aggregates and the base by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates and initial thought are a condition for the two aggregates and the base by way of mutuality condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0077] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vitakko ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The state with initial thought and sustained thought, the state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for the state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought, initial thought, and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutuality condition…pe… two aggregates, initial thought, and the base are a condition for the two aggregates by way of mutuality condition. (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Support Condition

98. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ) satta.

98. A state with initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. One aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for the three aggregates. (Abbreviated.) Seven.

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ) pañca.

A state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, is a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition. (Abbreviated.) Five.

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [M 2.0068] rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Vicāro cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā [T 2.0095] ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu avitakkaavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. One aggregate without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. Sustained thought is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for three aggregates and for kamma-born materiality by way of support condition…pe… two aggregates for two aggregates…pe… for non-percipient beings, one great element…pe… the eye-base for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates without initial thought and sustained thought, and for sustained thought, by way of support condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu…pe…. (2)

A state without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base…pe…. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vicāro [V 2.0078] avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo, vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro…pe…. (3)

A state without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition. Sustained thought is a condition for the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition; the base is a condition for the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for initial thought, by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, sustained thought…pe…. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicāro…pe…. (4)

A state without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for a state without initial thought and sustained thought, by way of support condition.
