Sustained thought is a condition for the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for sustained thought, by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, sustained thought…pe…. (4)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu…pe…. (5)

A state without initial thought and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought, and for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought, and for initial thought, by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base…pe…. (5)

99. Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0096] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… (pavattipi, paṭisandhipi dīpetabbā). (1)

99. A state with initial thought and sustained thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. One aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of support condition…pe… (This should be illustrated for both the course of existence and rebirth-linking). (1)

Savitakkasavicāro [M 2.0069] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vatthu ca vitakkassa…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with initial thought and sustained thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition. The aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought and the base are a condition for initial thought by way of support condition…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state with initial thought and sustained thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. The aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicāro eko khandho [V 2.0079] ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state with initial thought and sustained thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought, and for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition. One aggregate with initial thought and sustained thought and the base are a condition for the three aggregates and for initial thought by way of support condition…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (4)

100. Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vitakko ca vatthu ca savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

100. A state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition. Initial thought and the base are a condition for the aggregates with initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko [T 2.0097] khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, by way of support condition—one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought, are a condition for the three aggregates… one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the base, are a condition for the three aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… vitakko ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vatthu ca vicārassa nissayapaccayena paccayo (paṭisandhikāni cattāri. Saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state without initial thought and sustained thought by way of support condition—the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought, are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. The aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the great elements, are a condition for mind-originated materiality… initial thought and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality… the aggregates with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the base, are a condition for sustained thought by way of support condition (Four at rebirth-linking. In brief.). (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vicāro ca [M 2.0070] dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (4)

A state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and for a state without initial thought and sustained thought, by way of support condition—one aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and sustained thought, are a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition… two aggregates and sustained thought are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. One aggregate with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and the base, are a condition for the three aggregates and for sustained thought… two aggregates and the base are a condition for two aggregates and for sustained thought by way of support condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (4)

101. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa [V 2.0080] …pe… avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa…pe… savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa…pe… tīṇi.

101. A state with initial thought and sustained thought, and a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, are a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought… for a state without initial thought and sustained thought… for a state with initial thought and sustained thought, and for a state without initial thought and sustained thought… (three).

Savitakkasavicāro [T 2.0098] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa…pe… avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo (dve vārā vitthāretabbā).

A state with initial thought and sustained thought, a state with sustained thought only, without initial thought, and a state without initial thought and sustained thought, are a condition for a state with initial thought and sustained thought… for a state without initial thought and sustained thought, by way of support condition (two sections should be elaborated).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

102. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicāraṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, savitakkasavicāraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Savitakkasavicāraṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, savitakkasavicāraṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ…pe… pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Savitakkasavicārā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā savitakkasavicārāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

102. A state with applied thought, with sustained thought, is a condition for a state with applied thought, with sustained thought, by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: based on faith with applied thought, with sustained thought, one gives alms, undertakes precepts, performs the Uposatha observance, generates jhāna with applied thought, with sustained thought, generates insight, the path… attains absorption, boasts, or holds a view. Based on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration with applied thought, with sustained thought, one gives alms, undertakes precepts, performs the Uposatha observance, generates jhāna with applied thought, with sustained thought, generates insight, the path… attains absorption… kills a living being… or splits the Saṅgha. (5)

106. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicārā [T 2.0106] saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā vitakko ca savitakkasavicārāya saddhāya sīlassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

106. A state with initial application, with sustained application, and a state without initial application, with only sustained application are conditions for a state with initial application, with sustained application by way of decisive support condition – object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: Faith with initial application, with sustained application… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration, and initial application are conditions for faith with initial application, with sustained application… for virtue… up to for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0086] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicārā [M 2.0076] saddhā sīlaṃ…pe… patthanā vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya vitakkassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with initial application, with sustained application, and a state without initial application, with only sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application, with only sustained application by way of decisive support condition – object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support…. Natural decisive support: Faith with initial application, with sustained application… virtue… up to aspiration, and initial application are conditions for faith without initial application, with only sustained application… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom, and for initial application by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicārā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā…pe… patthanā vitakko ca avitakkaavicārāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya vicārassa ca… kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States with applied and sustained thought and states with only sustained thought are a condition for a state without applied and sustained thought by way of decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: faith with applied and sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… up to aspiration, and applied thought are a condition for faith without applied and sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, sustained thought, bodily pleasure, and bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicārā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā…pe… patthanā [T 2.0107] vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya vicārassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States with applied and sustained thought and states with only sustained thought are a condition for a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied and sustained thought by way of decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: faith with applied and sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… up to aspiration, and applied thought are a condition for faith with only sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, and sustained thought by way of decisive support condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – savitakkasavicārā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā vitakko ca savitakkasavicārāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya vitakkassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

States with applied and sustained thought and states with only sustained thought are a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: faith with applied and sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration, and applied thought are a condition for faith with applied and sustained thought… up to aspiration, and applied thought by way of decisive support condition. (5)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

107. Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0087] – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu avitakkaavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

107. A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied and sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One sees a form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear-element; the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: The eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the aggregates without applied and sustained thought and for sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro [M 2.0077] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… [T 2.0108] vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One discerns the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self… the tangible object… one discerns the base as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one savors it and delights in it, and dependent on that, lust arises… displeasure arises. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates with applied and sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha vitakko uppajjati…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha vitakko uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with only sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One discerns the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; savors it and delights in it; and dependent on that, applied thought arises… one discerns the base as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; savors it and delights in it; and dependent on that, applied thought arises. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates with only sustained thought and for applied thought by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with only sustained thought and a state without applied and sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates with only sustained thought and for sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition. (4)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca uppajjanti. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… [T 2.0109] jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati assādeti [V 2.0088] abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state with only sustained thought by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One discerns the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; savors it and delights in it, and dependent on that, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Similarly with the ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangible objects… the base—one discerns them as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; savors it and delights in it, and dependent on that, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought by way of pre-nascence condition. (5)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

108. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā savitakkasavicārā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

108. A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied and sustained thought by way of post-nascence condition. Post-nascent aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto [M 2.0078] dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vitakko ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state with only sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied and sustained thought by way of post-nascence condition. Post-nascent aggregates with only sustained thought and applied thought are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā avitakkaavicārā khandhā ca vicāro ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state without applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied and sustained thought by way of post-nascence condition. Post-nascent aggregates without applied and sustained thought and sustained thought are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

States of mere sustained application and states without initial and sustained application are a condition for a state without initial and sustained application by way of the post-nascence condition. Post-nascent aggregates of mere sustained application and sustained application are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa [T 2.0110] dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

States accompanied by initial application and sustained application and states of mere sustained application are a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the post-nascence condition. Post-nascent aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and initial application are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

The Repetition Condition.

109. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0089] – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu savitakkasavicārassa maggassa… vodānaṃ savitakkasavicārassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

109. A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage... conformity is a condition for purification... change-of-lineage is a condition for the path accompanied by initial application and sustained application... purification is a condition for the path accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa vitakkassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa parikammaṃ avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Vodānaṃ avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application are a condition for later and later sustained application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the jhāna of mere sustained application is a condition for the jhāna of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Purification is a condition for the path of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – dutiyassa jhānassa parikammaṃ dutiye jhāne vicārassa āsevanapaccayena [M 2.0079] paccayo. Tatiyassa jhānassa parikammaṃ tatiyassa jhānassa…pe… catutthassa jhānassa parikammaṃ catutthassa jhānassa…pe… [T 2.0111] ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa…pe… viññāṇañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ dibbassa cakkhussa…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā parikammaṃ dibbāya sotadhātuyā…pe… iddhividhañāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe… gotrabhu avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca… vodānaṃ avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the third jhāna is a condition for the third jhāna... the preparatory work for the fourth jhāna is a condition for the fourth jhāna... the preparatory work for the base of the infinity of space is a condition for the base of the infinity of space... the preparatory work for the base of the infinity of consciousness is a condition for the base of the infinity of consciousness... the preparatory work for the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of nothingness... the preparatory work for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception... the preparatory work for the divine eye is a condition for the divine eye... the preparatory work for the divine ear element is a condition for the divine ear element... the preparatory work for the knowledge of psychic power... the preparatory work for the knowledge of mind-reading... the preparatory work for the knowledge of past-life recollection... the preparatory work for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearing of beings... the preparatory work for the knowledge of the future... change-of-lineage is a condition for the path without initial application and sustained application... purification is a condition for the path without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa parikammaṃ avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu avitakkavicāramattassa [V 2.0090] maggassa vicārassa ca… vodānaṃ avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application and for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the jhāna of mere sustained application is a condition for the jhāna of mere sustained application and for sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path of mere sustained application and for sustained application... purification is a condition for the path of mere sustained application and for sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 2.0112] vitakkassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa vitakkassa ca… anulomaṃ vodānassa vitakkassa ca… gotrabhu savitakkasavicārassa maggassa vitakkassa ca… vodānaṃ savitakkasavicārassa maggassa vitakkassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state accompanied by initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the repetition condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage and for initial application... conformity is a condition for purification and for initial application... change-of-lineage is a condition for the path accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for initial application... purification is a condition for the path accompanied by initial application and sustained application and for initial application by way of the repetition condition. (5)

110. Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vitakko pacchimassa pacchimassa vitakkassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

110. A state of mere sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto [M 2.0080] dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vitakko pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state of mere sustained application is a condition for a state accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates accompanied by initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa vicārassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state of mere sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates without initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (3)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state of mere sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application and for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application and for aggregates without initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (4)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa [T 2.0113] ca dhammassa [V 2.0091] āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vitakko pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state of mere sustained application is a condition for a state with initial and sustained application and for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier initial application is a condition for later and later aggregates with initial and sustained application and for initial application by way of the repetition condition. (5)

111. Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vicāro pacchimassa pacchimassa vicārassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā avitakkaavicārā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkaavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

111. A state without initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier sustained application is a condition for later and later sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates without initial application and sustained application are a condition for later and later aggregates without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vicāro pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier sustained application is a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimo purimo vicāro pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state of mere sustained application and for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier sustained application is a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application and for sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (3)

112. Avitakkavicāramatto [M 2.0081] ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

112. States of mere sustained application and without initial application and sustained application are a condition for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application, and sustained application, are a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa [T 2.0114] dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimassa pacchimassa vicārassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States of mere sustained application and without initial application and sustained application are a condition for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application, and sustained application, are a condition for later and later sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States of mere sustained application and without initial application and sustained application are a condition for a state of mere sustained application and for a state without initial application and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates of mere sustained application, and sustained application, are a condition for later and later aggregates of mere sustained application, and for sustained application, by way of the repetition condition. (3)

113. Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomañca vitakko ca gotrabhussa… anulomañca vitakko ca vodānassa… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa… vodānañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

113. States with initial and sustained application and of mere sustained application are a condition for a state with initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates with initial and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for later and later aggregates with initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Conformity knowledge and initial application are a condition for change-of-lineage knowledge… conformity knowledge and initial application for purification knowledge… change-of-lineage knowledge and initial application for the path with initial and sustained application… purification knowledge and initial application for the path with initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca pacchimassa pacchimassa vitakkassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakka vicāramattassa maggassa… vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States with initial and sustained application and of mere sustained application are a condition for a state of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Earlier and earlier aggregates with initial and sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for later and later initial application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the jhāna of mere sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for the jhāna of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. Change-of-lineage knowledge and initial application are a condition for the path of mere sustained application… purification knowledge and initial application for the path of mere sustained application by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – dutiyassa jhānassa parikammañca vitakko [M 2.0082] ca dutiye jhāne vicārassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa parikammañca vitakko ca…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammañca vitakko ca anāgataṃsañāṇassa āsevanapaccayena [T 2.0115] paccayo. Gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkaavicārassa maggassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States with initial and sustained application and of mere sustained application are a condition for a state without initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the second jhāna, and initial application, are a condition for sustained application in the second jhāna by way of the repetition condition… the preparatory work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception and initial application… the preparatory work for the divine eye and initial application… the preparatory work for the knowledge of the future and initial application are a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of the repetition condition. Change-of-lineage knowledge and initial application are a condition for the path without initial and sustained application, and for sustained application, by way of the repetition condition. Purification knowledge and initial application are a condition for the path without initial and sustained application, and for sustained application, by way of the repetition condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa [V 2.0093] parikammañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa jhānassa vicārassa ca… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa vicārassa ca… vodānañca vitakko ca avitakkavicāramattassa maggassa vicārassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States with initial and sustained application and of mere sustained application are a condition for a state of mere sustained application and for a state without initial and sustained application by way of the repetition condition. The preparatory work for the jhāna of mere sustained application, and initial application, are a condition for the jhāna of mere sustained application, and for sustained application… change-of-lineage knowledge and initial application for the path of mere sustained application, and for sustained application… purification knowledge and initial application for the path of mere sustained application, and for sustained application, by way of the repetition condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo [T 2.0116] – purimā purimā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomañca vitakko ca gotrabhussa vitakkassa ca… anulomañca vitakko ca vodānassa vitakkassa ca… gotrabhu ca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa vitakkassa ca… vodānañca vitakko ca savitakkasavicārassa maggassa vitakkassa ca āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (5)

States with initial and sustained thought and states without initial thought, with sustained thought only, are a condition for states with initial and sustained thought and for states without initial thought, with sustained thought only, by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates with initial and sustained thought and initial thought are a condition for the succeeding aggregates with initial and sustained thought and for initial thought by way of repetition condition. Conformity knowledge and initial thought are a condition for change-of-lineage knowledge and for its initial thought… Conformity knowledge and initial thought are a condition for purification knowledge and for its initial thought… Change-of-lineage knowledge and initial thought are a condition for the path with initial and sustained thought and for its initial thought… Purification knowledge and initial thought are a condition for the path with initial and sustained thought and for its initial thought by way of repetition condition. (5)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

114. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

114. A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the resultant aggregates with initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro [M 2.0083] dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vitakkassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā vitakkassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākassa vitakkassa kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for initial thought by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for initial thought by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for resultant initial thought by way of kamma condition. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa kammapaccayena [T 2.0117] paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena [V 2.0094] paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākānaṃ avitakkaavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state without initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for resultant aggregates without initial and sustained thought and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial and sustained thought and for a state without initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for resultant aggregates with initial and sustained thought and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (4)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vitakkassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā vitakkassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākassa [T 2.0118] vitakkassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, and for a state without initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for initial thought and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for initial thought and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for resultant initial thought and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (5)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ [M 2.0084] khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vicākānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca kammapaccayena paccayo. (6)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial and sustained thought and for a state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates and for initial thought by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates and for initial thought by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the resultant aggregates with initial and sustained thought and for initial thought by way of kamma condition. (6)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [V 2.0095] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – savitakkasavicārā cetanā vipākānaṃ savitakkasavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ vitakkassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (7)

A state with initial and sustained thought is a condition for a state with initial and sustained thought, for a state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, and for a state without initial and sustained thought by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates, for initial thought, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the associated aggregates, for initial thought, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. Arisen at different moments: Volition with initial and sustained thought is a condition for the resultant aggregates with initial and sustained thought, for initial thought, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (7)

115. Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – avitakkavicāramattā [T 2.0119] cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – avitakkavicāramattā cetanā vipākānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

115. A state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, is a condition for a state without initial thought, with sustained thought only, by way of kamma condition—simultaneously arisen and arisen at different moments. Simultaneously arisen: Volition without initial thought, with sustained thought only, is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. Arisen at different moments: Volition without initial thought, with sustained thought only, is a condition for the resultant aggregates without initial thought, with sustained thought only, by way of kamma condition. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – avitakkavicāramattā cetanā vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā cetanā vipākassa vicārassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – avitakkavicāramattā cetanā vipākassa vicārassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of kamma condition—co-nascently and at different moments. Co-nascently, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for sustained application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for resultant sustained application and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At different moments, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for resultant sustained application and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – avitakkavicāramattā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā [M 2.0085] – avitakkavicāramattā cetanā vipākānaṃ avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, and for a state without initial application and without sustained application, by way of kamma condition—co-nascently and at different moments. Co-nascently, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for the associated aggregates, for sustained application, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for the associated aggregates, for sustained application, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At different moments, volition that is without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for the resultant aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, for sustained application, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa kammapaccayena [T 2.0120] paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – avitakkaavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca [V 2.0096] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkaavicārā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – avitakkaavicārā cetanā vipākānaṃ avitakkaavicārānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of kamma condition—co-nascently and at different moments. Co-nascently, volition that is without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition that is without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At different moments, volition that is without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for the resultant aggregates that are without initial application and without sustained application, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

116. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe savitakkasavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe….

116. A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of result condition—a resultant state with initial application and sustained application, being one aggregate, is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of result condition…and so on… At the moment of rebirth-linking, a resultant state with initial application and sustained application, being one aggregate, is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of result condition…and so on.

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā savitakkasavicārā khandhā vitakkassa vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

A state with initial application and sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition—resultant aggregates with initial application and sustained application are a condition for initial application by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on.

(Savitakkasavicāramūlakā sattapi pañhā paripuṇṇā.)

(The seven questions originating with states with initial application and sustained application are completed.)

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho…pe….

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition—a resultant state without initial application, with sustained application only, being one aggregate, is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of result condition…and so on…two aggregates…and so on… At the moment of rebirth-linking, a resultant state without initial application, with sustained application only, being one aggregate…and so on.

(Avitakkavicāramattamūlakā [T 2.0121] pañca pañhā kātabbā, vipākanti niyāmetabbā.)

(Five questions originating with states without initial application, with sustained application only, are to be formulated; they should be specified as ‘resultant’.)

117. Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko avitakkaavicāro eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā [M 2.0086]…pe… vipāko vicāro cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [V 2.0097] rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. Vicāro vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

117. A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of result condition—a resultant state without initial application and without sustained application, being one aggregate, is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition…and so on…two aggregates…and so on… Resultant sustained application is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on…the aggregates are a condition for the physical basis by way of result condition. Sustained application is a condition for the physical basis by way of result condition. (1)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition—resultant sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition. (2)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko vicāro avitakkavicāramattānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, and for a state without initial application and without sustained application, by way of result condition—resultant sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant sustained application is a condition for the aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. (3)

118. Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena [T 2.0122] paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

118. A state without initial application, with sustained application only, and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of result condition—a resultant state without initial application, with sustained application only, being one aggregate, and sustained application are conditions for the other three aggregates by way of result condition…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe avitakkavicāramattā khandhā ca vicāro ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of result condition—resultant aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, and sustained application are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, aggregates that are without initial application, with sustained application only, and sustained application are conditions for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto ca avitakkaavicāro ca dhammā avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko avitakkavicāramatto eko khandho ca vicāro ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Both a state without initial application, with sustained application only, and a state without initial application and without sustained application are conditions for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of result condition—a resultant state without initial application, with sustained application only, one aggregate, and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking, a resultant state without initial application, with sustained application only, one aggregate, and sustained application are conditions for the three aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. (3)

Savitakkasavicāro [V 2.0098] ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko savitakkasavicāro eko [M 2.0087] khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application, with sustained application only, are conditions for a state with initial application and sustained application by way of result condition—a resultant state with initial application and sustained application, one aggregate, and initial application are conditions for the three aggregates by way of result condition…and so on…two aggregates…and so on…at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā savitakkasavicārā khandhā ca vitakko ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena [T 2.0123] paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application, with sustained application only, are conditions for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of result condition—resultant aggregates with initial application and sustained application, and initial application, are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (2)

Savitakkasavicāro ca avitakkavicāramatto ca dhammā savitakkasavicārassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko savitakkasavicāro eko khandho ca vitakko ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Both a state with initial application and sustained application and a state without initial application, with sustained application only, are conditions for a state with initial application and sustained application and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of result condition—a resultant state with initial application and sustained application, one aggregate, and initial application are conditions for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

119. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

119. A state with initial and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial and sustained application by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments with initial and sustained application are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Savitakkasavicāro dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā āhārā vitakkassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

A state with initial and sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments with initial and sustained application are a condition for initial application by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on.

(Savitakkasavicāramūlakā iminā kāraṇena satta pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

For this reason, the seven questions rooted in states with initial and sustained application should be analyzed.

Avitakkavicāramatto dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments without initial application, with sustained application only, are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)

Avitakkavicāramatto [V 2.0099] dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā āhārā vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments without initial application, with sustained application only, are a condition for sustained application and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (2)

Avitakkavicāramatto [T 2.0124] dhammo avitakkavicāramattassa ca avitakkaavicārassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – avitakkavicāramattā āhārā [M 2.0088] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ vicārassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state without initial application, with sustained application only, is a condition for a state without initial application, with sustained application only, and for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments without initial application, with sustained application only, are a condition for the associated aggregates, for sustained application, and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (3)

Avitakkaavicāro dhammo avitakkaavicārassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – avitakkaavicārā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo.

A state without initial application and without sustained application is a condition for a state without initial application and without sustained application by way of the nutriment condition. Nutriments without initial application and without sustained application are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on… Physical food is a condition for this body by way of the nutriment condition.

Faculty Condition

120. Savitakkasavicāro dhammo savitakkasavicārassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – savitakkasavicārā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

120. A state with initial and sustained application is a condition for a state with initial and sustained application by way of the faculty condition. Faculties with initial and sustained application are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the faculty condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on. (1)
