Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

6. Pītisahagataṃ [V 2.0124] dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

6. Dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, a joy-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition. Dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied aggregate, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagatā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied aggregate, three pleasure-accompanied aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (2)

Pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, both joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied aggregate, three joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (3)

7. Sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. (1)

7. Dependent on a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless pleasure-accompanied aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (1)

Sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca pītisahagatā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve [T 2.0156] khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, a joy-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless pleasure-accompanied aggregate, three joy-accompanied aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (2)

Sukhasahagataṃ [M 2.0111] dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. (3)

Dependent on a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, both joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless pleasure-accompanied aggregate, two joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (3)

8. Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ [V 2.0125] upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upekkhāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

8. Dependent on an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless equanimity-accompanied aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rootless relinking, dependent on one equanimity-accompanied aggregate, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. Dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

9. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca pītisahagatā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

9. Dependent on a joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, a joy-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregate, three joy-accompanied aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagatā dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. (2)

Dependent on a joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregate, two pleasure-accompanied aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (2)

Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca [T 2.0157] eko khandho. (3)

Dependent on a joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, both joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied phenomena arise by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregate, two joy-accompanied and pleasure-accompanied aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (3)

Naadhipati-naāsevanapaccayā

Non-Domination, Non-Repetition Conditions

10. Pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (naadhipatipaṭisandhikkhaṇe paripuṇṇaṃ)… napurejātapaccayā… (“arūpe”ti niyāmetabbaṃ “paṭisandhikkhaṇe”ti ca) napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

10. A joy-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of domination condition (complete for non-domination at the moment of rebirth-linking)... not by way of pre-nascence condition... (This should be restricted to the immaterial realm and the moment of rebirth-linking)... not by way of post-nascence condition... not by way of repetition condition.

Nakammapaccayo

Non-Kamma Condition

11. Pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – pītisahagate khandhe paṭicca pītisahagatā cetanā.

11. A joy-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on joy-accompanied aggregates, joy-accompanied volition arises.

Pītisahagataṃ [M 2.0112][V 2.0126] dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – pītisahagate khandhe paṭicca sukhasahagatā cetanā.

A pleasure-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on joy-accompanied aggregates, pleasure-accompanied volition arises.

(Iminā kāraṇena dasa pañhā vitthāretabbā.)

(For this reason, ten questions should be elaborated.)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-Result Condition

12. Pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā…pe… (paripuṇṇaṃ, paṭisandhi natthi).

12. A joy-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on a joy-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of result condition...etc. (complete, rebirth-linking is absent).

Najhānapaccayādi

Non-Jhāna Condition, etc.

13. Sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. (1)

13. A pleasure-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on a pleasure-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of jhāna condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by pleasure and body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (1)

Upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – catuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. (1)

An equanimity-accompanied phenomenon arises dependent on an equanimity-accompanied phenomenon, not by way of jhāna condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by the four consciousnesses, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. (1)

(Namaggapaccayā nahetupaccayasadisaṃ. Moho natthi. Navippayuttapaccayā paripuṇṇaṃ arūpapañhameva.)

(The non-path condition is similar to the non-root condition. Delusion is absent. The non-dissociation condition is complete only in the questions pertaining to the immaterial realm.)

Paṭiccavāro.

The Section on Dependence.

2-6. The Sections on Conascence, Condition, Dependence, Concomitance, and Association.

(Sahajātavāropi paccayavāropi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi paṭiccavārasadisā.)

(The conascence section, the condition section, the dependence section, the concomitance section, and the association section are similar to the dependence section.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. The Section on Questions.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Affirmative Mode of Conditions.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section of Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

17. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pītisahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena [T 2.0159] paccayo. (1)

17. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of root condition—roots accompanied by joy are a condition for their associated aggregates by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, roots accompanied by joy are a condition for their associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Pītisahagato [M 2.0114] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by pleasure by way of root condition—roots accompanied by joy are a condition for their associated aggregates accompanied by pleasure by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking...etc. (2)

Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo [V 2.0129] – pītisahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for states accompanied by joy and by pleasure by way of root condition—roots accompanied by joy are a condition for their associated aggregates accompanied by joy and by pleasure by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking...etc. (3)

18. Sukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa…pe… (sukhamūle tīṇi).

18. A state accompanied by pleasure is a condition for a state accompanied by pleasure...etc., for a state accompanied by joy...etc., for a state accompanied by both joy and pleasure...etc. (three in the pleasure root).

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upekkhāsahagatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of root condition—roots accompanied by equanimity are a condition for their associated aggregates by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking...etc. (1)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca hetū sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

States accompanied by joy and by pleasure are a condition for states accompanied by joy...etc., for states accompanied by pleasure...etc., and for states accompanied by joy and by pleasure by way of root condition—roots accompanied by joy and by pleasure are a condition for their associated aggregates accompanied by joy and by pleasure by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking...etc. (2)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

19. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 2.0160] paccayo – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pītisahagatena cittena paccavekkhati, pītisahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā taṃ pītisahagatena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā pītisahagatena cittena pītisahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Pītisahagate khandhe pītisahagatena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha pītisahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pītisahagate khandhe ārabbha pītisahagatā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

19. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of object condition. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by joy, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by joy. Having emerged from a jhana accompanied by joy, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by joy. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by joy, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by joy; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by joy, they discern the aggregates accompanied by joy as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Taking that as object, lust accompanied by joy arises, and wrong view arises. Taking the aggregates accompanied by joy as object, aggregates accompanied by joy arise. (1)

Pītisahagato [M 2.0115] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ sukhasahagatena cittena paccavekkhati, pītisahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā taṃ sukhasahagatena [V 2.0130] cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā sukhasahagatena cittena pītisahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Pītisahagate khandhe sukhasahagatena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha sukhasahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pītisahagate khandhe ārabbha sukhasahagatā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by pleasure by way of object condition. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by joy, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by pleasure. Having emerged from a jhana accompanied by joy, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by pleasure. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by pleasure, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by joy; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by pleasure, they discern the aggregates accompanied by joy as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Taking that as object, lust accompanied by pleasure arises, and wrong view arises. Taking the aggregates accompanied by joy as object, aggregates accompanied by pleasure arise. (2)

Pītisahagato [T 2.0161] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ upekkhāsahagatena cittena paccavekkhati, pītisahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā taṃ upekkhāsahagatena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā upekkhāsahagatena cittena pītisahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Pītisahagate khandhe upekkhāsahagatena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha upekkhāsahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena pītisahagatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti, pītisahagatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagate khandhe ārabbha upekkhāsahagatā khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of object-condition. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by joy, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by equanimity. Having emerged from a jhāna accompanied by joy, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by equanimity. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by equanimity, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by joy; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by equanimity, they discern the aggregates accompanied by joy as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Taking this as object, lust accompanied by equanimity arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, and restlessness arises. Through knowledge of others’ minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind accompanied by joy. The aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition by way of object for knowledge of others’ minds, recollection of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and advertence. Taking the aggregates accompanied by joy as object, aggregates accompanied by equanimity arise. (3)

Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena [T 2.0162] paccavekkhati, pītisahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā taṃ pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena pītisahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti[M 2.0116], pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Pītisahagate khandhe pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pītisahagate khandhe ārabbha pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (4)

A phenomenon accompanied by joy is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a phenomenon accompanied by joy and for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by joy, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by both joy and happiness. Having emerged from a jhāna accompanied by joy, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by both joy and happiness. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by both joy and happiness, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by joy; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by both joy and happiness, they discern the aggregates accompanied by joy as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Taking this as object, lust accompanied by both joy and happiness arises, and wrong view arises. Taking the aggregates accompanied by joy as object, aggregates accompanied by both joy and happiness arise. (4)

20. Sukhasahagato [V 2.0131] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sukhasahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sukhasahagate khandhe ārabbha pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (4)

20. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of object-condition… A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by joy… for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity… for a phenomenon accompanied by both joy and happiness by way of object-condition. Taking the aggregates accompanied by happiness as object, aggregates accompanied by both joy and happiness arise. (4)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ upekkhāsahagatena cittena paccavekkhati, upekkhāsahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā taṃ upekkhāsahagatena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā upekkhāsahagatena cittena upekkhāsahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Upekkhāsahagate khandhe upekkhāsahagatena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato [T 2.0163] vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha upekkhāsahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena upekkhāsahagatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Upekkhāsahagatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Upekkhāsahagate khandhe ārabbha upekkhāsahagatā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of object-condition. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by equanimity, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by equanimity. Having emerged from a jhāna accompanied by equanimity, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by equanimity. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by equanimity, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by equanimity; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by equanimity, they discern the aggregates accompanied by equanimity as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Taking this as object, lust accompanied by equanimity arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, and restlessness arises. Through knowledge of others’ minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind accompanied by equanimity. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness by way of object-condition… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object-condition. The aggregates accompanied by equanimity are a condition by way of object for the knowledge of psychic powers, knowledge of others’ minds, recollection of past lives, knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and advertence. Taking the aggregates accompanied by equanimity as object, aggregates accompanied by equanimity arise. (1)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ [M 2.0117] samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena paccavekkhati, upekkhāsahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā phalā vuṭṭhahitvā, taṃ pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena upekkhāsahagate pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Upekkhāsahagate khandhe pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca [T 2.0164] cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti assādenti [V 2.0132] abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Upekkhāsahagate khandhe ārabbha pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by zest… for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness… for a phenomenon accompanied by both zest and happiness by way of object-condition. Having given a gift, undertaken virtue, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind accompanied by equanimity, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness. Having emerged from a jhāna accompanied by equanimity, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness. Noble Ones, with a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness, review the abandoned defilements accompanied by equanimity; they review the suppressed defilements; and they know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness, they discern the aggregates accompanied by equanimity as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they savor them and delight in them. Based on that, lust accompanied by both zest and happiness arises, and wrong view arises. Based on the aggregates accompanied by equanimity, aggregates accompanied by both zest and happiness arise. (3)

21. Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā…pe… pītisahagate ca sukhasahagate ca khandhe upekkhāsahagatena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha upekkhāsahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena pītisahagatasukhasahagatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagate ca sukhasahagate ca khandhe ārabbha upekkhāsahagatā khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

21. Phenomena accompanied by both zest and happiness are a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by zest… for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness… for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of object-condition. Having given a gift with a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness, having undertaken virtue, having performed the Uposatha observance… one discerns, with a mind accompanied by equanimity, the aggregates accompanied by both zest and happiness as impermanent, as suffering, and as not-self, savors them, and delights in them. Based on that, lust accompanied by equanimity arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, and restlessness arises. Through the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind accompanied by both zest and happiness. The aggregates accompanied by both zest and happiness are a condition, by way of object-condition, for the knowledge of discerning minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of beings’ passing away and reappearance according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting. Based on the aggregates accompanied by both zest and happiness, aggregates accompanied by equanimity arise. (3)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (4)

Phenomena accompanied by both zest and happiness are a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by both zest and happiness by way of object-condition (in brief). (4)

Adhipatipaccayo

Predominance Condition

22. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – pītisahagatena [T 2.0165] cittena dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā [M 2.0118] pītisahagatena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pītisahagatā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā pītisahagatena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Pītisahagate khandhe pītisahagatena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā pītisahagato rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A phenomenon accompanied by zest is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by zest by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance and co-nascent predominance. Object-predominance: having given a gift with a mind accompanied by zest, having undertaken virtue, or having performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by zest, regarding it as weighty. Having emerged from a jhāna accompanied by zest, from the path, or from the fruit, one reviews that with a mind accompanied by zest, regarding it as weighty. One savors and delights in the aggregates accompanied by zest with a mind accompanied by zest, regarding them as weighty; based on regarding that as weighty, lust accompanied by zest arises, and wrong view arises. Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of predominance-condition. (1)

Pītisahagato [V 2.0133] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon accompanied by zest is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance and co-nascent predominance. Object-predominance: Having given a gift with a mind accompanied by zest… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of predominance-condition. (2)

Pītisahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā…pe… upekkhāsahagatena cittena (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon accompanied by zest is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of predominance-condition. Object-predominance: having given a gift with a mind accompanied by zest… with a mind accompanied by equanimity (in brief). (3)

Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A phenomenon accompanied by zest is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by both zest and happiness by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance and co-nascent predominance. Object-predominance: having given a gift with a mind accompanied by zest… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by both zest and happiness by way of predominance-condition. (4)

23. Sukhasahagato [T 2.0166] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ datvā…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – sukhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

23. A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by happiness by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance and co-nascent predominance. Object-predominance: having given a gift with a mind accompanied by happiness… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of predominance-condition. (1)

Sukhasahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – sukhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by zest by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance and co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by zest by way of predominance-condition. (2)

Sukhasahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A phenomenon accompanied by happiness is a condition for a phenomenon accompanied by equanimity by way of predominance-condition: object-predominance (in brief). (3)

Sukhasahagato [M 2.0119] dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo [V 2.0134] – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – sukhasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for states accompanied by zest and states accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition: object predominance, co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by zest and for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition. (4)

24. Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – upekkhāsahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the predominance condition: object predominance, co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the predominance condition. (1)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by zest by way of the predominance condition: object predominance (in brief). (2)

Upekkhāsahagato [T 2.0167] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition: object predominance (in brief). (3)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati (saṃkhittaṃ). (4)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for states accompanied by zest and states accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition: object predominance (in brief). (4)

25. Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. States accompanied by zest and happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by zest by way of the predominance condition: object predominance, co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest and happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by zest by way of the predominance condition. (1)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā sukhasahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati…pe…. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

States accompanied by zest and happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition: object predominance, co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest and happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition. (2)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati (saṃkhittaṃ). (3)

States accompanied by zest and happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the predominance condition: object predominance (in brief). (3)

Pītisahagato [V 2.0135] ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati [M 2.0120] …pe…. Sahajātādhipati – pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

States accompanied by zest and happiness are a condition for states accompanied by zest and states accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition: object predominance, co-nascent predominance… Co-nascent predominance: the predominance accompanied by zest and happiness is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by zest and for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the predominance condition. (4)

Anantarapaccayo

The immediately proximate condition

26. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 2.0168] paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (Iminā kāraṇena sabbesaṃ padānaṃ paccayoti dīpetabbo). Anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulomaṃ pītisahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

26. A state accompanied by zest is a condition for a state accompanied by zest by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by zest are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by zest by way of the immediately proximate condition. Conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for change-of-lineage by way of the immediately proximate condition. (By this method, it should be explained that it is a condition for all terms.) Conformity for emergence… change-of-lineage for the path… emergence for the path… the path for the fruit… the fruit for the fruit… conformity is a condition for the attainment of fruition accompanied by zest by way of the immediately proximate condition. (1)

Pītisahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatassa gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatassa vodānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by zest is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition—preceding aggregates accompanied by zest are a condition for subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. Conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for change-of-lineage accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. Conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for emergence accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. Conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for the attainment of fruition accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. (2)

Pītisahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagataṃ cuticittaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0169]. Pītisahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by zest is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition—the death consciousness accompanied by zest is a condition for the rebirth consciousness accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. The life-continuum accompanied by zest is a condition for adverting by way of the immediately proximate condition. The resultant mind-consciousness-element accompanied by zest is a condition for the functional mind-consciousness-element by way of the immediately proximate condition. The life-continuum accompanied by zest is a condition for the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition. A wholesome or unwholesome state accompanied by zest is a condition for emergence accompanied by equanimity by way of the immediately proximate condition… a functional state for emergence… a fruition state for emergence. (3)

Pītisahagato [V 2.0136] dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo[M 2.0121]. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by zest is a condition for a state accompanied by zest and for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition—the preceding aggregates accompanied by zest are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by zest and accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. Conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for change-of-lineage accompanied by zest and accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition… and so on… conformity accompanied by zest is a condition for the attainment of fruition accompanied by zest and accompanied by happiness by way of the immediately proximate condition. (4)

27. Sukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatassa gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… sukhasahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by happiness—the preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness. The conformity accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the change-of-lineage accompanied by happiness…pe… the conformity accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by happiness. (1)

Sukhasahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… sukhasahagataṃ anulomaṃ pītisahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by joy—the preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy…pe… the conformity accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by joy. (2)

Sukhasahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 2.0170] paccayo – sukhasahagataṃ cuticittaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ vipākamanodhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagatā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo sukhasahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by equanimity—the death consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the rebirth consciousness accompanied by equanimity. The life-continuum accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for adverting. The body-consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the resultant mind-element. The resultant mind-consciousness-element accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the functional mind-consciousness-element. The life-continuum accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity. The wholesome or unwholesome state accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for emergence accompanied by equanimity… the functional state for emergence… the fruition state for emergence. (3)

Sukhasahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… sukhasahagataṃ anulomaṃ pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by joy and a state accompanied by happiness—the preceding aggregates accompanied by happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and by happiness…pe… the conformity accompanied by happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by joy and by happiness. (4)

28. Upekkhāsahagato [M 2.0122][V 2.0137] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… āvajjanā pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Upekkhāsahagataṃ anulomaṃ upekkhāsahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upekkhāsahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by equanimity—preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity are a condition by way of immediate proximity for subsequent aggregates accompanied by equanimity…pe… adverting is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the five consciousnesses. Conformity accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by equanimity… for one rising from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by equanimity. (1)

Upekkhāsahagato [T 2.0171] dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – upekkhāsahagataṃ cuticittaṃ pītisahagatassa upapatticittassa…pe… āvajjanā pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… vipākamanodhātu pītisahagatāya vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ pītisahagatassa bhavaṅgassa…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalākusalaṃ pītisahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pītisahagatāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by joy—the death consciousness accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the rebirth consciousness accompanied by joy…pe… adverting is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the aggregates accompanied by joy…pe… the resultant mind-element is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the resultant mind-consciousness-element accompanied by joy…pe… the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the life-continuum accompanied by joy…pe… the wholesome or unwholesome state accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for emergence accompanied by joy… the functional state for emergence… the fruition state for emergence… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by joy. (2)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by happiness…pe… and for a state accompanied by both joy and happiness. (4)

(Tāniyeva ca gamanāni niyāmetabbāni.)

(Those same procedures should be determined.)

29. Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca cuticittaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa upapatticittassa…pe… pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya…pe… pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā…pe… pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca bhavaṅgaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa bhavaṅgassa…pe… pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca kusalākusalaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

29. States accompanied by joy and happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by joy…pe… for a state accompanied by happiness…pe… for a state accompanied by equanimity—the death consciousness accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the rebirth consciousness accompanied by equanimity…pe… the life-continuum accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for adverting…pe… the resultant mind-consciousness-element accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the functional mind-consciousness-element…pe… the life-continuum accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the life-continuum accompanied by equanimity…pe… the wholesome or unwholesome state accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for emergence accompanied by equanimity… a functional state for emergence… a fruition state for emergence. (3)

Pītisahagato [T 2.0172][V 2.0138] ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā [M 2.0123] ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ…pe… pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca anulomaṃ pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States accompanied by joy and happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for a state accompanied by joy and by happiness—the preceding aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness are a condition by way of immediate proximity for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and by happiness…pe… the conformity accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition by way of immediate proximity for the attainment of fruition accompanied by joy and by happiness. (4)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity condition

30. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarapaccayasadisaṃ).

30. A state accompanied by joy is a condition by way of contiguity for a state accompanied by joy (similar to the immediate proximity condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Conascence condition

31. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… (paṭiccasadisaṃ sahajāte dasa pañhā).

31. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate accompanied by joy is a condition for the three aggregates by way of co-nascence condition… and so on… two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition… and so on. (Ten questions are to be formulated, similar to the Dependent Origination section).

Aññamañña-nissayapaccayā

Mutuality and Support Conditions

32. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo (dasa pañhā kātabbā).

32. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition. (Ten questions are to be formulated).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

33. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, pītisahagataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagataṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ [T 2.0173][V 2.0139] upanissāya pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati…pe… mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagataṃ rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, pītisahagataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Pītisahagatena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati[M 2.0124], pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā pītisahagatāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by joy, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy, undertakes precepts, observes the Uposatha, generates jhāna accompanied by joy, generates insight, generates the path, generates attainment, harbors conceit, adopts a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy… learning… generosity… wisdom, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy, undertakes precepts, and so on… harbors conceit, adopts a view. Relying on lust accompanied by joy… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy, undertakes precepts, observes the Uposatha, generates jhāna accompanied by joy, and so on… generates attainment. With a mind accompanied by joy, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, engages in divisive speech, indulges in idle chatter, breaks into houses, plunders, commits burglary, lies in wait on the roads, goes to another’s wife, destroys villages, destroys towns. Faith accompanied by joy… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Pītisahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagataṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sukhasahagatena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by joy, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness, and so on… generates attainment, harbors conceit, adopts a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness, and so on… generates attainment. With a mind accompanied by happiness, one takes what is not given, and so on… destroys towns. Faith accompanied by joy, and so on… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by happiness, and so on… aspiration, and for body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Pītisahagato [T 2.0174] dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā upekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by joy, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity, and so on… generates higher knowledge, generates attainment, harbors conceit, adopts a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy, and so on… aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity, and so on… destroys towns. Faith accompanied by joy, and so on… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by equanimity, and so on… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Pītisahagato [V 2.0140] dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā [M 2.0125] saddhā…pe… patthanā pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by joy, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness, and so on… adopts a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy, and so on… aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness, and so on… destroys towns. Faith accompanied by joy, and so on… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy and for faith accompanied by happiness, and so on… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (4)

34. Sukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – sukhasahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sukhasahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ sukhasahagataṃ [T 2.0175] kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Sukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ sukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness, and so on… adopts a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by happiness… and so on… aspiration, and on body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness, and so on… destroys towns. Faith accompanied by happiness… and so on… aspiration, and body-consciousness accompanied by happiness are a condition for faith accompanied by happiness… and so on… aspiration, and for body-consciousness accompanied by happiness by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Sukhasahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition for faith accompanied by joy... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Sukhasahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Sukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity... generates higher knowledge... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition for faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Sukhasahagato [T 2.0176] dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [M 2.0126] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – sukhasahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sukhasahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ [V 2.0141] upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Sukhasahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration, body-consciousness accompanied by happiness is a condition for faith accompanied by joy and for faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (4)

35. Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… abhiññaṃ uppādeti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Upekkhāsahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Upekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā upekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by equanimity, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity... generates higher knowledge... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by equanimity... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena [T 2.0177] cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti.
