Upekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā pītisahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by equanimity, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Upekkhāsahagato [V 2.0142] dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Upekkhāsahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Upekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by equanimity, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by happiness... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration, and for body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Upekkhāsahagato [M 2.0127] dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – upekkhāsahagataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Upekkhāsahagataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Upekkhāsahagatā saddhā…pe… patthanā pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediacy decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith accompanied by equanimity, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness... adopts a view. Relying on virtue... aspiration, one gives alms with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness... commits a town-massacre. Faith accompanied by equanimity... aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy and for faith accompanied by happiness... aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (4)

36. Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa [T 2.0178] upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca saddhā…pe… patthanā pītisahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

36. States accompanied by joy and states accompanied by happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith accompanied by joy and happiness, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy… grasps a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by joy… commits a town massacre. Faith accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā sukhasahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya sukhasahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā [V 2.0143] ca saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhasahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States accompanied by joy and states accompanied by happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith accompanied by joy and happiness, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by happiness… grasps a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by happiness… commits a town massacre. Faith accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by happiness… aspiration, and for body-consciousness accompanied by happiness, by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca saddhaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti [M 2.0128] …pe… abhiññaṃ uppādeti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca sīlaṃ…pe… [T 2.0179] patthanaṃ upanissāya upekkhāsahagatena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca saddhā…pe… patthanā upekkhāsahagatāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States accompanied by joy and states accompanied by happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith accompanied by joy and happiness, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by equanimity… produces supernormal knowledge… grasps a view. Relying on virtue accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration, one gives a gift with a mind accompanied by equanimity… commits a town massacre. Faith accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by equanimity… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca saddhaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca jhānaṃ uppādeti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Pītisahagatena ca sukhasahagatena ca cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca saddhā…pe… patthanā pītisahagatāya ca sukhasahagatāya ca saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

States accompanied by joy and states accompanied by happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by joy and happiness by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support—relying on faith accompanied by joy and happiness, with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness, one gives a gift, undertakes precepts, performs the observance-day duties. One produces jhāna accompanied by joy and happiness, produces insight, produces the path, produces attainment, cultivates conceit, grasps a view. Relying on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration accompanied by joy and happiness, with a mind accompanied by joy and happiness, one gives a gift, undertakes precepts, performs the observance-day duties. One produces jhāna accompanied by joy and happiness… produces attainment. With a mind accompanied by joy and happiness, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks slanderously, speaks frivolously, breaks into houses, plunders, commits burglary, lies in wait on highways, goes to another's wife, commits village massacre, commits town massacre. Faith accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration is a condition for faith accompanied by joy and happiness… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (4)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

37. Pītisahagato [V 2.0144] dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena [T 2.0180] paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ pītisahagatassa gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy by way of repetition condition. The anuloma accompanied by joy is a condition for the gotrabhū accompanied by joy… the anuloma for the vodāna… the gotrabhū for the path… the vodāna for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Pītisahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ [M 2.0129] khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatassa gotrabhussa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ anulomaṃ sukhasahagatassa vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Pītisahagataṃ gotrabhu sukhasahagatassa maggassa… pītisahagataṃ vodānaṃ sukhasahagatassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of repetition condition. The anuloma accompanied by joy is a condition for the gotrabhū accompanied by happiness by way of repetition condition. The anuloma accompanied by joy is a condition for the vodāna accompanied by happiness by way of repetition condition. The gotrabhū accompanied by joy is a condition for the path accompanied by happiness… the vodāna accompanied by joy is a condition for the path accompanied by happiness by way of repetition condition. (2)

Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca āsevanapaccayena paccayo…pe… pītisahagataṃ vodānaṃ pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and happiness by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates accompanied by joy are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness by way of repetition condition… the vodāna accompanied by joy is a condition for the path accompanied by joy and happiness by way of repetition condition. (3)

38. Sukhasahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ. Pītinayaṃ passitvā kātabbaṃ).

38. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness… for a state accompanied by joy… for a state accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the repetition condition. (Abbreviated. This should be done by referring to the section on joy.)

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena [T 2.0181] paccayo – purimā purimā upekkhāsahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ vodānaṃ upekkhāsahagatassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the repetition condition. The preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by equanimity… the purification accompanied by equanimity is a condition for the path accompanied by equanimity by way of the repetition condition. (1)

39. Pītisahagato ca sukhasahagato ca dhammā pītisahagatassa dhammassa…pe… sukhasahagatassa [V 2.0145] dhammassa…pe… pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā pītisahagatā ca sukhasahagatā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo…pe… pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca vodānaṃ pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

39. States accompanied by joy and happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by joy… for a state accompanied by happiness… for a state accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the repetition condition. The preceding aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness are a condition for the subsequent aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the repetition condition… the purification accompanied by joy and happiness is a condition for the path accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the repetition condition. (3)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

40. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā nānākhaṇikā (syā. ka.). Sahajātā – pītisahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pītisahagatā [M 2.0130] cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – pītisahagatā cetanā vipākānaṃ pītisahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of the kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments. Co-nascent: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. At different moments: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the resultant aggregates accompanied by joy by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Pītisahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – pītisahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pītisahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena [T 2.0182] paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – pītisahagatā cetanā vipākānaṃ sukhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of the kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments. Co-nascent: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the kamma condition. At different moments: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the resultant aggregates accompanied by happiness by way of the kamma condition. (2)

Pītisahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – pītisahagatā cetanā vipākānaṃ upekkhāsahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the kamma condition. At different moments: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the resultant aggregates accompanied by equanimity by way of the kamma condition. (3)

Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa ca sukhasahagatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – pītisahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe [V 2.0146] …pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – pītisahagatā cetanā vipākānaṃ pītisahagatānañca sukhasahagatānañca khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments. Co-nascent: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the associated aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… At different moments: Volition accompanied by joy is a condition for the resultant aggregates accompanied by joy and happiness by way of the kamma condition. (4)

41. A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness (the four enumerations should be done by referring to the preceding method).

42. Upekkhāsahagato dhammo upekkhāsahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā…pe….

42. A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of the kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments….

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – upekkhāsahagatā cetanā…pe….

Upekkhāsahagato dhammo sukhasahagatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – upekkhāsahagatā cetanā…pe….

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

43. Pītisahagato dhammo pītisahagatassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – pītisahagato vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe pītisahagato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe….

43. A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of the result condition. One resultant aggregate accompanied by joy is a condition for the three aggregates by way of the result condition… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate accompanied by joy is a condition for the three aggregates… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates….

(Yathā [V 2.0147] paṭiccavāre hetupaccaye evaṃ vitthāretabbā dasa pañhā.)

As in the section on root condition in the chapter on dependence, the ten questions should be elaborated.

A state accompanied by joy is a condition for a state accompanied by joy by way of the nutriment condition… by way of the faculty condition… by way of the jhāna condition… by way of the path condition… by way of the association condition… by way of the presence condition… (The ten questions should be elaborated.) by way of the absence condition… by way of the disappearance condition… (Absence and disappearance are similar to immediacy.) by way of the non-disappearance condition.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Dassanena [T 2.0188][M 2.0135][V 2.0152] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

1. Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing arises through root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates [arise]… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise]. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises through root condition: dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, mind-produced materiality arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, phenomena to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise through root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality [arise]… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced materiality [arise]. (3)

2. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [V 2.0153] – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

2. Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, a phenomenon to be abandoned by development arises through root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development, three aggregates [arise]… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise]. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises through root condition: dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by development, mind-produced materiality arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 2.0189] hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, phenomena to be abandoned by development and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise through root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality [arise]… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced materiality [arise]. (3)

3. 15. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme nava, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava (imāni padāni anumajjantena anulomaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

15. By root condition, nine; by object condition, three; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, three; by immediately proximate condition, three; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, three; by pre-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, three; by kamma condition, nine; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, nine; by path condition, nine; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, three; by disappearance condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, nine (These terms should be counted in the forward order).

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

19. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… (paripuṇṇaṃ hetupaccayasadisaṃ) naanantarapaccayā… [T 2.0196] nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

19. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of predominance condition… (The full text is as for the root condition) not by way of contiguity condition… not by way of immediately proximate condition… not by way of reciprocity condition… not by way of strong dependence condition.

Napurejātapaccayo

Non-Pre-nascence Condition.

20. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

20. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of pre-nascence condition. In the immaterial realm, three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing… etc. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of pre-nascence condition. Mind-originated materiality arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing. (2)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0160] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo…pe… arūpe bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A state to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, not by way of pre-nascence condition… In the immaterial realm, three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development… two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo…pe… bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, not by way of pre-nascence condition… Mind-originated materiality arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by development. (2)

21. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ [M 2.0142] khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

21. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the pre-nascence condition. In the immaterial realm, three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates; mind-originated materiality arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. At the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise dependent on two aggregates; the base arises dependent on aggregates, aggregates arise dependent on the base; three great elements arise dependent on one great element… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings, one great element… (1)

Dassanena [T 2.0197] pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo…pe… dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… Mind-originated materiality arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by development and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the pre-nascence condition. Mind-originated materiality arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements. (1)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Non-post-nascence condition, etc.

22. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

22. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the post-nascence condition… not by way of the repetition condition.

Nakammapaccayo

Non-kamma condition.

23. Dassanena [V 2.0161] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca dassanena pahātabbā cetanā. (1)

23. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the kamma condition. Volition to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā. (1)

A state to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, not by way of the kamma condition. Volition to be abandoned by development arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by development. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the kamma condition. Volition to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings, one great element… (1)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-resultance condition.

24. Dassanena [M 2.0143] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (naadhipatipaccayasadisaṃ, paṭisandhi natthi).

24. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the resultance condition (similar to the non-predominance condition; rebirth-linking is not present).

Naāhārapaccayo

Non-nutriment condition.

25. Nevadassanena [T 2.0198] nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

25. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the nutriment condition. External… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings, one great element….

Naindriyapaccayo

Non-faculty condition.

26. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhāna… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ.

26. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… not by way of the faculty condition—external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… one great element… in non-percipient beings, the material life faculty arises dependent on the great elements.

Najhānapaccayo

Non-jhāna condition.

27. Nevadassanena [V 2.0162] nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

27. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… not by way of the jhāna condition—three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate accompanied by the five consciousnesses… two aggregates… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings, one great element… Temperature-originated, in non-percipient beings, one great element…

Namaggapaccayo

Non-path condition.

28. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ…pe… namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

28. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… not by way of the path condition—a rootless state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… one great element… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings, one great element…

Nasampayuttapaccayo

Non-association condition.

29. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nasampayuttapaccayā (naārammaṇasadisaṃ).

29. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the association condition (similar to the non-object condition).

Navippayuttapaccayo

Non-dissociation condition.

30. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ…pe… navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

30. A state to be abandoned by seeing… not by way of the dissociation condition—in the formless realm, dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing… (1)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0144] pahātabbaṃ…pe… navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (1)

A state to be abandoned by development… not by way of the dissociation condition—in the formless realm, one aggregate to be abandoned by development… (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ…pe… navippayuttapaccayā [T 2.0199] – arūpe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [V 2.0163] pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… not by way of the dissociation condition—in the formless realm, three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings… (1)

Nonatthi-novigatapaccayā

Non-absence and Non-disappearance Conditions.

31. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya…pe… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā (naārammaṇasadisaṃ).

31. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing… not by way of the absence condition… not by way of the disappearance condition (similar to the non-object condition).

36. Dassanena [V 2.0165] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.

36. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition… three.

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya… tīṇi.

A state to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by development… three.

37. Nevadassanena [M 2.0146] nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 2.0201] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā. (1)

37. A state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise… dependent on the aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, the aggregates arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. Dependent on the base, the aggregates not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā. (2)

A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on the base, the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā. (3)

A state to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on the base, the aggregates to be abandoned by development arise. (3)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [V 2.0166] pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

A state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on the base, the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (4)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

A state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on the base, the aggregates to be abandoned by development arise; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (5)

38. Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 2.0202] – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

38. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [M 2.0147] – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises by way of root condition. Dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise; dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (3)

39. Bhāvanāya pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca…pe…. (1)

39. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base…. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises by way of root condition. Dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0167] pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 2.0203] hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca…pe… bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base… dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

40. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

40. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… two aggregates…. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development, three aggregates arise…. (1)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0148] nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, three aggregates arise… two aggregates…. At the moment of relinking: dependent on one aggregate not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, three aggregates arise… two aggregates… dependent on the base, the aggregates arise; dependent on the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… dependent on the body-base, body-consciousness arises; dependent on the base, aggregates not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition. Dependent on the base, aggregates to be abandoned by seeing arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā [T 2.0204] – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of object condition. Dependent on the base, aggregates to be abandoned by development arise. (3)

41. Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena [V 2.0168] pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā…pe…. (1)

41. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base…. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development and a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of object condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development and the base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Adhipatipaccayādi

Dominance Condition, and so on

42. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā… (paripuṇṇaṃ, paṭisandhi natthi) anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā (ārammaṇasadisaṃ).

42. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of dominance condition… (complete, there is no relinking); by way of immediate condition… by way of contiguous condition (similar to the object condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

Dassanena [M 2.0149] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ… tīṇi.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of co-nascence condition. Dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing… (three cases).

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development… (three cases).

43. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ [T 2.0205] ekaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā.

43. Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of co-nascence condition. One aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates… at the moment of relinking… the aggregates are a condition for the base; the base is a condition for the aggregates; one great element is a condition for three great elements… the great elements are a condition for… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness; the base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development.

Nevadassanena [V 2.0169] nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā (avasesā hetupaccayasadisā).

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of co-nascence condition (the remainder is similar to the root condition).

Aññamaññapaccayādi

Mutuality Condition, etc.

44. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi)… āsevanapaccayā… (paṭisandhi natthi, vipākañca) kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

44. Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… by way of strong-support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition (relinking is absent)… by way of repetition condition (relinking and resultant are absent)… by way of kamma condition… by way of resultant condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of absorption condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of dissociation condition… by way of presence condition… by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

45. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā sattarasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye satta, purejāte satta, āsevane [M 2.0150] satta, kamme sattarasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre sattarasa, indriye sattarasa, jhāne sattarasa, magge sattarasa, sampayutte satta, vippayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

45. By root condition, seventeen; by object condition, seven; by dominance condition, seventeen; by contiguity condition, seven; by immediate contiguity condition, seven; by co-nascence condition, seventeen; by mutuality condition, seven; by support condition, seventeen; by strong-support condition, seven; by pre-nascence condition, seven; by repetition condition, seven; by kamma condition, seventeen; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, seventeen; by faculty condition, seventeen; by absorption condition, seventeen; by path condition, seventeen; by association condition, seven; by dissociation condition, seventeen; by presence condition, seventeen; by absence condition, seven; by disappearance condition, seven; by non-disappearance condition, seventeen (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditions and their Negations

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Exposition Section

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

46. Dassanena [T 2.0206][V 2.0170] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

46. Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of non-root condition: the aggregates associated with doubt are a condition for delusion associated with doubt. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of non-root condition—the aggregates associated with restlessness are a condition for delusion associated with restlessness. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā. (1)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-root condition—one rootless aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… at the moment of rootless relinking… the aggregates are a condition for the base, the base is a condition for the aggregates; one great element… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness, the base is a condition for rootless aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of non-root condition—the base is a condition for delusion associated with doubt. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (3)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of non-root condition—the base is a condition for delusion associated with restlessness. (3)

47. Dassanena [M 2.0151] pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca [T 2.0207] dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

47. Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of non-root condition—the aggregates associated with doubt and the base are conditions for delusion associated with doubt. (1)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0171] pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by development and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises by way of non-root condition—the aggregates associated with restlessness and the base are conditions for delusion associated with restlessness. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

48. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

48. Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-object condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for mind-originated materiality. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned by development, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-object condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by development are a condition for mind-originated materiality. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paccayā vatthu; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-object condition—the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for mind-originated materiality. At the moment of relinking, the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for kamma-originated materiality; the aggregates are a condition for the base; one great element is a condition for… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings…. (1)

49. Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca [T 2.0208] dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

49. A state to be abandoned by seeing arises, conditioned by a state to be abandoned by seeing and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-object condition—conditioned by the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises, conditioned by a state to be abandoned by development and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-object condition—conditioned by the aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Not by way of the dominance condition, etc.

50. Dassanena [M 2.0152] pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā [V 2.0172] (sahajātasadisaṃ)… naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

50. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the dominance condition (similar to conascence)… not by way of the contiguity condition… not by way of the immediate contiguity condition… not by way of the mutuality condition… not by way of the strong dependence condition.

Napurejātapaccayo

Not by way of the prenascence condition.

51. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe dassanena pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe…. (1)

51. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing… and so on. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the prenascence condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by development… and so on. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā [T 2.0209] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by development, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

52. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

52. A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates… and so on. Dependent on aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… dependent on aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises; dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; one great primary element… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated, in non-percipient beings… and so on. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises, not by way of the prenascence condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0153][V 2.0173] pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises, not by way of the prenascence condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Not by way of the post-nascence condition, etc.

53. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

Not by way of the kamma condition.

54. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe paccayā dassanena pahātabbā cetanā. (1)

54. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the kamma condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, volition to be abandoned by seeing arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… nakammapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned by development, not by way of the kamma condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by development, volition to be abandoned by development arises. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… nakammapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [T 2.0210] pahātabbā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the kamma condition—dependent on aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, volition to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… and so on. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbā cetanā. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the kamma condition—dependent on the base, volition to be abandoned by seeing arises. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the kamma condition—dependent on the base, volition to be abandoned by development arises. (3)

55. Dassanena pahātabbañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena [V 2.0174] pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbe khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dassanena pahātabbā cetanā. (1)
