Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa…pe… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a state not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of root condition: roots not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development are a condition for their associated aggregates and mind-originated material forms by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, roots not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development are a condition for their associated aggregates and kamma-produced material forms by way of root condition. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

71. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhiṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo [T 2.0217] rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati[V 2.0181]. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, vicikicchaṃ ārabbha vicikicchā uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati. (1)

71. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of object condition: one delights in and relishes greed to be abandoned by seeing; taking that as object, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises. Displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. One delights in and relishes wrong view; taking that as object, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises. Displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. Taking skeptical doubt as object, skeptical doubt arises, wrong view arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. Taking displeasure to be abandoned by seeing as object, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā dassanena pahātabbe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Dassanena pahātabbe khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Cetopariyañāṇena dassanena pahātabbacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Dassanena pahātabbā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition: The noble ones reflect on the defilements that have been abandoned by seeing; they know the defilements previously accumulated. They contemplate the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self. By the knowledge of the minds of others, they know the mind of one endowed with a mind to be abandoned by seeing. The aggregates to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for the knowledge of the minds of others, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting of mind, by way of object condition. (2)

72. Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati[M 2.0160]. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ ārabbha uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. (1)

72. A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of object condition: one delights in and relishes greed to be abandoned by development; taking that as object, greed to be abandoned by development arises, restlessness arises. Displeasure to be abandoned by development arises. Taking restlessness as object, restlessness arises. Displeasure to be abandoned by development arises. Taking displeasure to be abandoned by development as object, displeasure to be abandoned by development arises, restlessness arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya [T 2.0218] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Uddhaccaṃ ārabbha diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of object condition: one delights in and relishes greed to be abandoned by development; taking that as object, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. Taking restlessness as object, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. Taking displeasure to be abandoned by development as object, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā bhāvanāya pahātabbe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Bhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena bhāvanāya pahātabbacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[V 2.0182], yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition: The noble ones reflect on the defilements that have been abandoned by development, reflect on the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements previously accumulated. They contemplate the aggregates to be abandoned by development as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self. By the knowledge of the minds of others, they know the mind of one endowed with a mind to be abandoned by development. The aggregates to be abandoned by development are a condition for the knowledge of the minds of others, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting of mind, by way of object condition. (3)

73. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā [T 2.0219] maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti[M 2.0161], ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A phenomenon not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition: Having given a donation, undertaken the precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on that; one reflects on past good deeds; emerging from jhāna, one reflects on the jhāna. The noble ones, emerging from the path, reflect on the path, reflect on the fruit, reflect on Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, the path, the fruit, and adverting of mind by way of object condition. One contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; the ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the mind-base… one contemplates the aggregates not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear faculty one hears sounds; by the knowledge of the minds of others, they know the mind of one endowed with a mind not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. The sphere of infinite space is a condition for the sphere of infinite consciousness by way of object condition… the sphere of nothingness for the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition… the form sphere is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of object condition… the tangible sphere for body-consciousness by way of object condition… the aggregates not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for the knowledge of psychic potency, the knowledge of the minds of others, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting of mind, by way of object condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni assādeti abhinandati…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha [T 2.0220] dassanena pahātabbo rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati…pe… sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha [V 2.0183] dassanena pahātabbo rāgo…pe… diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of object-condition: Having given a donation, undertaken the precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one delights in and relishes that; with reference to that, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, skeptical doubt arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. One delights in and relishes past good deeds… Having emerged from jhāna, one delights in and relishes that jhāna; with reference to that, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises… wrong view… skeptical doubt… When the jhāna has declined, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises for one who feels remorse. One delights in and relishes the eye… ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the mind-base… one delights in and relishes the aggregates not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; with reference to that, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises… wrong view… skeptical doubt… displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe assādeti…pe… taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. (3)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of object-condition: Having given a donation, undertaken the precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one delights in and relishes that; with reference to that, greed to be abandoned by development arises, restlessness arises, displeasure to be abandoned by development arises. Past good deeds… having emerged from jhāna… the eye… the mind-base… one delights in and relishes the aggregates not to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… with reference to that, greed to be abandoned by development arises, restlessness arises, displeasure to be abandoned by development arises. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

74. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati [M 2.0162] – dassanena pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati [T 2.0221] – dassanena pahātabbādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of dominance-condition—object-dominance, conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: Holding greed to be abandoned by seeing as important, one delights in and relishes it; holding that as important, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. Holding wrong view as important, one delights in and relishes it; holding that as important, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance-condition. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – dassanena pahātabbādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of dominance-condition. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance-condition. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – dassanena pahātabbādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of dominance-condition. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance-condition. (3)

75. Bhāvanāya [V 2.0184] pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – bhāvanāya pahātabbādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of dominance-condition—object-dominance, conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: Holding greed to be abandoned by development as important, one delights in and relishes it; holding that as important, greed to be abandoned by development arises. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by development is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance-condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of dominance-condition. Object-dominance: Holding greed to be abandoned by development as important, one delights in and relishes it; holding that as important, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa [T 2.0222] dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – bhāvanāya pahātabbādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of dominance-condition. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by development is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance-condition. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – bhāvanāya pahātabbādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development and for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of dominance-condition. Conascent-dominance: A dominant factor to be abandoned by development is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance-condition. (4)

76. Nevadassanena [M 2.0163] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

76. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of the dominance condition—object-dominance, conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken virtue, performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that, holding it as important; having formerly well-performed deeds [...]; having emerged from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna, holding it as important; having emerged from the noble path, noble ones reflect upon the path, holding it as important; they reflect upon the fruit, holding it as important; they reflect upon Nibbāna, holding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for the change-of-lineage, purification, path, and fruit by way of the dominance condition. Conascent-dominance: a dominant state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Nevadassanena [V 2.0185] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti [T 2.0223] abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a state to be abandoned by seeing by way of the dominance condition. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken virtue, performed the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in that, holding it as important; holding that as important, lust to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. Holding formerly well-performed deeds as important [...]; having emerged from jhāna, holding jhāna as important [...]; the eye [...]; the base [...]; holding the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development as important, one savors and delights in them; holding them as important, lust to be abandoned by seeing arises, and wrong view arises. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati. Pubbe…pe… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati. (3)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a state to be abandoned by development by way of the dominance condition. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken virtue, performed the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in that, holding it as important; holding that as important, lust to be abandoned by development arises. Formerly [...]; holding the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development as important, one savors and delights in them; holding them as important, lust to be abandoned by development arises. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

The Immediate Condition.

77. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo.

77. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of the immediate condition. The preceding aggregates to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for the succeeding aggregates to be abandoned by seeing by way of the immediate condition.

Dassanena [M 2.0164] pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of the immediate condition. The aggregates to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for emergence by way of the immediate condition. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ [T 2.0224] pacchimānaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of the immediate condition. The preceding aggregates to be abandoned by development are a condition for the succeeding aggregates to be abandoned by development by way of the immediate condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0186] pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of the immediate condition. The aggregates to be abandoned by development are a condition for emergence by way of the immediate condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of the immediate condition. The preceding aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for the succeeding aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of the immediate condition. Conformity to the change-of-lineage… conformity to the purification… change-of-lineage to the path… purification to the path… the path to the fruit… the fruit to the fruit… conformity to fruition-attainment… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of the immediate condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa…pe… āvajjanā dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of the immediate condition… Adverting is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing by way of the immediate condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of the immediate condition. Adverting is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by development by way of the immediate condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

The Immediate Contiguity Condition.

78. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa [T 2.0225] samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ).

78. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of the immediate contiguity condition (similar to the immediate condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

The Conascent Condition.

79. Dassanena [M 2.0165] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

79. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of the conascent condition… three.

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa… tīṇi.

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development [by way of conascent condition]… three.

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena [V 2.0187] paccayo – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of conascent condition. One aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of conascent condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… aggregates are a condition for the base by way of conascent condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates… one great element is a condition for the three great elements… the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Phenomena to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of conascent condition. The aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of conascent condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Phenomena to be abandoned by development and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of conascent condition. The aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of conascent condition. (1)

Aññamaññapaccayo

The Mutuality Condition

80. Dassanena [T 2.0226] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

80. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of mutuality condition. One aggregate to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for the three aggregates… (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa…pe… bhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of mutuality condition… One aggregate to be abandoned by development is a condition for the three aggregates… (1)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0166] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa…pe… nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of mutuality condition… One aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutuality condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for the three aggregates and the base by way of mutuality condition… two aggregates… aggregates are a condition for the base… the base is a condition for the aggregates… one great element is a condition for the three great elements by way of mutuality condition… for non-percipient beings… (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Support Condition

81. Dassanena [V 2.0188] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

81. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of support condition… three.

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa… tīṇi.

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of support condition… three.

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… [T 2.0227] vatthu…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of support condition: one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… aggregates are a condition for the base… the base is a condition for the aggregates… one great element… for non-percipient beings… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base… (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of support condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing by way of support condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of support condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by development by way of support condition. (3)

82. Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

82. Phenomena to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of support condition—one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of support condition… two aggregates… (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo [M 2.0167] – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of support condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. (2)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0189] pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

Phenomena to be abandoned by development and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of support condition—one aggregate to be abandoned by development and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of support condition… two aggregates… (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena [T 2.0228] paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Phenomena to be abandoned by development and phenomena to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of support condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by development and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of support condition. (2)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

83. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – dassanena pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dosaṃ… mohaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Dassanena pahātabbo rāgo… doso… moho… diṭṭhi… patthanā dassanena pahātabbassa rāgassa.. dosassa… mohassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on lust to be abandoned by seeing, one kills a living being, takes what is not given… and so on… splits the Saṅgha. Relying on hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing, one kills a living being… and so on… splits the Saṅgha. Lust… hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – dassanena pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Dassanena pahātabbaṃ dosaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Dassanena pahātabbo rāgo… doso… moho… diṭṭhi… patthanā saddhāya…pe… paññāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on lust to be abandoned by seeing, one gives a gift, undertakes precepts, observes the Uposatha… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Relying on hatred… and so on… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing, one gives a gift… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Lust… hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for faith… and so on… wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (2)

84. Bhāvanāya [M 2.0168] pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo[T 2.0229], pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – bhāvanāya [V 2.0190] pahātabbo rāgo… doso… moho… māno… patthanā bhāvanāya pahātabbassa rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

84. A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: lust to be abandoned by development… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration are a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration to be abandoned by development by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo… doso… moho… māno… patthanā dassanena pahātabbassa rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sakabhaṇḍe chandarāgo parabhaṇḍe chandarāgassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sakapariggahe chandarāgo parapariggahe chandarāgassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on lust to be abandoned by development, one kills a living being… and so on… splits the Saṅgha. Relying on hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration to be abandoned by development, one kills a living being… and so on… splits the Saṅgha. Lust to be abandoned by development… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration are a condition for lust to be abandoned by seeing… hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. Desire for one's own property is a condition for desire for others' property by way of decisive support condition. Attachment to one's own belongings is a condition for attachment to others' belongings by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo… doso… moho… māno… [T 2.0230] patthanā saddhāya…pe… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on lust to be abandoned by development, one gives a gift… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Relying on hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration to be abandoned by development, one gives a gift… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Lust to be abandoned by development… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration are a condition for faith… and so on… for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (3)

85. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ… sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo [M 2.0169]… paññā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… saddhāya…pe… paññāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

85. A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one gives a gift… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Relying on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… weather… food… lodging… one gives a gift… and so on… attains meditative absorption. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… weather… food… lodging… are a condition for faith… and so on… for wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Nevadassanena [V 2.0191] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ dassanena pahātabbassa rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one adopts a wrong view. Relying on virtue… and so on… lodging, one kills a living being… and so on… splits the Saṅgha. Faith… and so on… lodging are a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… wrong view… aspiration to be abandoned by seeing by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya [T 2.0231] mānaṃ jappeti. Sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti. Saddhā…pe… paññā… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbassa rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: relying on faith, one generates conceit. Relying on virtue… and so on… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… weather… food… lodging… one generates conceit. Faith… and so on… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… weather… food… lodging are a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… aspiration to be abandoned by development by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-arisen Condition

86. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

86. A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of pre-arising condition—object pre-arising, base pre-arising. Object pre-arising—one discerns the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; the ear… nose… tongue… body… visible forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangible objects… the heart-base…pe… With the divine eye, one sees a visible form; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound. The visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-arising condition. Base pre-arising—the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of pre-arising condition. (1)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0170] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā [V 2.0192] uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati…pe… [T 2.0232] vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of pre-arising condition—object pre-arising, base pre-arising. Object pre-arising—one relishes and delights in the eye; dependent on that, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises…pe… one relishes and delights in the heart-base; dependent on that, greed to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, displeasure to be abandoned by seeing arises. Base pre-arising—the base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing by way of pre-arising condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati… uddhaccaṃ uppajjati… bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, sotaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of pre-arising condition—object pre-arising, base pre-arising. Object pre-arising—one relishes and delights in the eye; dependent on that, greed to be abandoned by development arises… restlessness arises… displeasure to be abandoned by development arises, the ear…pe… the body… visible forms…pe… tangible objects…one relishes and delights in the heart-base; dependent on that, greed to be abandoned by development arises, restlessness arises, displeasure to be abandoned by development arises. Base pre-arising—the base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by development by way of pre-arising condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-arising condition

87. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

87. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of post-arising condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, arising subsequently, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-arising condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena [T 2.0233] paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of post-arising condition—the aggregates to be abandoned by development, arising subsequently, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-arising condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā [M 2.0171] nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of post-arising condition—the aggregates not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, arising subsequently, are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-arising condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition condition

88. Dassanena [V 2.0193] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā dassanena pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ…pe… āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

88. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of repetition condition—the preceding aggregates to be abandoned by seeing are a condition for the succeeding ones…pe… by way of repetition condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā bhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ…pe… āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of repetition condition—the preceding aggregates to be abandoned by development are a condition for the succeeding ones…pe… by way of repetition condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ…pe… āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development by way of repetition condition—the preceding aggregates not to be abandoned by seeing nor by development are a condition for the succeeding ones…pe… by way of repetition condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification… change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma condition

89. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of the kamma condition: the volition to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Dassanena [T 2.0234] pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – dassanena pahātabbā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – dassanena pahātabbā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of the kamma condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development—co-nascently and at different moments. Co-nascently: the volition to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of the kamma condition for mind-originated materiality. At different moments: the volition to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of the kamma condition for the resultant aggregates and for materiality produced by kamma. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of the kamma condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development—the volition to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of the kamma condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality. (3)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0172][V 2.0194] pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned by cultivation by way of kamma condition: volition to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of kamma condition: volition to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – bhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned by cultivation and for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of kamma condition: volition to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Nevadassanena [T 2.0235] nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of kamma condition—co-nascently and at different moments. Co-nascently: volition to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, volition to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-born materiality…pe…. At different moments: volition to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-born materiality by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

90. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo.

90. A state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of result condition. A resultant state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, one aggregate, is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of result condition…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of result condition.

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

91. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ) kabaḷīkāro… satta pañhā… indriyapaccayena [M 2.0173] paccayo… cakkhundriyañca…pe… rūpajīvitindriyañca [V 2.0195] …pe… satta pañhā jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo.

91. A state to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state to be abandoned by vision by way of nutriment condition (in brief). Edible food… seven questions… by way of faculty condition… the eye faculty…pe… the material life faculty…pe… seven questions… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

92. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0236]. Pacchājātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

92. A state to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state to be abandoned by vision by way of dissociation condition—co-nascently and post-nascently. Co-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned by vision are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned by vision are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (idampi dassanena sadisaṃ).

A state to be abandoned by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of dissociation condition—co-nascently and post-nascently (this is also similar to that of vision). (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of dissociation condition—co-nascently, pre-nascently, and post-nascently. Co-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation are a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of dissociation condition; the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition; the physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascently: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition…pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition…pe… the physical base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ vatthu dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned by vision by way of dissociation condition: the pre-nascent physical base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by vision by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa [T 2.0237] dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ vatthu bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation is a condition for a state to be abandoned by cultivation by way of dissociation condition: the pre-nascent physical base is a condition for the aggregates to be abandoned by cultivation by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

93. Dassanena [M 2.0174][V 2.0196] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

93. A state to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state to be abandoned by vision by way of presence condition: one aggregate to be abandoned by vision is a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state to be abandoned by vision is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of presence condition—co-nascently and post-nascently. Co-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned by vision are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. Post-nascently: the aggregates to be abandoned by vision are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – dassanena pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

A state to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned by seeing, and for a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. One aggregate to be abandoned by seeing is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena...two aggregates... (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa… tīṇi (dassanena sadisaṃ kātabbaṃ).

A state to be abandoned by development is a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned by development... (three, similar to those for seeing).

94. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā [T 2.0238] vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, sotaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbā [V 2.0197] khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena [M 2.0175] paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa…pe… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

94. A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development—as coexistent, as prenascent, as postnascent, as nutriment, as faculty. Coexistent: one aggregate to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the physical basis… the physical basis is a condition by way of presence for the aggregates… one great element… for non-percipient beings, one great element… Prenascent: one regards the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self… the ear… the body… forms… tangible objects… the physical basis as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; with the divine eye one sees forms, with the divine ear element one hears sounds, the form base is a condition by way of presence for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical basis is a condition by way of presence for the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. Postnascent: the aggregates to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition by way of presence for this prenascent body. Physical food is a condition by way of presence for this body… the life faculty of materiality is a condition by way of presence for materiality produced by kamma. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha dassanena pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, dassanena pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti…pe… vatthu dassanena pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned by seeing: the pre-existent eye is savored and cherished; dependent on that, lust to be abandoned by seeing arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, grief to be abandoned by seeing arises… the ear… the physical base is savored… the physical basis is a condition by way of presence for the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha bhāvanāya pahātabbo rāgo uppajjati[T 2.0239], uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati, sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati…pe… vatthu bhāvanāya pahātabbānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned by development: the pre-existent eye is savored and cherished; dependent on that, lust to be abandoned by development arises, agitation arises, grief to be abandoned by development arises… the ear… the physical base is savored and cherished… the physical basis is a condition by way of presence for the aggregates to be abandoned by development. (3)

95. Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – dassanena pahātabbo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca…pe…. (1)

95. A state to be abandoned by seeing and a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned by seeing—coexistent condition, prenascent condition. Coexistent condition: one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing and the physical base are a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base… (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – dassanena pahātabbā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

States to be abandoned by seeing and those to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition by way of presence for a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development: coexistent, postnascent, nutriment, and faculty. Coexistent: aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements are a condition by way of presence for mind-originated material phenomena. Postnascent: aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and physical food are a condition by way of presence for this body. Postnascent: aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the life faculty of materiality are a condition by way of presence for materiality produced by kamma. (2)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0198] pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbassa…pe… (dve pañhā kātabbā).

States to be abandoned by development, and states to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are a condition by way of presence for the state to be abandoned by development… (two questions should be asked).

Natthivigatāvigatapaccayā

Absence, Disappearance, and Non-Disappearance Conditions

96. Dassanena [M 2.0176] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa [T 2.0240] natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

96. A state to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a state to be abandoned by seeing by way of the absence condition… by way of the disappearance condition… by way of the non-disappearance condition.

1. The Forward Order
