97. Hetuyā satta, ārammaṇe aṭṭha, adhipatiyā dasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme satta, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre satta, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate terasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

97. By root condition, seven; by object condition, eight; by domination condition, ten; by contiguity condition, seven; by succession condition, seven; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by support condition, thirteen; by decisive support condition, eight; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by habituation condition, three; by kamma condition, seven; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, seven; by faculty condition, seven; by jhāna condition, seven; by path condition, seven; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, thirteen; by absence condition, seven; by disappearance condition, seven; by non-disappearance condition, thirteen (thus should it be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

The Forward Order.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Section on Opposites

98. Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

98. A state to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a state to be abandoned by seeing by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Dassanena [V 2.0199] pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence condition. (3)

99. Bhāvanāya [T 2.0241] pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

99. A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0177] pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development and for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence condition. (4)

100. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

100. A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo bhāvanāya pahātabbassa [T 2.0242] dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development is a condition for a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

101. Dassanena [V 2.0200] pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā dassanena pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

101. A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are related to a phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing by way of co-nascence, pre-nascence. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are related to a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā bhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are related to a phenomenon to be abandoned by development by way of co-nascence, pre-nascence. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbo ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbo ca dhammā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development are related to a phenomenon to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, faculty. (2)

102. Nahetuyā [M 2.0178] cuddasa, naārammaṇe cuddasa, naadhipatiyā cuddasa, naanantare cuddasa, nasamanantare cuddasa, nasahajāte dasa, naaññamaññe dasa, nanissaye dasa, naupanissaye cuddasa, napurejāte dvādasa, napacchājāte cuddasa, naāsevane cuddasa, nakamme cuddasa, navipāke cuddasa, naāhāre cuddasa, naindriye cuddasa, najhāne cuddasa, namagge cuddasa, nasampayutte dasa, navippayutte [T 2.0243] aṭṭha, noatthiyā aṭṭha, nonatthiyā cuddasa, novigate cuddasa, noavigate aṭṭha (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

102. Fourteen are not by root condition, fourteen not by object condition, fourteen not by domination condition, fourteen not by contiguity condition, fourteen not by succession condition, ten not by co-nascence condition, ten not by reciprocity condition, ten not by support condition, fourteen not by decisive support condition, twelve not by pre-nascence condition, fourteen not by post-nascence condition, fourteen not by habituation condition, fourteen not by kamma condition, fourteen not by result condition, fourteen not by nutriment condition, fourteen not by faculty condition, fourteen not by jhāna condition, fourteen not by path condition, ten not by association condition, eight not by dissociation condition, eight not by presence condition, fourteen not by absence condition, fourteen not by disappearance condition, eight not by non-disappearance condition (thus should it be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative

103. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare [V 2.0201] satta, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte satta, naāsevane satta, nakamme satta, navipāke satta, naāhāre satta, naindriye satta, najhāne satta, namagge satta, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

103. By root condition: seven are not by object condition, seven not by domination condition, seven not by contiguity condition, seven not by succession condition, three not by reciprocity condition, seven not by decisive support condition, seven not by pre-nascence condition, seven not by post-nascence condition, seven not by habituation condition, seven not by kamma condition, seven not by result condition, seven not by nutriment condition, seven not by faculty condition, seven not by jhāna condition, seven not by path condition, three not by association condition, three not by dissociation condition, seven not by absence condition, seven not by disappearance condition (thus should it be counted).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Affirmative-Negative

104. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe aṭṭha, adhipatiyā dasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme satta, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre satta, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate terasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ ).

104. Not by root condition: by object condition, eight; by domination condition, ten; by contiguity condition, seven; by succession condition, seven; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by support condition, thirteen; by decisive support condition, eight; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by habituation condition, three; by kamma condition, seven; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, seven; by faculty condition, seven; by jhāna condition, seven; by path condition, seven; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, thirteen; by absence condition, seven; by disappearance condition, seven; by non-disappearance condition, thirteen (thus should it be counted).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

Negative-Affirmative

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Dassanena [T 2.0244][M 2.0179][V 2.0202] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

1. Dependent on a phenomenon with roots to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon with roots to be abandoned by seeing arises by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with roots to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by root condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

States with roots to be abandoned by seeing and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by seeing, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

2. Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

2. A state with roots to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned by development, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0203] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by development, by root condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by development, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā [T 2.0245] uppajjanti hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

States with roots to be abandoned by development and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned by development, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

3. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā [M 2.0180] cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

3. A state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and kamma-born materiality arise…pe… two aggregates…pe… dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-born materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state with roots to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

A state with roots to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated aggregates arise. (3)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (4)

States with roots to be abandoned by seeing and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (4)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena [T 2.0246] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (5)

States with roots to be abandoned by development and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (5)

4. Dassanena [V 2.0204] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

4. A state with roots to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by seeing and a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt, and on delusion, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and on delusion, two aggregates arise. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by seeing and a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt, and on delusion, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Dassanena [M 2.0181] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

States with roots to be abandoned by seeing and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by seeing and a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt, and on delusion, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and on delusion, two aggregates…pe…. (3)

5. Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

5. A state with roots to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by development and a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by restlessness, and on delusion, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates and on delusion, two aggregates arise. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena [T 2.0247] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with roots to be abandoned by development and a state with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by development and on the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness, and on delusion, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe…. (3)

States with a root to be abandoned by development and states with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by development and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by root condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and delusion, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe…. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

6. Dassanena [V 2.0205] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

6. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, by object condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise... Dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, by object condition. Dependent on doubt-accompanied aggregates, doubt-accompanied delusion arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā ca moho ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā ca moho ca. (3)

States with a root to be abandoned by seeing and states with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, by object condition. Dependent on one doubt-accompanied aggregate, three aggregates and delusion arise... Dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and delusion arise. (3)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0182] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… tīṇi. (Dassanena sadisaṃ vibhajitabbaṃ.)

A state with a root to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by development, by object condition... three. (To be analyzed similarly to the case of seeing.)

7. Nevadassanena [T 2.0248] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

7. A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by object condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates arise... Dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking... Dependent on the physical base, aggregates arise. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by object condition. Dependent on doubt-accompanied delusion, associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

A state with a root to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by object condition. Dependent on restlessness-accompanied delusion, associated aggregates arise. (3)

8. Dassanena [V 2.0206] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

8. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by object condition. Dependent on one doubt-accompanied aggregate and delusion, three aggregates arise... Dependent on two aggregates and delusion, two aggregates arise. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by development and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by object condition. Dependent on one restlessness-accompanied aggregate and delusion, three aggregates arise... Dependent on two aggregates and delusion, two aggregates arise. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

9. Dassanena [T 2.0249] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā… tīṇi (hetusadisā).

9. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing, by dominance condition... three. (Similar to the root condition.)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… tīṇi (hetusadisā, adhipatiyā moho natthi).

A state with a root to be abandoned by development arises dependent on... three. (Similar to the root condition; there is no delusion by way of dominance.)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0183] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by dominance condition. Dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... Dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise... Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

10. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

10. A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by dominance condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena [V 2.0207] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by development and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by dominance condition. Dependent on the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by development and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Anantara-samanantarapaccayā

Immediately Proximate Condition; Contiguity Condition

11. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā. Samanantarapaccayā (ārammaṇasadisaṃ).

11. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing by the immediately proximate condition. By the contiguity condition (similar to the object condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

12. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ [T 2.0250] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

12. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing by co-nascence condition—dependent on one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca moho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing by way of co-nascence condition—in dependence on the aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by seeing, mind-produced materiality arises; in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion and mind-produced materiality arise. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā [M 2.0184] – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe…. (3)

Both a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a cause to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced materiality; one aggregate accompanied by doubt conditions three aggregates, delusion, and mind-produced materiality…pe…. (3)

13. Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

13. A state with a cause to be abandoned by development arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by development by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a cause to be abandoned by development conditions three aggregates…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati [V 2.0208] sahajātapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by development by way of co-nascence condition—in dependence on the aggregates with a cause to be abandoned by development, mind-produced materiality arises; in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness, delusion and mind-produced materiality arise. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā [T 2.0251] – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe…. (3)

Both a state with a cause to be abandoned by development and a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arise in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by development by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a cause to be abandoned by development conditions three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…pe… two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced materiality; one aggregate accompanied by restlessness conditions three aggregates, delusion, and mind-produced materiality…pe…. (3)

14. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ…pe…. (1)

14. A state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions three aggregates and mind-produced materiality…pe… two aggregates…pe… delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions mind-produced materiality. At the moment of re-linking…pe… the aggregates condition the base, the base conditions the aggregates; one great primary element conditions three great primary elements…pe… external… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… for non-percipient beings, one…pe…. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence condition—delusion accompanied by doubt conditions the associated aggregates. (2)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0185] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ. Hetusadisaṃ kātabbaṃ). (3)

A state with a cause to be abandoned by development arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by way of co-nascence condition (in brief. This should be done in the same way as for the Root Condition). (3)

Aññamaññapaccayādi

Mutuality Condition, etc.

15. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā, nissayapaccayā, upanissayapaccayā, purejātapaccayā, āsevanapaccayā, kammapaccayā, vipākapaccayā, āhārapaccayā, indriyapaccayā, jhānapaccayā, maggapaccayā, sampayuttapaccayā[T 2.0252][V 2.0209], vippayuttapaccayā, atthipaccayā, natthipaccayā, vigatapaccayā, avigatapaccayā.

15. A state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing arises in dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing by way of Mutuality Condition, Support Condition, Decisive Support Condition, Prenascence Condition, Repetition Condition, Kamma Condition, Result Condition, Nutriment Condition, Faculty Condition, Jhāna Condition, Path Condition, Association Condition, Dissociation Condition, Presence Condition, Absence Condition, Disappearance Condition, and Non-disappearance Condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

16. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe ekādasa, adhipatiyā nava, anantare ekādasa, samanantare ekādasa, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe ekādasa, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye ekādasa, purejāte ekādasa, āsevane ekādasa, kamme sattarasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre sattarasa, indriye sattarasa, jhāne sattarasa, magge sattarasa, sampayutte ekādasa, vippayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā ekādasa, vigate ekādasa, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

16. In Root Condition, seventeen; in Object, eleven; in Predominance, nine; in Immediacy, eleven; in Contiguity, eleven; in Co-nascence, seventeen; in Mutuality, eleven; in Support, seventeen; in Decisive Support, eleven; in Prenascence, eleven; in Repetition, eleven; in Kamma, seventeen; in Result, one; in Nutriment, seventeen; in Faculty, seventeen; in Jhāna, seventeen; in Path, seventeen; in Association, eleven; in Dissociation, seventeen; in Presence, seventeen; in Absence, eleven; in Disappearance, eleven; in Non-disappearance, seventeen (thus it should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Order of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

17. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

17. In dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by seeing, a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-root condition—in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0186][V 2.0210] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

In dependence on a state with a cause to be abandoned by development, a state with a cause to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of non-root condition—in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by restlessness arises. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ [T 2.0253] paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-root condition. For example, in dependence on one rootless aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… two aggregates; at the moment of rootless relinking… in dependence on the aggregates, the physical base arises; in dependence on the physical base, the aggregates arise; in dependence on one great element… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… in non-percipient beings… (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

18. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

18. A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of non-object condition. For example, mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by development, by way of non-object condition. For example, mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-object condition. For example, mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on delusion accompanied by doubt, and on delusion accompanied by restlessness. At the moment of relinking, kamma-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; in dependence on the aggregates, the physical base arises… in dependence on one great element… in non-percipient beings… (1)

19. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko [T 2.0254] dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena [V 2.0211] pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

19. A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-object condition. For example, mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion. (1)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0187] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by development and a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of non-object condition. For example, mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development and the great elements; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Non-Predominance Condition, etc.

20. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… (sahajātasadisaṃ) naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

20. A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of non-predominance condition… (similar to the conascence condition) by way of non-immediacy condition… by way of non-contiguity condition… by way of non-mutuality condition… by way of non-strong dependence condition.

Napurejātapaccayo

Non-prenascence Condition

21. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

21. A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, in dependence on one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing… (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho; dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, delusion accompanied by doubt arises in dependence on the aggregates accompanied by doubt; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā [T 2.0255] uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, three aggregates and delusion arise in dependence on one aggregate accompanied by doubt…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ… tīṇi (dassanena sadisaṃ).

A state whose root is to be abandoned by development… three (similar to that of seeing).

22. Nevadassanena [V 2.0212] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā, nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ [M 2.0188] mohaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

22. A state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, three aggregates arise in dependence on one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development…pe… two aggregates; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on delusion accompanied by doubt and on delusion accompanied by restlessness. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… for non-percipient beings…pe…. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises in dependence on a state whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, associated aggregates arise in dependence on delusion accompanied by doubt. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

A state whose root is to be abandoned by development arises in dependence on a state whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, associated aggregates arise in dependence on delusion accompanied by restlessness. (3)

23. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

23. A state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises in dependence on a state whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a state whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of the prenascence condition—in the formless realm, three aggregates arise in dependence on one aggregate accompanied by doubt and on delusion…pe…. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca [T 2.0256] nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of prenascence condition—dependent on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements, mind-originated form arises; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion, mind-originated form arises. (2)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā (imepi dve kātabbā).

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of prenascence condition (these two cases should also be elaborated).

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Non-Postnascence Condition, etc.

24. Dassanena [V 2.0213] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

24. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of postnascence condition… not by way of repetition condition.

Nakammapaccayo

Non-Kamma Condition

25. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā. (1)

25. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0189] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development, volition whose root is to be abandoned by development arises. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, volition whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises; external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature…and so on. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, associated volition arises. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [T 2.0257] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on delusion accompanied by restlessness, associated volition arises. (3)

26. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

26. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion, associated volition arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0214] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion, associated volition arises. (1)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-Result Condition

27. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi).

27. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of result condition (there is no rebirth-linking).

Naāhārapaccayādi

Non-Nutriment Condition, etc.

28. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… [M 2.0190] utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asaññasattānaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇaṃ…pe… (mahābhūtā kātabbā) namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… nasampayuttapaccayā.

28. A phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of nutriment condition—external… arising from temperature… for non-percipient beings… and so on; not by way of faculty condition—external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature, for non-percipient beings… and so on; dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty arises…; not by way of jhāna condition—the five consciousnesses… and so on (the great elements should be elaborated); not by way of path condition—a single rootless aggregate that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development… and so on… for non-percipient beings… and so on; not by way of association condition.

Navippayuttapaccayādi

Non-Dissociation Condition, etc.

29. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko [T 2.0258] dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

29. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… and so on. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [V 2.0215] pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arise dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate accompanied by doubt, three aggregates and delusion arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe bhāvanāya… tīṇi.

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, for that to be abandoned by development… three cases.

30. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

30. A phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development arises dependent on a phenomenon whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, not by way of dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate whose root is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by development, three aggregates arise… and so on… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; external… arising from nutriment… arising from temperature… for non-percipient beings… and so on. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ [T 2.0259] dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated aggregates arise. (3)

31. Dassanena [M 2.0191] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

31. Dependent on a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate and on delusion accompanied by doubt, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates arise. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

Dependent on a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate and on delusion accompanied by restlessness, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates arise… by way of non-absence condition… by way of non-disappearance condition.
