42. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe…. (1)

42. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise by way of the Dominance Condition – one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the base condition three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Dassanena [M 2.0197] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the Dominance Condition – the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the Dominance Condition – one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the base condition three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter. (3)

Bhāvanāya [T 2.0267] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… tīṇi… (dassanena sadisā) anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā.

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development to arise by way of the Dominance Condition – one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by development and the base condition three aggregates…pe… (three times, similar to seeing). By way of the Immediately Proximate Condition… By way of the Contiguity Condition.

Sahajātapaccayo

The Co-nascence Condition.

43. Dassanena [V 2.0223] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

43. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise by way of the Co-nascence Condition – one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates…pe…. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the Co-nascence Condition – the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing condition mind-originated matter; the aggregates accompanied by doubt condition the delusion accompanied by doubt and mind-originated matter. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates and mind-originated matter…etc. … one aggregate accompanied by doubt conditions three aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated matter…etc. … two aggregates…etc. (3)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0198] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ. Dassanena sadisā ).

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development conditions… (three cases, in brief, similar to the section on seeing).

44. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā [T 2.0268] – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā. (1)

44. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions three aggregates and mind-originated matter…etc. … the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions mind-originated matter. At the moment of rebirth…etc. … the aggregates condition the base, the base conditions the aggregates; one great element conditions three great elements…etc. … for non-percipient beings…etc. … the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness…etc. … the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the base conditions the aggregates with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā; vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—the base conditions the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing; the delusion accompanied by doubt conditions the associated aggregates. (2)

Nevadassanena [V 2.0224] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā; uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—the base conditions the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by development; the delusion accompanied by restlessness conditions the associated aggregates. (3)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca. (4)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—the base conditions the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing; the great elements condition mind-originated matter; the delusion accompanied by doubt conditions the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter; the base conditions the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion. (4)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ [T 2.0269] paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ [M 2.0199] paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca. (5)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—the base conditions the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by development; the great elements condition mind-originated matter; the delusion accompanied by restlessness conditions the associated aggregates and mind-originated matter; the base conditions the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion. (5)

45. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

45. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the base condition three aggregates…etc. … one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion condition three aggregates…etc. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion condition mind-originated matter; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and the base condition the delusion accompanied by doubt. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena [V 2.0225] pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā; cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca [T 2.0270] vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā moho ca. (3)

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition—one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the base condition three aggregates…etc.; two aggregates…etc.; the aggregates with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter; one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion condition three aggregates and mind-originated matter…etc.; two aggregates…etc.; one aggregate accompanied by doubt and the base condition three aggregates and delusion…etc.; two aggregates and the base condition two aggregates and delusion. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā… tīṇi.

A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development to arise by way of the co-nascence condition… three cases.

Aññamaññapaccayādi

Mutuality Condition, etc.

46. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā.

46. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of the mutuality condition… the support condition… the decisive support condition… the prenascence condition… the repetition condition… the kamma condition… the result condition… the nutriment condition… the faculty condition… the jhāna condition… the path condition… the association condition.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

47. Dassanena [M 2.0200] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

47. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of the dissociation condition—one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates… etc.; two aggregates; aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paccayā moho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, moho vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of the dissociation condition—the aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing condition mind-originated form; the aggregates condition by way of the dissociation condition. The aggregates accompanied by doubt condition delusion and mind-originated form; delusion conditions the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā [T 2.0271] dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [V 2.0226] pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā ca moho ca vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of the dissociation condition—one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions three aggregates and mind-originated form… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; the aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. One aggregate accompanied by doubt conditions three aggregates, delusion, and mind-originated form… etc.; two aggregates… etc.; the aggregates and delusion condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā… tīṇi (dassanena sadisā).

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, by way of the dissociation condition… three (similar to the cases for seeing).

48. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ… dve khandhe…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, mohaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vatthu khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ[M 2.0201], khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā. (1)

48. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of the dissociation condition—one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions three aggregates and mind-originated form… two aggregates… etc.; the aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. Delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness conditions mind-originated form; delusion is conditioned by way of the dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… etc.; the aggregates condition the base, the base conditions the aggregates. The aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. The base conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. One great element conditions three great elements… etc.; the great elements condition mind-originated form, kamma-originated form, and derived form; the aggregates condition by way of the dissociation condition. The eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… etc.; the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the base conditions aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo [T 2.0272] uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of the dissociation condition—the base conditions the aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing; the base conditions by way of the dissociation condition. Delusion accompanied by doubt conditions the associated aggregates; the base conditions by way of the dissociation condition. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā[V 2.0227]. Uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, by way of the dissociation condition—the base conditions the aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned by development; the base conditions by way of the dissociation condition. Delusion accompanied by restlessness conditions the associated aggregates; the base conditions by way of the dissociation condition. (3)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā khandhā; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ mohaṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagatā khandhā ca moho ca, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (4)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of the dissociation condition—the base conditions the aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned by seeing; the great elements condition mind-originated form; the aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions the aggregates by way of the dissociation condition. Delusion accompanied by doubt conditions associated aggregates and mind-originated form; the aggregates condition the base by way of the dissociation condition. Mind-originated form conditions delusion by way of the dissociation condition. The base conditions doubt-accompanied aggregates and delusion; the base conditions by way of the dissociation condition. (4)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā…pe… (dassanena sadisaṃ). (5)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned by development and phenomena whose roots are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, by way of the dissociation condition—the base conditions the aggregates whose roots are to be abandoned by development… etc. (similar to the cases for seeing). (5)

49. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena [T 2.0273] pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

49. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing by dissociation condition—one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the physical base condition three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… the physical base by dissociation condition. One aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion condition three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… the physical base by dissociation condition. (1)

Dassanena [M 2.0202] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe ca mohañca vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by dissociation condition—the aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter, with the aggregates as dissociation condition. The aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion condition mind-originated matter, with the aggregates and delusion as dissociation condition. The aggregates accompanied by doubt and the physical base condition delusion accompanied by doubt, with the physical base as dissociation condition. (2)

Dassanena [V 2.0228] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe ca mohañca vippayuttapaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca [T 2.0274] paccayā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe ca…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition states with roots to be abandoned by seeing and states with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development by dissociation condition. — One aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing and the physical base condition three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. Aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated matter. The aggregates are related to the physical base by dissociation condition; mind-originated matter is related to the aggregates by dissociation condition. One aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion condition three aggregates and mind-originated matter… and so on… two aggregates and… and so on. The aggregates are related to the physical base by dissociation condition; mind-originated matter is related to the aggregates and delusion by dissociation condition. One aggregate accompanied by doubt and the physical base condition three aggregates and delusion… and so on… two aggregates and… and so on… the physical base by dissociation condition. (3)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca…pe… tīṇi (dassanena sadisā).

A state with a root to be abandoned by development… and so on… three (similar to those with roots to be abandoned by seeing).

Atthipaccayādi

Beginning with the Presence Condition

50. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

50. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a state with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise by presence condition… by absence condition… by disappearance condition… by non-disappearance condition.

51. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe sattarasa, adhipatiyā sattarasa, anantare sattarasa, samanantare sattarasa, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe sattārasa nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye sattarasa, purejāte [M 2.0203] sattarasa, āsevane sattarasa, kamme sattarasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre sattarasa, indriye sattarasa, jhāne sattarasa, magge sattarasa, sampayutte sattarasa, vippayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā sattarasa, vigate sattarasa, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

51. By root condition, seventeen; by object condition, seventeen; by predominance condition, seventeen; by contiguity condition, seventeen; by immediate contiguity condition, seventeen; by co-nascence condition, seventeen; by reciprocity condition, seventeen; by support condition, seventeen; by decisive support condition, seventeen; by pre-nascence condition, seventeen; by repetition condition, seventeen; by kamma condition, seventeen; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, seventeen; by faculty condition, seventeen; by jhāna condition, seventeen; by path condition, seventeen; by association condition, seventeen; by dissociation condition, seventeen; by presence condition, seventeen; by absence condition, seventeen; by disappearance condition, seventeen; by non-disappearance condition, seventeen (thus should it be reckoned).

Non-Root Condition

52. Dassanena [V 2.0229] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

52. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-root condition: aggregates accompanied by doubt condition delusion accompanied by doubt. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned by development conditions a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-root condition: aggregates accompanied by restlessness condition delusion accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena [T 2.0275] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe (paripuṇṇaṃ) cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā khandhā; vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-root condition: one rootless aggregate with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions three aggregates and mind-originated matter… and so on… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking (complete), the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions rootless aggregates with roots to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; the physical base conditions delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

53. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato moho. (1)

53. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-root condition: aggregates accompanied by doubt and the physical base condition delusion accompanied by doubt. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo [M 2.0204] uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A state with a root to be abandoned by development and a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-root condition: aggregates accompanied by restlessness and the physical base condition delusion accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

54. Dassanena [V 2.0230] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

54. A state with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a state with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise by non-object condition: aggregates with roots to be abandoned by seeing condition mind-originated matter. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 2.0276] rūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise through the non-object condition: the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development condition mind-originated materiality. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ; khandhe paccayā vatthu…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise through the non-object condition: the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition kamma-produced materiality; the aggregates condition the base...pe...one great element...pe...external...nutriment-originated...temperature-originated...in non-percipient beings...pe.... (1)

55. Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

55. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise through the non-object condition: the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion condition mind-originated materiality. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise through the non-object condition: the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion condition mind-originated materiality. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Non-predominance Condition, etc.

56. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā [V 2.0231] (sahajātasadisaṃ)… naanantarapaccayā [M 2.0205]… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… [T 2.0277] napurejātapaccayā (paṭiccavāre paccanīyasadisaṃ, terasa pañhā. Ninnānaṃ)… napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā.

56. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing to arise, not by way of predominance condition (similar to the co-nascence condition)... not by way of contiguity condition... not by way of immediate contiguity condition... not by way of mutuality condition... not by way of decisive support condition... not by way of pre-nascence condition (similar to the negative section in the chapter on conditionality; thirteen questions, omitted)... not by way of post-nascence condition... not by way of repetition condition.

Nakammapaccayo

Non-kamma Condition

57. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā. (1)

57. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by development arises. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, the volition whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises; external... nutriment-originated... temperature-originated...pe... conditioned by the base, the volition whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises. (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā; vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā cetanā. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the base, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises; conditioned by delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated volition arises. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā; uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā cetanā. (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development conditions a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the base, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by development arises; conditioned by delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated volition arises. (3)

58. Dassanena [T 2.0278] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetuke khandhe [V 2.0232] ca vatthuñca paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetukā cetanā; vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

58. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and the base, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by seeing arises; conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and delusion, the associated volition arises. Bhāvanāya [M 2.0206] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuke khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā cetanā; uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca mohañca paccayā sampayuttakā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development condition a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development to arise, not by way of kamma condition: conditioned by the aggregates whose root is to be abandoned by development and the base, the volition whose root is to be abandoned by development arises; conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by restlessness and delusion, the associated volition arises. (1)

Navipākapaccayādi

Non-resultant Condition, etc.

59. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ, paṭisandhi natthi), naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paccayā rūpajīvitindriyaṃ… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ ekaṃ…pe… nasampayuttapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā… (paṭiccavārapaccanīye navippayuttasadisaṃ, ninnānaṃ. Ekādasa). Nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

59. A phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing conditions a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing to arise, not by way of result condition (complete, there is no rebirth-linking), not by way of nutriment condition—external... arising from temperature... for non-percipient beings... etc. Not by way of faculty condition—external... arising from nutriment... arising from temperature... for non-percipient beings... etc. The great elements condition the material life faculty... Not by way of jhāna condition—one aggregate associated with the fivefold sense-consciousness... etc. External... arising from nutriment... arising from temperature... for non-percipient beings... etc. Not by way of path condition—one rootless aggregate... etc. Not by way of association condition... not by way of dissociation condition... (similar to non-dissociation in the negative section of the Chapter on Relations; omitted. Eleven). Not by way of absence condition... not by way of disappearance condition.

Nahetuyā [T 2.0279] pañca, naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā sattarasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte terasa, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane sattarasa, nakamme satta, navipāke sattarasa, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte ekādasa, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

Not by way of root condition: five; not by way of object condition: five; not by way of domination condition: seventeen; not by way of contiguity condition: five; not by way of immediate contiguity condition: five; not by way of reciprocity condition: five; not by way of strong reliance condition: five; not by way of pre-existence condition: thirteen; not by way of post-existence condition: seventeen; not by way of repetition condition: seventeen; not by way of kamma condition: seven; not by way of result condition: seventeen; not by way of nutriment condition: one; not by way of faculty condition: one; not by way of jhāna condition: one; not by way of path condition: one; not by way of association condition: five; not by way of dissociation condition: eleven; not by way of absence condition: five; not by way of disappearance condition: five (thus should be reckoned).

The Root Dyad.

61. Hetupaccayā [V 2.0233] naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā sattarasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte [M 2.0207] terasa, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane sattarasa, nakamme satta, navipāke sattarasa, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte ekādasa, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca ( evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

61. By way of root condition: not by object condition, five; not by dominance condition, seventeen; not by contiguity condition, five; not by immediate contiguity condition, five; not by mutuality condition, five; not by strong support condition, five; not by prenascent condition, thirteen; not by postnascent condition, seventeen; not by repetition condition, seventeen; not by kamma condition, seven; not by resultant condition, seventeen; not by association condition, five; not by dissociation condition, eleven; not by absence condition, five; not by disappearance condition, five (thus should be counted).

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad.

62. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe pañca, anantare pañca, samanantare pañca, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe pañca, nissaye pañca, upanissaye pañca, purejāte pañca, āsevane pañca, kamme pañca, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre pañca, indriye pañca, jhāne pañca, magge pañca, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca, natthiyā [T 2.0280] pañca, vigate pañca, avigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

62. Not by way of root condition: by object condition, five; by contiguity condition, five; by immediate contiguity condition, five; by co-nascence condition, five; by mutuality condition, five; by dependence condition, five; by strong support condition, five; by prenascent condition, five; by repetition condition, five; by kamma condition, five; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, five; by faculty condition, five; by jhāna condition, five; by path condition, five; by association condition, five; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, five; by absence condition, five; by disappearance condition, five; by non-disappearance condition, five (thus should be counted).

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

63. Dassanena [V 2.0234] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

63. Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… associated with two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by development, three aggregates arise… associated with two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0208] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, three aggregates arise… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: associated with delusion accompanied by doubt, the associated aggregates arise. (2)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development arises by way of root condition: associated with delusion accompanied by restlessness, the associated aggregates arise. (3)

64. Dassanena [T 2.0281] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

64. Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion, three aggregates arise… or two aggregates. (1)

Bhāvanāya [V 2.0235] pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by development arises by way of root condition: associated with one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and delusion, three aggregates arise… or two aggregates. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

65. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

65. Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing arises by way of object condition: associated with one aggregate with a root to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise… or two aggregates. (1)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato moho. (2)

Associated with a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned by seeing, a phenomenon with a root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development arises by way of object condition: associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt arises. (2)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko ca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā moho ca…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Phenomena whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and phenomena whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, arise by way of object condition: three aggregates and delusion associated with one aggregate accompanied by doubt… or two aggregates… (3)

Bhāvanāya [M 2.0209] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho… tīṇi.

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, associated with… (three cases).

66. Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya [T 2.0282] pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

66. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of object condition: three aggregates associated with one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development… two aggregates associated with two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of object condition: the conjoined aggregates associated with delusion accompanied by doubt. (2)

Nevadassanena [V 2.0236] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ mohaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā sampayuttakā khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of object condition: the conjoined aggregates associated with delusion accompanied by restlessness. (3)

Dassanena pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vicikicchāsahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, associated with both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of object condition: three aggregates associated with one aggregate accompanied by doubt and delusion… or two aggregates associated with two aggregates and delusion. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – uddhaccasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca mohañca saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, associated with both a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development and a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of object condition: three aggregates associated with one aggregate accompanied by restlessness and delusion… or two aggregates. (1)

Adhipatipaccayādi

Dominance condition, and so on.

67. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

67. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, arises by way of dominance condition: three aggregates associated with one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned by seeing... two aggregates. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho… ekaṃ.

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, associated with... one.

Nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko [T 2.0283] dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā; anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā.

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of the dominance condition: three aggregates associated with one aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development... two aggregates; by way of the immediately contiguous condition... by way of the same-immediately contiguous condition.

Sahajātapaccayādi

By way of the co-nascence condition, and so on.

68. Dassanena [M 2.0210] pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā [V 2.0237]… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā….

68. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, arises by way of the co-nascence condition... by way of the mutuality condition... by way of the dependence condition... by way of the decisive support condition... by way of the pre-nascence condition... by way of the repetition condition... by way of the kamma condition... by way of the result condition... by way of the nutriment condition... by way of the faculty condition... by way of the jhāna condition... by way of the path condition... by way of the association condition... by way of the dissociation condition... by way of the presence condition... by way of the absence condition... by way of the disappearance condition... by way of the non-disappearance condition.

69. Hetuyā satta, ārammaṇe ekādasa, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare ekādasa, samanantare ekādasa, sahajāte ekādasa, aññamaññe ekādasa, nissaye ekādasa, upanissaye ekādasa, purejāte ekādasa, āsevane ekādasa, kamme ekādasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre ekādasa, indriye ekādasa, jhāne ekādasa, magge ekādasa, sampayutte ekādasa, vippayutte ekādasa, atthiyā ekādasa, natthiyā ekādasa, vigate ekādasa, avigate ekādasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

69. By way of the root condition, seven; by way of the object condition, eleven; by way of the dominance condition, three; by way of the immediately contiguous condition, eleven; by way of the same-immediately contiguous condition, eleven; by way of the co-nascence condition, eleven; by way of the mutuality condition, eleven; by way of the dependence condition, eleven; by way of the decisive support condition, eleven; by way of the pre-nascence condition, eleven; by way of the repetition condition, eleven; by way of the kamma condition, eleven; by way of the result condition, one; by way of the nutriment condition, eleven; by way of the faculty condition, eleven; by way of the jhāna condition, eleven; by way of the path condition, eleven; by way of the association condition, eleven; by way of the dissociation condition, eleven; by way of the presence condition, eleven; by way of the absence condition, eleven; by way of the disappearance condition, eleven; by way of the non-disappearance condition, eleven (thus should be reckoned).

Anulomaṃ.

The Affirmative Mode.

The Non-Root Condition.

70. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate [T 2.0284] khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato moho.(1)

70. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, arises by way of the non-root condition: delusion accompanied by doubt associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt. (1)

Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by development, arises by way of the non-root condition: delusion accompanied by restlessness associated with the aggregates accompanied by restlessness. (1)

Nevadassanena [M 2.0211][V 2.0238] nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, associated with a phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development, arises by way of the non-root condition: three aggregates associated with one causeless aggregate whose root is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development... two aggregates associated with two aggregates. At the moment of causeless rebirth-linking… (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

The Non-Dominance Condition, and so on.

71. Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe… naadhipatipaccayā (sahajātasadisaṃ)… napurejātapaccayā… napacchājātapaccayā, naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā… satta, navipākapaccayā… najhānapaccayā… namaggapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā….

71. A phenomenon whose root is to be abandoned by seeing, associated with... not by way of the dominance condition (similar to co-nascence)... not by way of the pre-nascence condition... not by way of the post-nascence condition, not by way of the repetition condition... not by way of the kamma condition... seven, not by way of the result condition... not by way of the jhāna condition... not by way of the path condition... not by way of the dissociation condition.

72. Nahetuyā tīṇi, naadhipatiyā ekādasa, napurejāte ekādasa, napacchājāte ekādasa, naāsevane ekādasa, nakamme satta, navipāke ekādasa, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekādasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

72. Not by way of the root condition: three; not by way of the dominance condition: eleven; not by way of the pre-nascence condition: eleven; not by way of the post-nascence condition: eleven; not by way of the repetition condition: eleven; not by way of the kamma condition: seven; not by way of the result condition: eleven; not by way of the jhāna condition: one; not by way of the path condition: one; not by way of the dissociation condition: eleven (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

73. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā satta, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte satta, naāsevane satta, nakamme satta, navipāke satta[T 2.0285], navippayutte satta (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

73. By way of the root condition, not by way of the dominance condition: seven; not by way of the pre-nascence condition: seven; not by way of the post-nascence condition: seven; not by way of the repetition condition: seven; not by way of the kamma condition: seven; not by way of the result condition: seven; not by way of the dissociation condition: seven (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative Mode.

74. Nahetupaccayā [V 2.0239] ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ[M 2.0212], āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge dve, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

74. Not by way of the root condition, but by way of the object condition: three; by way of the contiguity condition: three; by way of the immediate contiguity condition: three; by way of the co-nascence condition: three; by way of the mutuality condition: three; by way of the dependence condition: three; by way of the decisive support condition: three; by way of the pre-nascence condition: three; by way of the repetition condition: three; by way of the kamma condition: three; by way of the result condition: one; by way of the nutriment condition: three; by way of the faculty condition: three; by way of the jhāna condition: three; by way of the path condition: two; by way of the association condition: three; by way of the dissociation condition: three; by way of the presence condition: three; by way of the absence condition: three; by way of the disappearance condition: three; by way of the non-disappearance condition: three (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.
