Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

18. Ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

18. A phenomenon leading to accumulation is a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of root condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation is a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates. (1)

Ācayagāmiṃ [V 2.0278] dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī [T 2.0331] dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ācayagāmī khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon leading to accumulation is a condition for a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: the aggregates leading to accumulation are a condition for mind-originated material form. (2)

Ācayagāmiṃ [M 2.0247] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A phenomenon leading to accumulation is a condition for phenomena both leading to accumulation and neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated material form…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo… tīṇi.

A phenomenon leading to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline… three.

19. Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā. (1)

19. A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: one aggregate neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated material form…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the aggregates are a condition for the physical basis, the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates; one great element is a condition…pe… the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates neither leading to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to accumulation. (2)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā apacayagāmī khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline by way of root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to decline. (3)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for phenomena both leading to accumulation and neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to accumulation, the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material form. (4)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā apacayagāmī khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for phenomena both leading to decline and neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to decline, the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material form. (5)

20. Ācayagāmiñca [V 2.0279] nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca [T 2.0332] paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

20. A phenomenon leading to accumulation and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of root condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon leading to accumulation and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: the aggregates leading to accumulation and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material form. (2)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ [M 2.0248] khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon leading to accumulation and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for phenomena both leading to accumulation and neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of root condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… the aggregates leading to accumulation and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material form. (3)

Apacayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo… tīṇi.

A phenomenon leading to decline and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline… three.

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

21. Ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe…. (1)

21. A phenomenon leading to accumulation is a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of object condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation is a condition for…pe…. (1)

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo… ekaṃ.

A phenomenon leading to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline… one.

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline by way of object condition: one aggregate neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates, the eye basis is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body basis is a condition for body-consciousness. The physical basis is a condition for the aggregates neither leading to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ [V 2.0280] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of object condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to accumulation. (2)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā apacayagāmī khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline is a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline by way of object condition: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates leading to decline. (3)

Ācayagāmiñca [T 2.0333] nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon leading to accumulation and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of object condition: one aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Apacayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – apacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon leading to decline and a phenomenon neither leading to accumulation nor to decline are a condition for a phenomenon leading to decline by way of object condition: one aggregate leading to decline and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition.

22. Ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā… tīṇi.

22. A phenomenon leading to accumulation is a condition for a phenomenon leading to accumulation by way of dominance condition… three.

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo… tīṇi.

A state leading to decline conditions a state leading to decline. Three.

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ [M 2.0249] dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo… ekaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā.

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline. One. (etc.) The physical base conditions aggregates that neither lead to accumulation nor to decline.

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo…pe… (idhāpi ghaṭanā hetusadisā).

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state that leads to accumulation. (etc.) (Here too, the formulation is similar to that of the root condition.)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

23. Ācayagāmiṃ [V 2.0281] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā… tīṇi.

23. Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state leading to accumulation arises by way of the contiguity condition, by way of the immediate contiguity condition, by way of the conascence condition. Three.

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo… tīṇi.

A state leading to decline conditions a state leading to decline. Three.

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline arises by way of the conascence condition. One aggregate that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions three aggregates and mind-originated material form. (etc.) Two aggregates. (etc.) At the moment of relinking. (etc.) For non-percipient beings, one great primary element. (etc.) The eye base conditions eye-consciousness. (etc.) The body base conditions body-consciousness. The physical base conditions (etc.). (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbe ghaṭanā kātabbā).

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that leads to accumulation arises by way of the conascence condition. (Brief. All formulations should be worked out.)

Aññamaññapaccayādi

Mutuality Condition, etc.

24. Apacayagāmiṃ [T 2.0334] dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

24. Conditioned by a state leading to decline, a state leading to decline arises by way of the mutuality condition, by way of the support condition, by way of the decisive support condition, by way of the prenascence condition, by way of the repetition condition, by way of the kamma condition, by way of the result condition, by way of the nutriment condition, by way of the faculty condition, by way of the jhāna condition, by way of the path condition, by way of the association condition, by way of the dissociation condition, by way of the presence condition, by way of the absence condition, by way of the disappearance condition, by way of the non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

25. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā sattarasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye satta, purejāte [V 2.0282] satta, āsevane [M 2.0250] satta, kamme sattarasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre sattarasa, indriye jhāne magge sattarasa, sampayutte satta, vippayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

25. By way of the root condition, seventeen; by way of the object condition, seven; by way of the dominance condition, seventeen; by way of the contiguity condition, seven; by way of the immediate contiguity condition, seven; by way of the conascence condition, seventeen; by way of the mutuality condition, seven; by way of the support condition, seventeen; by way of the decisive support condition, seven; by way of the prenascence condition, seven; by way of the repetition condition, seven; by way of the kamma condition, seventeen; by way of the result condition, one; by way of the nutriment condition, seventeen; by way of the faculty condition, by way of the jhāna condition, by way of the path condition, seventeen; by way of the association condition, seven; by way of the dissociation condition, seventeen; by way of the presence condition, seventeen; by way of the absence condition, seven; by way of the disappearance condition, seven; by way of the non-disappearance condition, seventeen. (Thus should it be counted.)

Anulomaṃ.

The Forward Order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Reverse Order of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

26. Ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

26. Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state leading to accumulation arises by way of the non-root condition: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness condition the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… [T 2.0335] kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā. (1)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline arises by way of the non-root condition: one rootless aggregate that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions three aggregates and mind-originated material form. (etc.) Two aggregates. (etc.) At the moment of rootless relinking. (etc.) For non-percipient beings, one great primary element. (etc.) The eye base conditions eye-consciousness. (etc.) The body base conditions body-consciousness. The physical base conditions rootless aggregates that neither lead to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that leads to accumulation arises by way of the non-root condition: the physical base conditions delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (2)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state leading to accumulation arises by way of the non-root condition: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and the physical base condition the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

27. Ācayagāmiṃ [V 2.0283] dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ. Paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

27. Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline arises by way of the non-object condition. (Brief. Similar to the section on conditions.)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-Dominance Condition

28. Ācayagāmiṃ [M 2.0251] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… tīṇi.

28. Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state leading to accumulation arises by way of the non-dominance condition. Three.

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe paccayā apacayagāmī adhipati. (1)

Conditioned by a state leading to decline, a state leading to decline arises by way of the non-dominance condition: the aggregates leading to decline condition the dominance leading to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā. (1)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline arises by way of the non-dominance condition. (etc.) For non-percipient beings. (etc.) The eye base conditions eye-consciousness. (etc.) The body base conditions body-consciousness. The physical base conditions aggregates that neither lead to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā. (2)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that leads to accumulation arises by way of the non-dominance condition: the physical base conditions the aggregates leading to accumulation. (2)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā apacayagāmī adhipati. (3)

Conditioned by a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, a state that leads to decline arises by way of the non-dominance condition: the physical base conditions the dominance leading to decline. (3)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī [T 2.0336] ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state that leads to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline by way of non-dominance condition. The physical base conditions the aggregates leading to accumulation, and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (4)

29. Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati [V 2.0284] naadhipatipaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

29. A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state leading to accumulation by way of non-dominance condition. One aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical base condition three aggregates… (etc.)… two aggregates… (etc.). (1)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline by way of non-dominance condition. The aggregates leading to accumulation and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (2)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state that leads to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline by way of non-dominance condition. One aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical base condition three aggregates… (etc.)… two aggregates… (etc.)… the aggregates leading to accumulation and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (3)

Apacayagāmiñca [M 2.0252] nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā apacayagāmī adhipati. (1)

A state leading to decline and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state that leads to decline by way of non-dominance condition. The aggregates leading to decline and the physical base condition the dominance leading to decline. (1)

Naanantarapaccayādi

Non-immediate Condition, etc.

30. Naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… napurejātapaccayā (paṭiccavārasadisā, satta pañhā)… napacchājātapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ).

30. Non-immediate condition… non-contiguous condition… non-mutual condition… non-strong-support condition… non-pre-nascent condition (similar to the Conditional Relations Section, seven questions)… non-post-nascent condition (complete).

Naāsevanapaccayo

Non-repetition Condition.

31. Ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā… tīṇi.

31. A state leading to accumulation conditions a state leading to accumulation, not by Repetition Condition… three.

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state leading to decline conditions a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—the aggregates leading to decline condition mind-originated material form. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ [V 2.0285] dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo [T 2.0337] uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhā. (1)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—for non-percipient beings… (etc.)… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… (etc.)… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. The physical basis conditions aggregates that neither lead to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā. (2)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state leading to accumulation, not by Repetition Condition—the physical basis conditions the aggregates leading to accumulation. (2)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions both a state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—the physical basis conditions the aggregates leading to accumulation, and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (3)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state leading to accumulation, not by Repetition Condition—one aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical basis condition three aggregates… (etc.)… two aggregates… (etc.). (1)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—the aggregates leading to accumulation and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (2)

Ācayagāmiñca [M 2.0253] nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī ca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – ācayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ācayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition both a state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—one aggregate leading to accumulation and the physical basis condition three aggregates… (etc.)… two aggregates… (etc.)… the aggregates leading to accumulation and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (3)

Apacayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A state leading to decline and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Repetition Condition—the aggregates leading to decline and the great primary elements condition mind-originated material form. (1)

Nakammapaccayo

Non-kamma Condition.

32. Ācayagāmiṃ [V 2.0286] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā [T 2.0338] – ācayagāmī khandhe paccayā ācayagāmī cetanā. (1)

32. A state leading to accumulation conditions a state leading to accumulation, not by Kamma Condition—the aggregates leading to accumulation condition volition leading to accumulation. (1)

Apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe paccayā apacayagāmī cetanā. (1)

A state leading to decline conditions a state leading to decline, not by Kamma Condition—the aggregates leading to decline condition volition leading to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī khandhe paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī cetanā. (1)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline, not by Kamma Condition—the aggregates that neither lead to accumulation nor to decline condition volition that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline; external… food-originated… temperature-originated… (etc.)… the physical basis conditions volition that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā ācayagāmī cetanā. (2)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state leading to accumulation, not by Kamma Condition—the physical basis conditions volition leading to accumulation. (2)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā apacayagāmī cetanā. (3)

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline conditions a state leading to decline, not by Kamma Condition—the physical basis conditions volition leading to decline. (3)

Ācayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – ācayagāmī khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā ācayagāmī cetanā. (1)

A state leading to accumulation and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state leading to accumulation, not by Kamma Condition—the aggregates leading to accumulation and the physical basis condition volition leading to accumulation. (1)

Apacayagāmiñca nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiñca dhammaṃ paccayā apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – apacayagāmī khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā apacayagāmī cetanā. (1)

A state leading to decline and a state that neither leads to accumulation nor to decline condition a state leading to decline, not by Kamma Condition—the aggregates leading to decline and the physical basis condition volition leading to decline. (1)

Navipākapaccayādi

Non-result Condition, etc.

33. Ācayagāmiṃ [M 2.0254] dhammaṃ paccayā ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ kātabbaṃ, paṭisandhikkhaṇe natthi).

33. A state leading to accumulation conditions a state leading to accumulation by non-result condition. (To be completed in full; it does not occur at the moment of rebirth-linking).

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ [V 2.0287] dhammaṃ paccayā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī [T 2.0339] dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paccayā rūpajīvitindriyaṃ… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ…pe… namaggapaccayā – ahetukā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī…pe… nasampayuttapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ, tīṇi)… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

A state that neither leads to accumulation nor decline conditions a state that neither leads to accumulation nor decline by non-nutriment condition—external… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… by non-faculty condition—external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… the great elements condition the material life faculty… by non-jhāna condition—the five consciousnesses… and so on… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… and so on… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base conditions body-consciousness… and so on… by non-path condition—rootless states that neither lead to accumulation nor decline… and so on… for non-percipient beings, one great element… and so on… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… and so on… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical basis conditions rootless states that neither lead to accumulation nor decline… and so on… by non-association condition… by non-dissociation condition (similar to the Conditional Relations Section, three)… by non-absence condition… by non-disappearance condition.

37. Associated with a state leading to accumulation, a state leading to accumulation arises by root condition. Associated with one aggregate leading to accumulation are three aggregates... and so on... associated with two aggregates are two aggregates. (1)

38. 40. A state leading to accumulation, associated with a state leading to accumulation, arises by non-root condition: doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates are associated with doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion. (1)

Nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī [T 2.0342] dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A state neither leading to accumulation nor to decline, associated with a state neither leading to accumulation nor to decline, arises by non-repetition condition: one aggregate neither leading to accumulation nor to decline, associated with... at the moment of rebirth-linking... non-kamma condition... non-result condition... non-jhāna condition... non-path condition... non-dissociation condition.
