Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Sekkhaṃ [T 2.0366][M 2.0275][V 2.0311] dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

1. A trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on one trainee aggregate, three aggregates... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (1)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho nevasekhānāsekho (sī.), nevasekkhānāsekkho (syā. ka.) dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on the trainee aggregates, mind-originated form arises. (2)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

A trainee phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arise dependent on a trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on one trainee aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated form... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (3)

2. Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

2. An adept phenomenon arises dependent on an adept phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on one adept aggregate, three aggregates... and so on. (1)

Asekkhaṃ [V 2.0312] dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on an adept phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on the adept aggregates, mind-originated form arises. (2)

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā…pe… asekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

An adept phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arise dependent on an adept phenomenon... and so on... Dependent on one adept aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated form... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (3)

3. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe …pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca [T 2.0367] tayo mahābhūtā…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

3. A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on one neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated form... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on... At the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... Dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element, three great elements... and so on... Dependent on two great elements, two great elements; dependent on the great elements, mind-originated form, kamma-born form, and derived form arise. (1)

Sekkhañca [M 2.0276] nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on the trainee aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. (1)

Asekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on an adept phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition. Dependent on the adept aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

Object Condition, etc.

4. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi)… anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā (sabbe mahābhūtā kātabbā)… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe….

4. A trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of dominance condition (rebirth-linking is absent)... by way of contiguity condition... by way of immediate contiguity condition... by way of co-nascence condition (all great elements should be included)... by way of reciprocity condition... by way of dependence condition... by way of strong dependence condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of repetition condition. Dependent on one trainee aggregate, three aggregates... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on.

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe [V 2.0313] …pe… kammapaccayā, vipākapaccayā – vipākaṃ sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (tīṇi, paripuṇṇaṃ).

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Dependent on one neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregate, three aggregates... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on. By way of kamma condition, by way of resultant condition: Dependent on one resultant trainee aggregate, three aggregates... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on. (Three, complete).

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā [T 2.0368] – asekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

An adept phenomenon arises dependent on an adept phenomenon by way of resultant condition. Dependent on one adept aggregate... (three).

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – vipākaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of resultant condition. Dependent on one resultant neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated form... and so on... Dependent on two aggregates... and so on... At the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... Dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates; dependent on one great element... and so on. (1)

Sekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – vipāke sekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of resultant condition. Dependent on the resultant trainee aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. (1)

Asekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – asekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises dependent on an adept phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of resultant condition. Dependent on the adept aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated form arises. (1)

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

5. Sekkhaṃ [M 2.0277] dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccaya… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

5. A trainee phenomenon arises dependent on a trainee phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of dissociation condition… by way of presence condition… by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Division

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

6. Hetuyā [V 2.0314] nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme nava, vipāke āhāre indriye jhāne magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā [T 2.0369] tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

6. By root condition, nine; by object condition, three; by predominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, three; by immediate contiguity condition, three; by conascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, three; by prenascence condition, three; by repetition condition, two; by kamma condition, nine; by resultant condition, by nutriment condition, by faculty condition, by jhāna condition, by path condition, nine; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, three; by disappearance condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, nine (thus should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

In forward order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditions in Reverse Order

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Division Section

Nahetupaccayo

Non-root Condition

7. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

7. Dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality…etc.…two aggregates…etc.…at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…etc.…aggregates dependent on the base, the base dependent on the aggregates, one great element…etc.…external…food-originated…temperature-originated…for non-percipient beings, one great element…etc.…dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and agitation, the delusion accompanied by doubt and agitation. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-object Condition

8. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

8. Dependent on a learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition—dependent on learner aggregates, mind-originated materiality. (1)

Asekkhaṃ [M 2.0278][V 2.0315] dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – asekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition—dependent on non-learner aggregates, mind-originated materiality. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nevasekkhanāsekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition—dependent on neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates, mind-originated materiality…etc.…at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.…aggregates dependent on the base…etc.…one great element…etc.…for non-percipient beings…etc. (1)

Sekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte [T 2.0370] ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition—dependent on learner aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality. (1)

Asekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – asekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a non-learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition—dependent on non-learner aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Non-predominance Condition, etc.

9. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca sekkho adhipati. (1)

9. Dependent on a learner phenomenon, a learner phenomenon arises by way of non-predominance condition—dependent on learner aggregates, a learner predominance. (1)

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – asekkhe khandhe paṭicca asekkho adhipati. (1)

Dependent on a non-learner phenomenon, a non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-predominance condition—dependent on non-learner aggregates, a non-learner predominance. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… (paripuṇṇaṃ, paṭisandhipi mahābhūtāpi sabbe) naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… napurejātapaccayā… satta (kusalattikasadisā)… napacchājātapaccayā…pe… naāsevanapaccayā. Vipākaṃ sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

Dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-predominance condition… (complete, rebirth-linking and all great elements are included), by way of non-contiguity condition… by way of non-immediate contiguity condition… by way of non-mutuality condition… by way of non-strong dependence condition… by way of non-prenascence condition… seven (similar to the wholesome triad)… by way of non-postnascence condition…etc.…by way of non-repetition condition. Dependent on one resultant learner aggregate, three aggregates…etc.…dependent on two aggregates…etc. (1)

10. Sekkhaṃ [V 2.0316] dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

10. Dependent on a learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-repetition condition—dependent on learner aggregates, mind-originated materiality. (2)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a learner phenomenon, both a learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arise by way of non-repetition condition—dependent on one resultant learner aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality…etc.…dependent on two aggregates…etc. (3)

Asekkhaṃ [M 2.0279] dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho dhammo… tīṇi.

Dependent on a non-learner phenomenon, a non-learner phenomenon… three.

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā… nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ [T 2.0371] (ekaṃ, paripuṇṇaṃ, sekkhañca, nevasekkhanāsekkhañca, ghaṭanā paripuṇṇā, dvepi kātabbā. Nava) nakammapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca sekkhā cetanā.

Dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-repetition condition… neither-learner-nor-non-learner (one, complete, and learner and neither-learner-nor-non-learner, complete combination, two should be done. Nine) by way of non-kamma condition—dependent on learner aggregates, learner volition.

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevasekkhanāsekkhe khandhe paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkhā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

Dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of non-kamma condition—dependent on neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates, neither-learner-nor-non-learner volition; external… food-originated… temperature-originated… one great element…etc.

Navipākapaccayo

Non-result Condition

11. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

11. A learner phenomenon arises dependent on a learner phenomenon by way of non-result condition—dependent on one learner aggregate, three aggregates…etc. (1)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.(2)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a learner phenomenon by way of non-result condition—dependent on learner aggregates, mind-originated materiality. (2)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti navipākapaccayā – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe…. (3)

Both a learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arise dependent on a learner phenomenon by way of non-result condition—dependent on one learner aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality…etc. (3)

12. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ [V 2.0317] dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ, paṭisandhi natthi ).

12. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of non-result condition (complete; rebirth-linking does not occur).

Sekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – sekkhe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of non-result condition—dependent on learner aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality. (1)

Naāhārapaccayādi

Non-nutriment Condition, etc.

13. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā… naindriyapaccayā… najhānapaccayā… namaggapaccayā[T 2.0372].

13. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of non-nutriment condition… non-faculty condition… non-jhāna condition… non-path condition.

Nasampayuttapaccayo

Non-concomitance Condition

14. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati nasampayuttapaccayā…pe… (naārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ).

14. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a learner phenomenon by way of non-concomitance condition…etc.… (similar to the non-object condition).

Navippayuttapaccayādi

Non-dissociation Condition, etc.

Sekkhaṃ [M 2.0280] dhammaṃ paṭicca sekkho dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā. Arūpe sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

A learner phenomenon arises dependent on a learner phenomenon by way of non-dissociation condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one learner aggregate, three aggregates…etc. (1)

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekkho dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe asekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

A non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a non-learner phenomenon by way of non-dissociation condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one non-learner aggregate, three aggregates… (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises dependent on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of non-dissociation condition. In the immaterial realm, dependent on one neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregate, three aggregates… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… by non-presence condition… by non-disappearance condition.

Suddhaṃ

Pure

15. Nahetuyā [V 2.0318] ekaṃ, naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare nasamanantare naaññamaññe naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava, nakamme dve, navipāke pañca, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

15. By non-root condition: one; by non-object condition: five; by non-dominance condition: three; by non-immediacy, non-contiguity, non-mutuality, non-strong-dependence condition: five; by non-prenascence condition: seven; by non-postnascence condition: nine; by non-repetition condition: nine; by non-kamma condition: two; by non-result condition: five; by non-nutriment condition: one; by non-faculty condition: one; by non-jhāna condition: one; by non-path condition: one; by non-association condition: five; by non-dissociation condition: three; by non-presence condition: five; by non-disappearance condition: five (thus should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

16. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare nasamanantare naaññamaññe naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte naāsevane nava, nakamme dve, navipāke pañca, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate [T 2.0373] pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

16. By root condition: by non-object condition, five; by non-dominance condition, three; by non-immediacy, non-contiguity, non-mutuality, non-strong-dependence condition, five; by non-prenascence condition, seven; by non-postnascence, non-repetition condition, nine; by non-kamma condition, two; by non-result condition, five; by non-association condition, five; by non-dissociation condition, three; by non-presence condition, five; by non-disappearance condition, five (thus should be counted).

26. Dependent on a learner phenomenon, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises by way of Non-Object Condition…. (1)

Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – sekkhe khandhe paccayā sekkho adhipati. (1)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon arises in dependence on a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon, not by dominance condition (to be filled in). For non-percipient beings… and so on… the eye-base… and so on… The physical base is a condition for neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā sekkho adhipati. (2)

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

33. Sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 2.0380] – sekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

33. A trainee phenomenon associated with a trainee phenomenon arises by way of root condition: three aggregates are associated with one trainee aggregate... etc... two aggregates... etc. (1)

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

A non-trainee phenomenon associated with a non-trainee phenomenon arises by way of root condition: three aggregates are associated with one non-trainee aggregate... etc... two aggregates... etc. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon associated with a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises by way of root condition: three aggregates are associated with one neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregate... etc... two aggregates... etc... at the moment of rebirth-linking... etc. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

Object-condition, etc.

34. Sekkhaṃ [M 2.0288][V 2.0328] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sekkho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā…pe… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā (dve kātabbā)…pe… avigatapaccayā.

34. A trainee phenomenon associated with a trainee phenomenon arises by way of object condition... by way of dominance condition... etc... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of repetition condition (two should be done)... etc... by way of non-disappearance condition.

35. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare samanantare sahajāte aññamaññe nissaye upanissaye purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

35. In the root condition, three; in the object condition, three; in the dominance condition, three; in the immediate condition, in the contiguity condition, in the co-nascence condition, in the mutuality condition, in the dependence condition, in the decisive support condition, in the pre-nascence condition, three; in the repetition condition, two; in the kamma condition, three... etc... in the non-disappearance condition, three (thus should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

The Concordant Mode.

Nahetupaccayo

Non-root condition

36. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

36. A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon associated with a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: three aggregates are associated with one rootless neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregate... etc... two aggregates... etc... at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking... etc... delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is associated with aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-dominance condition

37. Sekkhaṃ [V 2.0329] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā [T 2.0381] – sekkhe khandhe saṃsaṭṭho sekkho adhipati. (1)

37. A trainee phenomenon associated with a trainee phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: a trainee dominance is associated with trainee aggregates. (1)

Asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho asekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – asekkhe khandhe saṃsaṭṭho asekkho adhipati. (1)

A non-trainee phenomenon associated with a non-trainee phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: a non-trainee dominance is associated with non-trainee aggregates. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ, ekaṃ).

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon associated with a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition (complete, one).

Napurejātapaccayādi

Non-pre-nascence condition, etc.

38. Sekkhaṃ [M 2.0289] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho sekkho dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā… napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā (dve kātabbā)… navipākapaccayā (dve kātabbā)… najhānapaccayā… namaggapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā…pe….

38. A trainee phenomenon associated with a trainee phenomenon arises by way of non-pre-nascence condition... by way of non-post-nascence condition... by way of non-repetition condition... by way of non-kamma condition (two should be done)... by way of non-result condition (two should be done)... by way of non-jhāna condition... by way of non-path condition... by way of non-dissociation condition... etc.

39. Nahetuyā ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

39. In the non-root condition, one; in the non-dominance condition, three; in the non-pre-nascence condition, three; in the non-post-nascence condition, three; in the non-repetition condition, three; in the non-kamma condition, two; in the non-result condition, two; in the non-jhāna condition, one; in the non-path condition, one; in the non-dissociation condition, three (thus should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

40. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

40. By way of root condition: in non-dominance condition, three; in non-pre-nascence condition, three; in non-post-nascence and non-repetition conditions, three; in non-kamma condition, two; in non-result condition, two; in non-dissociation condition, three (thus it should be counted).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Concordant-Negative Mode.

4. The Condition-Negative-Concordant Mode.

41. Nahetupaccayā [V 2.0330] ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare samanantare sahajāte aññamaññe nissaye upanissaye purejāte āsevane kamme vipāke āhāre indriye jhāne magge sampayutte vippayutte atthiyā [T 2.0382] natthiyā vigate avigate ekaṃ (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

41. By way of non-root condition: in object condition, one; in immediate condition, contiguity condition, co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, dependence condition, decisive support condition, pre-nascence condition, repetition condition, kamma condition, result condition, nutriment condition, faculty condition, jhāna condition, path condition, association condition, dissociation condition, presence condition, absence condition, disappearance condition, and non-disappearance condition, one (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Concordant Mode.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ
