1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

42. Sekkho [M 2.0290] dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sekkhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

42. A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a trainee phenomenon by way of root condition: trainee roots are a condition for their associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sekkhā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition: trainee roots are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition. (2)

Sekkho [V 2.0331] dhammo sekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sekkhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a trainee phenomenon and for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition: trainee roots are a condition for their associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition. (3)

Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa (tīṇi).

A non-trainee phenomenon for a non-trainee phenomenon (three).

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nevasekkhanāsekkhā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of root condition: neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee roots are a condition for their associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

43. Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, sekkhaṃ phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, cetopariyañāṇena sekkhacittasamaṅgissa [T 2.0383] cittaṃ jānanti, sekkhā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

43. A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path; they reflect upon the trainee's fruition; with mind-penetrating knowledge, they know the mind of one endowed with a trainee's consciousness; the trainee's aggregates are a condition by way of object for mind-penetrating knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā asekkhaṃ phalaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇena asekkhacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, asekkhā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of object condition. The Arahant reflects upon the non-trainee's fruition; with mind-penetrating knowledge, knows the mind of one endowed with a non-trainee's consciousness; the non-trainee's aggregates are a condition by way of object for mind-penetrating knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

44. Nevasekkhanāsekkho [M 2.0291] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhe [V 2.0332] khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nevasekkhanāsekkhacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ [T 2.0384] viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

44. A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of object condition. Having given a gift, undertaken the precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; previously well-performed deeds... having emerged from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna. The noble ones reflect upon Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object for change-of-lineage consciousness, for purification, and for adverting. The noble ones reflect upon abandoned defilements, reflect upon suppressed defilements, and know previously accumulated defilements. They discern the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; they relish it, they delight in it, and with that as object, lust arises... grief arises. The ear... the base... they discern the neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregates as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; they relish them... grief arises. With the divine eye, one sees a form; with the divine ear-element, one hears a sound; with mind-penetrating knowledge, one knows the mind of one endowed with a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition by way of object for the base of infinite consciousness... the base of nothingness is a condition by way of object for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness... the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness... the neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee aggregates are a condition by way of object for knowledge of psychic powers, for mind-penetrating knowledge, for knowledge of past lives, for knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, sekkhassa phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon is a condition for a trainee phenomenon by way of object condition. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object for the path and for the trainee's fruition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ asekkhassa phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon is a condition for a non-trainee phenomenon by way of object condition. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object for the non-trainee's fruition. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition.

45. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – sekkhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

45. A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a trainee phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: A trainee's dominance factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, sekkhaṃ phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti[M 2.0292]. Sahajātādhipati – sekkhādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A trainee phenomenon is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object Dominance, Co-nascence Dominance. Object Dominance: The noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path, holding it in high esteem; they reflect upon the trainee's fruition, holding it in high esteem. Co-nascence Dominance: A trainee's dominance factor is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (2)

Sekkho [T 2.0385] dhammo sekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – sekkhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A trainee phenomenon is a condition for both a trainee phenomenon and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: A trainee's dominance factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (3)

46. Asekkho [V 2.0333] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – asekkhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

46. A non-trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a non-trainee's phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition. Conascence Dominance: A non-trainee's dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of Dominance Condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā asekkhaṃ phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati – asekkhādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Dominance Condition. Object Dominance, Conascence Dominance. Object Dominance: The Arahant reflects upon the non-trainee's fruition, holding it in respect. Conascence Dominance: A non-trainee's dominance is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of Dominance Condition. (2)

Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – asekkhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-trainee's phenomenon is a condition for both a non-trainee's phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Dominance Condition. Conascence Dominance: A non-trainee's dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of Dominance Condition. (3)

47. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā [T 2.0386] jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – nevasekkhanāsekkhādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

47. A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Dominance Condition. Object Dominance, Conascence Dominance. Object Dominance: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that, holding it in respect; one reflects upon previously well-performed deeds, holding them in respect; having emerged from jhana, one reflects upon the jhana, holding it in respect. The noble ones reflect upon Nibbāna, holding it in respect. Nibbāna is a condition by way of dominance for the change-of-lineage consciousness and for purification. One relishes the eye, delights in it, and by holding it in respect, lust arises, wrong view arises. Similarly for the ear... the base... one relishes the aggregates that are neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee, delights in them, and by holding them in respect, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence Dominance: The dominance of a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of Dominance Condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa, sekkhassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a trainee's phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition. Object Dominance: Nibbāna is a condition by way of dominance for the path and for the trainee's fruition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho [M 2.0293] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ asekkhassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a non-trainee's phenomenon by way of Dominance Condition. Object Dominance: Nibbāna is a condition by way of dominance for the non-trainee's fruition. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

48. Sekkho [V 2.0334] dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sekkhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Maggo sekkhassa phalassa… sekkhaṃ phalaṃ sekkhassa phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

48. A trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a trainee's phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition—preceding trainee's aggregates are a condition for succeeding trainee's aggregates by way of Proximity Condition. The path is a condition for the trainee's fruition... a trainee's fruition is a condition for a trainee's fruition by way of Proximity Condition. (1)

Sekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – maggo asekkhassa phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a non-trainee's phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition—the path is a condition for the non-trainee's fruition by way of Proximity Condition. (2)

Sekkho [T 2.0387] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – sekkhaṃ phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Proximity Condition—a trainee's fruition is a condition for emergence by way of Proximity Condition. (3)

49. Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā asekkhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Asekkhaṃ phalaṃ asekkhassa phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

49. A non-trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a non-trainee's phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition—preceding non-trainee's aggregates are a condition for succeeding non-trainee's aggregates by way of Proximity Condition. A non-trainee's fruition is a condition for a non-trainee's fruition by way of Proximity Condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – asekkhaṃ phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Proximity Condition—a non-trainee's fruition is a condition for emergence by way of Proximity Condition. (2)

50. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… āvajjanā nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

50. A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Proximity Condition—preceding aggregates that are neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee are a condition for succeeding aggregates that are neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee... adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage... adaptation is a condition for purification... adverting is a condition for aggregates that are neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee by way of Proximity Condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… anulomaṃ sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a trainee's phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition—change-of-lineage is a condition for the path... purification is a condition for the path... adaptation is a condition for a trainee's attainment of fruition... for one emerging from cessation, the wholesome consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for a trainee's attainment of fruition by way of Proximity Condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho [M 2.0294][V 2.0335] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – anulomaṃ asekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa [T 2.0388] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ asekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither of a trainee nor of a non-trainee is a condition for a non-trainee's phenomenon by way of Proximity Condition—adaptation is a condition for a non-trainee's attainment of fruition... for one emerging from cessation, the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for a non-trainee's attainment of fruition by way of Proximity Condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

51. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… (anantarasadisaṃ, aṭṭha pañhā).

51. A trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a trainee's phenomenon by way of Contiguity Condition... (similar to Proximity Condition, eight questions).

Sahajātapaccayādi

Conascence Condition, etc.

52. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… (paṭiccavāre sahajātasadisaṃ, nava pañhā) aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavāre aññamaññasadisaṃ, tīṇi. Nissayapaccaye kusalattike nissayapaccayasadisaṃ, terasa pañhā).

52. A trainee's phenomenon is a condition for a trainee's phenomenon by way of Conascence Condition... (similar to Conascence Condition in the Conditionality Section, nine questions); it is a condition by way of Mutuality Condition (similar to Mutuality Condition in the Conditionality Section, three questions). In the case of Dependence Condition, this is similar to the Dependence Condition section for the Wholesome Triad (thirteen questions).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

53. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyo maggo tatiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Maggo sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

53. A learner's phenomenon is a condition for a learner's phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—the first path is a condition for the second path by way of the decisive support condition. The second path is a condition for the third path by way of the decisive support condition. The third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of the decisive support condition. The path is a condition for a learner's attainment of fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Sekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – maggo asekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A learner's phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner's phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—the path is a condition for a non-learner's attainment of fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccaya – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ariyā maggaṃ [V 2.0336] upanissāya anuppannaṃ kusalasamāpattiṃ [T 2.0389] uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpajjanti, saṅkhāre aniccato…pe… vipassanti, maggo ariyānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya…pe… paṭibhānappaṭisambhidāya… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa [M 2.0295] upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā phalasamāpattiyā kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A learner's phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—noble ones, relying on the path, generate wholesome attainments that have not arisen, and enter into those that have arisen; they contemplate formations as impermanent... etc. ... the path is a condition for the noble ones’ analytical knowledge of meaning... etc. ... analytical knowledge of eloquence... skill in what is possible and impossible by way of the decisive support condition. A learner's attainment of fruition is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

54. Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Anantarūpanissayo – purimā purimā asekkhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… asekkhaṃ phalaṃ asekkhassa phalassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

54. A non-learner's phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner's phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition. Immediately contiguous decisive support—earlier non-learner's aggregates are a condition for later non-learner's aggregates... etc. ... a non-learner's fruition is a condition for a non-learner's fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – asekkhā phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-learner's phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—a non-learner's attainment of fruition is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

55. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti. Sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… jhānaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Nevasekkhanāsekkhā saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… [T 2.0390] senāsanaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

55. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—relying on neither-learner-nor-non-learner faith, one gives alms; observes morality... etc. ... performs the Uposatha observance... etc. ... cultivates jhāna... etc. ... cultivates insight... etc. ... produces higher knowledge... etc. ... produces attainment; generates conceit; grasps wrong view. Relying on neither-learner-nor-non-learner morality... etc. ... wisdom... lust... etc. ... aspiration... bodily pleasure... etc. ... climate... food... lodging, one gives alms; observes morality... etc. ... produces attainment; kills living beings... etc. ... splits the Saṅgha. Neither-learner-nor-non-learner faith... etc. ... wisdom, lust... etc. ... aspiration, bodily pleasure... etc. ... lodging is a condition for neither-learner-nor-non-learner faith... etc. ... wisdom, lust... etc. ... aspiration, bodily pleasure, bodily pain by way of the decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition for the first jhāna by way of the decisive support condition... etc. ... the preliminary work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... etc. ... the first jhāna is a condition for the second jhāna by way of the decisive support condition... etc. ... the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[V 2.0337], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a learner's phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—the preliminary work for the first path is a condition for the first path by way of the decisive support condition... etc. ... the preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition for the fourth path by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho [M 2.0296] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ asekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner's phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediately contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support... etc. ... Natural decisive support—bodily pleasure... bodily pain... climate... food... lodging is a condition for a non-learner's attainment of fruition by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

56. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato [T 2.0391] anattato vipassati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

56. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: one discerns the eye as impermanent… and delights in and approves of it; based on that, lust arises… sorrow arises. The ear… one discerns the base as impermanent, suffering, non-self… sorrow arises; with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; the form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness; the base is a condition for the aggregates of neither-learners-nor-non-learners by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu sekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a learner's phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates of learners by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the adept phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates of adepts by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

57. Sekkho [V 2.0338] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā sekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

57. The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition—the post-nascent trainee aggregates are a condition for this pre-existent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā asekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition—the post-nascent adept aggregates are a condition for this pre-existent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho [M 2.0297] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā nevasekkhanāsekkhā [T 2.0392] khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition—the post-nascent neither-trainee-nor-adept aggregates are a condition for this pre-existent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

58. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

58. The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of the repetition condition—the preceding neither-trainee-nor-adept aggregates are a condition for the succeeding neither-trainee-nor-adept aggregates by way of the repetition condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the trainee phenomenon by way of the repetition condition—change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

59. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – sekkhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – sekkhā cetanā vipākānaṃ sekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

59. The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the trainee phenomenon by way of kamma condition—simultaneous, non-simultaneous. Simultaneous: trainee volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Non-simultaneous: trainee volition is a condition for the resultant trainee aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Sekkho [V 2.0339] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – sekkhā cetanā asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Non-simultaneous: trainee volition is a condition for the adept aggregates by way of kamma condition. (2)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā – sekkhā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Simultaneous: trainee volition is a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa [T 2.0393] kammapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (4)

The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the trainee phenomenon and the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition—trainee volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (4)

60. Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – asekkhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

60. The adept phenomenon is a condition for the adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition—adept volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Asekkho [M 2.0298] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – asekkhā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Adept volition is a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – asekkhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The adept phenomenon is a condition for the adept phenomenon and the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition—adept volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

61. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – nevasekkhanāsekkhā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – nevasekkhanāsekkhā cetanā vipākānaṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

61. The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of kamma condition—simultaneous, non-simultaneous. Simultaneous: the neither-trainee-nor-adept volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… Non-simultaneous: the neither-trainee-nor-adept volition is a condition for the resultant neither-trainee-nor-adept aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

62. Sekkho [V 2.0340] dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko sekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… (sekkhamūlake tīṇi ).

62. The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the trainee phenomenon by way of result condition: one resultant trainee aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates… (three instances in the trainee root).

Asekkho [T 2.0394] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – asekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… (asekkhamūlake tīṇi).

The adept phenomenon is a condition for the adept phenomenon by way of result condition: one resultant adept aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates… (three instances in the adept root).

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko nevasekkhanāsekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of result condition: one resultant neither-trainee-nor-adept aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of result condition. (1)

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, and so on

63. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe….

63. The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the trainee phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhana condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… and so on.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

64. Sekkho [M 2.0299] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – sekkhā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – sekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo (1).

64. The trainee phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, postnascent. Conascent: trainee aggregates are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of dissociation condition. Postnascent: trainee aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ (sekkhasadisaṃ).

The adept phenomenon is a condition for the neither-trainee-nor-adept phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, postnascent (similar to the trainee).

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ[V 2.0341], purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ [T 2.0395] vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascent, prenascent, postnascent. Conascent: neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of dissociation condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascent: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness; the physical base is a condition for the neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascent: neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu sekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a learner phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascent: the physical base is a condition for the learner aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascent: the physical base is a condition for the non-learner aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

65. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

65. A learner phenomenon is a condition for a learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: one learner aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates… and so on. (1)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – sekkhā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – sekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A learner phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, postnascent. Conascent: learner aggregates are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Postnascent: learner aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Sekkho [M 2.0300] dhammo sekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa [T 2.0396] atthipaccayena paccayo – sekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

A learner phenomenon is a condition for both a learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: one learner aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… tīṇi (sekkhasadisaṃ).

A non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition… and so on… three sections (similar to the learner section).

66. Nevasekkhanāsekkho [V 2.0342] dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nevasekkhanāsekkho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa… vatthu nevasekkhanāsekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nevasekkhanāsekkhā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ [T 2.0397] kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

66. A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, prenascent, postnascent, nutriment, faculty. Conascent: one neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on… the aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of presence condition. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of presence condition; one great element… and so on… external… and so on… for non-percipient beings… and so on. Prenascent: one contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one savors it and rejoices in it; taking that as object, lust arises… and so on… grief arises. The ear… and so on… the physical base as impermanent… and so on… one contemplates; one sees forms with the divine eye, hears sounds with the divine ear element; the visible form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness… and so on… the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… and so on… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates by way of presence condition. Postnascent: neither-learner-nor-non-learner aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. Physical food is a condition for this body by way of presence condition. The material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu sekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a learner phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascent: the physical base is a condition for the learner aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu asekkhānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon is a condition for a non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascent: the physical base is a condition for the non-learner aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

67. Sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā sekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – sekkho [M 2.0301] eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

67. A learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon are conditions for a learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, prenascent. Conascent: one learner aggregate and the physical base are conditions for the three aggregates by way of presence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – sekkhā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – sekkhā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro [V 2.0343] āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – sekkhā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon are conditions for a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascent, postnascent, nutriment, faculty. Conascent: learner aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Postnascent: learner aggregates and physical food are conditions for this body by way of presence condition. Postnascent: learner aggregates and the material life faculty are conditions for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Asekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā asekkhassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… (dve pañhā kātabbā, sekkhasadisā).

A non-learner phenomenon and a neither-learner-nor-non-learner phenomenon are conditions for a non-learner phenomenon by way of presence condition… and so on (two questions are to be formulated, similar to the learner section).

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Positive Exposition of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

68. Hetuyā [T 2.0398] satta, ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā nava, anantare aṭṭha, samanantare aṭṭha, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme aṭṭha, vipāke āhāre indriye jhāne magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā aṭṭha, vigate aṭṭha, avigate terasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

68. By root condition, seven; by object condition, five; by predominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, eight; by immediate proximity condition, eight; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, thirteen; by decisive support condition, eight; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, two; by kamma condition, eight; by result condition, by nutriment condition, by faculty condition, by jhāna condition, by path condition, seven; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, thirteen; by absence condition, eight; by disappearance condition, eight; by non-disappearance condition, thirteen (thus should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Direct Order.

2. Paccanīyuddhāro

2. Negative Section

69. Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A trainee state is a condition for a trainee state by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition. (1)

Sekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A trainee state is a condition for a non-trainee state by decisive support condition. (2)

Sekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A trainee state is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by post-nascence condition. (3)

Sekkho dhammo sekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A trainee state is a condition for a trainee state and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by co-nascence condition. (4)

70. Asekkho [M 2.0302][V 2.0344] dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

70. A non-trainee state is a condition for a non-trainee state by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition. (1)

Asekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena [T 2.0399] paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-trainee state is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by post-nascence condition. (2)

Asekkho dhammo asekkhassa ca nevasekkhanāsekkhassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-trainee state is a condition for a non-trainee state and a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by co-nascence condition. (3)

71. Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

71. A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state is a condition for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by object condition... by co-nascence condition... by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition... by post-nascence condition... by kamma condition... by nutriment condition... by faculty condition. (1)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo sekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state is a condition for a trainee state by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo asekkhassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state is a condition for a non-trainee state by decisive support condition... by pre-nascence condition. (3)

72. Sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā sekkhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

72. Trainee states and neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee states are conditions for a trainee state by co-nascence, by pre-nascence. (1)

Sekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

Trainee states and neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee states are conditions for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by co-nascence, by post-nascence, by nutriment, by faculty. (2)

Asekkho ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā asekkhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

Non-trainee states and neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee states are conditions for a non-trainee state by co-nascence, by pre-nascence. (1)

Asekkho [V 2.0345] ca nevasekkhanāsekkho ca dhammā nevasekkhanāsekkhassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

Non-trainee states and neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee states are conditions for a neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee state by co-nascence, by post-nascence, by nutriment, by faculty. (2)

73. Nahetuyā [T 2.0400] cuddasa, naārammaṇe naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare cuddasa, nasahajāte dasa, naaññamaññe dasa, nanissaye dasa[M 2.0303], naupanissaye terasa, napurejāte dvādasa, napacchājāte cuddasa, naāsevane nakamme cuddasa, navipāke dvādasa, naāhāre naindriye najhāne namagge cuddasa, nasampayutte dasa, navippayutte aṭṭha, noatthiyā aṭṭha, nonatthiyā cuddasa, novigate cuddasa, noavigate aṭṭha (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

73. Not by root condition, fourteen; not by object condition, not by predominance condition, not by contiguity condition, not by immediate proximity condition, fourteen; not by co-nascence condition, ten; not by reciprocity condition, ten; not by dependence condition, ten; not by decisive support condition, thirteen; not by pre-nascence condition, twelve; not by post-nascence condition, fourteen; not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, fourteen; not by result condition, twelve; not by nutriment condition, not by faculty condition, not by jhāna condition, not by path condition, fourteen; not by association condition, ten; not by dissociation condition, eight; not by presence condition, eight; not by absence condition, fourteen; not by disappearance condition, fourteen; not by non-disappearance condition, eight (thus should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Pair

74. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye napurejāte napacchājāte naāsevane nakamme satta, navipāke cattāri, naāhāre naindriye najhāne namagge satta, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

74. By root condition: not by object condition, seven; not by predominance condition, seven; not by contiguity condition, seven; not by immediate proximity condition, seven; not by reciprocity condition, three; not by decisive support condition, not by pre-nascence condition, not by post-nascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, seven; not by result condition, four; not by nutriment condition, not by faculty condition, not by jhāna condition, not by path condition, seven; not by association condition, three; not by dissociation condition, three; not by absence condition, seven; not by disappearance condition, seven (thus should be counted).

75. Nahetupaccayā [V 2.0346] ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā nava, anantare aṭṭha, samanantare aṭṭha, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme aṭṭha, vipāke āhāre indriye jhāne magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā [T 2.0401] aṭṭha, vigate aṭṭha, avigate terasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

75. By non-root condition: by object condition, five; by predominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, eight; by immediate proximity condition, eight; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, thirteen; by decisive support condition, eight; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, two; by kamma condition, eight; by result condition, by nutriment condition, by faculty condition, by jhāna condition, by path condition, seven; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, thirteen; by absence condition, eight; by disappearance condition, eight; by non-disappearance condition, thirteen (thus should be counted).
