Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Parittaṃ [M 2.0304][V 2.0347] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ…pe…. (1)

1. A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of root condition—in dependence on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. Aggregates arise in dependence on the base; the base arises in dependence on aggregates. In dependence on one great element, three great elements arise [...]; in dependence on two great elements, mind-originated materiality arises [...]. (1)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted aggregates arise in dependence on the base. (2)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted aggregates arise in dependence on the base, and kamma-produced materiality arises in dependence on the great elements. (3)

2. Mahaggataṃ [V 2.0348] dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – mahaggataṃ [T 2.0402] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

2. An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of root condition—in dependence on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of root condition—mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on exalted aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-produced materiality arises in dependence on exalted aggregates. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of root condition—in dependence on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (3)

3. Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

3. An immeasurable phenomenon arises in dependence on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of root condition—in dependence on one immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of root condition—mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the immeasurable aggregates. (2)

Appamāṇaṃ [M 2.0305] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and immeasurable phenomena arise in dependence on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of root condition—in dependence on one immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (3)

4. Parittañca appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

4. A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on limited and immeasurable phenomena by way of root condition—mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the immeasurable aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on both limited and exalted phenomena by way of root condition—mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the exalted aggregates and the great elements. At the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe [V 2.0349] mahaggataṃ ekaṃ [T 2.0403] khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on both limited and exalted phenomena by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one exalted aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (2)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise in dependence on both limited and exalted phenomena by way of root condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one exalted aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. Kamma-produced materiality arises in dependence on the exalted aggregates and the great elements. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

5. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

5. A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of object condition—in dependence on one limited aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. Aggregates arise in dependence on the base. (1)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted aggregates arise in dependence on the base. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition—in dependence on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking [...]. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

An immeasurable phenomenon arises in dependence on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of object condition—in dependence on one immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on both a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one exalted aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

6. Parittaṃ [M 2.0306] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – parittaṃ [T 2.0404] ekaṃ khandhaṃ [V 2.0350] paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

6. A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on a limited phenomenon by way of dominance condition: in dependence on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; in dependence on two aggregates [...]; in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise [...]; in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated derived materiality arises. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of dominance condition: in dependence on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise [...]; in dependence on two aggregates [...]. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises in dependence on an exalted phenomenon by way of dominance condition: in dependence on exalted aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of dominance condition: Dependent on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…etc.… Dependent on two aggregates…etc…. (3)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dominance condition: Dependent on one immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates…etc.… Dependent on two aggregates…etc…. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dominance condition: Dependent on immeasurable aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and immeasurable phenomena arise dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dominance condition: Dependent on one immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…etc.… Dependent on two aggregates…etc…. (3)

7. Parittañca appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

7. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and immeasurable phenomena by way of dominance condition: Dependent on immeasurable aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo [T 2.0405] uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena by way of dominance condition: Dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

8. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā (sabbepi mahābhūtā kātabbā)… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā [V 2.0351]… purejātapaccayā (tisso [M 2.0307] pañhā kātabbā)… āsevanapaccayā (tisso pañhā kātabbā)… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā (terasa pañhā)… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā,… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

8. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of contiguity condition… samanantarapaccayā… co-nascence condition (all great elements should be stated)… mutuality condition… dependence condition… strong support condition … pre-nascence condition (three questions should be stated)… repetition condition (three questions should be stated)… kamma condition… result condition (thirteen questions)… nutriment condition… faculty condition… jhāna condition… path condition,… association condition… dissociation condition… presence condition… absence condition… disappearance condition… non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Affirmative Order of Conditions.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section.

9. Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā nava, anantare pañca, samanantare pañca, sahajāte terasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye terasa, upanissaye pañca, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme terasa, vipāke terasa, āhāre indriye jhāne magge terasa, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte terasa, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā pañca, vigate pañca, avigate terasa.

9. By way of root condition, thirteen; by way of object condition, five; by way of dominance condition, nine; by way of contiguity condition, five; by way of immediate contiguity condition, five; by way of co-nascence condition, thirteen; by way of mutuality condition, seven; by way of dependence condition, thirteen; by way of strong support condition, five; by way of pre-nascence condition, three; by way of repetition condition, three; by way of kamma condition, thirteen; by way of result condition, thirteen; by way of nutriment condition, faculty condition, jhāna condition, path condition, thirteen; by way of association condition, five; by way of dissociation condition, thirteen; by way of presence condition, thirteen; by way of absence condition, five; by way of disappearance condition, five; by way of non-disappearance condition, thirteen.

Anulomaṃ.

In Forward Order.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Order of Conditions.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Distinctions.

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition.

10. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 2.0406] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

10. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of non-root condition: Dependent on one rootless limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…etc.… Dependent on two aggregates…etc.… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…etc.… dependent on aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, aggregates; dependent on one great element…etc.… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…etc.… dependent on doubt-concomitant and restlessness-concomitant aggregates, doubt-concomitant and restlessness-concomitant delusion arises. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition.

11. Parittaṃ [V 2.0352] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – paritte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe paritte khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

11. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of non-object condition: Dependent on limited aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on limited aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises; dependent on aggregates, the physical base…etc.… dependent on one great element…etc.… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…etc…. (1)

Mahaggataṃ [M 2.0308] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of non-object condition: Dependent on exalted aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of non-object condition: Dependent on immeasurable aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and immeasurable phenomena by way of non-object condition: Dependent on immeasurable aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte [T 2.0407] ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena by way of non-object condition: Dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-Dominance Condition.

12. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

12. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on one limited aggregate, three aggregates arise…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc.… dependent on aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, aggregates arise; dependent on one great element…etc.… for non-percipient beings…etc. (1)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, exalted aggregates arise. (2)

Parittaṃ [V 2.0353] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, exalted aggregates arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

13. Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca mahaggatādhipati, vipākaṃ mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

13. An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on exalted aggregates, exalted dominance arises; dependent on one resultant exalted aggregate…etc.… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vipāke mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon not by way of dominance condition: dependent on resultant exalted aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates, kamma-produced material form arises. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on an exalted phenomenon not by way of dominance condition: dependent on one resultant exalted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (3)

14. Appamāṇaṃ [T 2.0408][M 2.0309] dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca appamāṇādhipati. (1)

14. An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon not by way of dominance condition: dependent on immeasurable aggregates, immeasurable dominance arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vipāke mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of dominance condition: dependent on resultant exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-produced material form arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of dominance condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of dominance condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-produced material form arises. (3)

Naanantarapaccayādi

Not by way of contiguity condition, and so on.

15. Parittaṃ [V 2.0354] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā.

15. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon not by way of contiguity condition… not by way of immediate contiguity condition… not by way of mutuality condition… not by way of strong support condition.

Napurejātapaccayo

Not by way of prenascence condition.

16. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paritte khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… (sabbe mahābhūtā vitthāretabbā, arūpe parittamūlake tisso pañhā).

16. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one limited aggregate, three aggregates arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … dependent on limited aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … (all the great elements should be expanded; in the immaterial sphere, with a limited root, there are three questions).

Mahaggataṃ [T 2.0409] dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: dependent on one exalted aggregate… and so on … at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: dependent on exalted aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates, kamma-produced material form arises. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on an exalted phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on. (3)

17. Appamāṇaṃ [M 2.0310] dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (1)

17. An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one immeasurable aggregate… and so on. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.(2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon not by way of prenascence condition: dependent on immeasurable aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. (2)

Parittañca [V 2.0355] appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and immeasurable phenomena not by way of prenascence condition: dependent on immeasurable aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (3)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of prenascence condition: dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on. (2)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā [T 2.0410] – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on limited and exalted phenomena not by way of prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-produced material form arises. (3)

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Not by way of post-nascence condition, and so on.

18. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….(1)

18. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon not by way of post-nascence condition… not by way of repetition condition: dependent on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise… and so on … dependent on two aggregates… and so on … at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on … dependent on aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, aggregates; dependent on one great element… and so on … for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element… and so on. (1)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon not by way of repetition condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted aggregates arise dependent on the physical base. (2)

Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca mahaggatā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on a limited phenomenon not by way of repetition condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted aggregates arise dependent on the physical base; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced material form arises. (3)

19. Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ mahaggataṃ [V 2.0356] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1) Mahaggataṃ [M 2.0311] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

19. An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on one resultant exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise… (1) A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on exalted aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 2.0411] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on one resultant exalted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate… (3)

20. Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

20. An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on one resultant immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on immeasurable aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe…. (3)

Both limited and immeasurable phenomena arise dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on one resultant immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… (3)

21. Parittañca appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

21. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited and an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on immeasurable aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. Dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe [V 2.0357] mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates… (2)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo [T 2.0412] khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-repetition condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one exalted aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

Nakammapaccayo

Non-kamma condition.

22. Parittaṃ [M 2.0312] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – paritte khandhe paṭicca parittā cetanā. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

22. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition. Dependent on limited aggregates, limited volition arises. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… dependent on one great element… (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca mahaggatā cetanā. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition. Dependent on exalted aggregates, exalted volition arises. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kusale appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca appamāṇā cetanā. (1)

An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition. Dependent on wholesome immeasurable aggregates, immeasurable volition arises. (1)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-result condition.

23. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

23. A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on one limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on one great element, three great elements arise… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element… (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

An exalted phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates arise… dependent on two aggregates… (1)

Mahaggataṃ [V 2.0358] dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on exalted aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā uppajjanti navipākapaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 2.0413] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and exalted phenomena arise dependent on an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on one exalted aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… (3)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kusalaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

An immeasurable phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on one wholesome immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates arise… (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kusale appamāṇe khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on wholesome immeasurable aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti navipākapaccayā – kusalaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Both limited and immeasurable phenomena arise dependent on an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on one wholesome immeasurable aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… dependent on two aggregates… (3)

Parittañca [M 2.0313] appamāṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kusale appamāṇe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited and an immeasurable phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on wholesome immeasurable aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Parittañca mahaggatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon arises dependent on a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of the non-result condition. Dependent on exalted aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Naāhārapaccayādi

Non-nutriment condition, etc.

24. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ (vitthāretabbaṃ)… naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ, najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ [V 2.0359]…pe… (sabbe mahābhūtā kātabbā), namaggapaccayā [T 2.0414] – ahetukaṃ parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe ekaṃ…pe… (sabbe mahābhūtā kātabbā) nasampayuttapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe….

24. Conditioned by a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises not by way of nutriment condition—external… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings (to be elaborated)… not by way of faculty condition—external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings… conditioned by the great elements, the material life faculty; not by way of jhāna condition—one aggregate accompanied by the fivefold consciousness… external… for non-percipient beings, one great element… (all great elements should be treated likewise); not by way of path condition—one rootless limited aggregate… at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one… (all great elements should be treated likewise); not by way of association condition… not by way of dissociation condition—in the formless realm, conditioned by one limited aggregate, three aggregates… two aggregates… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings…

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggato dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe…. (1)

Conditioned by an exalted phenomenon, an exalted phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the formless realm, one exalted aggregate… (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ…pe… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

Conditioned by an immeasurable phenomenon, an immeasurable phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition—in the formless realm, one immeasurable aggregate… not by way of absence condition… not by way of disappearance condition.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Conditional-Negative Section

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

25. Nahetuyā ekaṃ, naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā dasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte dvādasa, napacchājāte terasa, naāsevane terasa, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye najhāne namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

25. Not by way of root condition: one; not by way of object condition: five; not by way of dominance condition: ten; not by way of proximity condition: five; not by way of contiguity condition: five; not by way of mutuality condition, not by way of support condition: five; not by way of prenascence condition: twelve; not by way of postnascence condition: thirteen; not by way of repetition condition: thirteen; not by way of kamma condition: three; not by way of result condition: nine; not by way of nutriment condition: one; not by way of faculty condition, not by way of jhāna condition, not by way of path condition: one; not by way of association condition: five; not by way of dissociation condition: three; not by way of absence condition: five; not by way of disappearance condition: five (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Conditional Affirmative-Negative Section

26. Hetupaccayā [M 2.0314] naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā dasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare naaññamaññe naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte [T 2.0415] dvādasa, napacchājāte terasa, naāsevane [V 2.0360] terasa, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke nava, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

26. By way of root condition, not by way of object condition: five; not by way of dominance condition: ten; not by way of proximity condition: five; not by way of contiguity condition, not by way of mutuality condition, not by way of support condition: five; not by way of prenascence condition: twelve; not by way of postnascence condition: thirteen; not by way of repetition condition: thirteen; not by way of kamma condition: three; not by way of result condition: nine; not by way of association condition: five; not by way of dissociation condition: three; not by way of absence condition: five; not by way of disappearance condition: five (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Conditional Negative-Affirmative Section

27. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ…pe… vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

27. Not by way of root condition, by way of object condition: one; by way of proximity condition: one… by way of disappearance condition: one; by way of non-disappearance condition: one (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Affirmative

Paṭiccavāro.

The Section on Conditionality

3. The Section on Conditions

1. The Conditional Affirmative

1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

28. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā parittā khandhā. (1)

28. Conditioned by a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises by way of root condition—conditioned by one limited aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… conditioned by the aggregates, the physical basis; conditioned by the physical basis, the aggregates; conditioned by one great element… derived materiality; conditioned by the physical basis, limited aggregates. (1)

Parittaṃ [V 2.0361] dhammaṃ paccayā mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā mahaggatā khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā mahaggatā khandhā. (2)

Naanantarapaccayādi

Not by Immediate Contiguity Condition, etc.

38. A limited phenomenon arises conditioned by a limited phenomenon, but not by way of Immediate Contiguity Condition… not by way of Contiguity Condition… not by way of Reciprocity Condition… not by way of Strong Support Condition… not by way of Prenascence Condition… (twelve questions similar to the Paṭiccavāra) not by way of Postnascence Condition… not by way of Repetition Condition… (complete; ‘resultant’ should be specified, but mind-originated form is not to be treated as resultant) not by way of Kamma Condition… not by way of Resultant Condition… (the rebirth-linking resultant is also not present) not by way of Nutriment Condition… not by way of Faculty Condition… not by way of Jhāna Condition… not by way of Path Condition… not by way of Association Condition… not by way of Dissociation Condition… not by way of Absence Condition… not by way of Vanishing Condition.
