Napacchājāta-naāsevanapaccayā

The Non-Postnascence and Non-Repetition Conditions

48. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho paritto dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

48. Associated with a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises by way of non-postnascence condition… by way of non-repetition condition—three aggregates associated with one limited aggregate… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho mahaggato dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…[T 2.0424]. (1)

Associated with an exalted phenomenon, an exalted phenomenon arises by way of non-repetition condition—three aggregates associated with one resultant exalted aggregate… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Associated with an immeasurable phenomenon, an immeasurable phenomenon arises by way of non-repetition condition—three aggregates associated with one resultant immeasurable aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Nakammapaccayo

The Non-Kamma Condition

49. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho paritto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – paritte khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā parittā cetanā. (1)

49. Associated with a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises by way of non-kamma condition—limited volitions associated with limited aggregates. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho mahaggato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – mahaggate khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā mahaggatā cetanā. (1)

Associated with an exalted phenomenon, an exalted phenomenon arises by way of non-kamma condition—exalted volitions associated with exalted aggregates. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ [V 2.0370] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kusale appamāṇe khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā appamāṇā cetanā. (1)

Associated with an immeasurable phenomenon, an immeasurable phenomenon arises by way of non-kamma condition—immeasurable volitions associated with wholesome immeasurable aggregates. (1)

Navipākapaccayo

The Non-Result Condition

50. Parittaṃ [M 2.0322] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho paritto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

50. Associated with a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises by way of non-result condition—three aggregates associated with one limited aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho mahaggato dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Associated with an exalted phenomenon, an exalted phenomenon arises by way of non-result condition—three aggregates associated with one exalted aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kusalaṃ appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Associated with an immeasurable phenomenon, an immeasurable phenomenon arises by way of non-result condition—three aggregates associated with one wholesome immeasurable aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Najhānapaccayādi

The Non-Jhāna Condition, etc.

51. Parittaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho paritto dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā… namaggapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe parittaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

51. Associated with a limited phenomenon, a limited phenomenon arises by way of non-jhāna condition… by way of non-path condition… by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, three aggregates associated with one limited aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho mahaggato dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe mahaggataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Associated with an exalted phenomenon, an exalted phenomenon arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, three aggregates associated with one exalted aggregate… and so on…. (1)

Appamāṇaṃ [T 2.0425] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe appamāṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

Associated with an immeasurable phenomenon, an immeasurable phenomenon arises by way of non-dissociation condition—in the immaterial sphere, three aggregates associated with one immeasurable aggregate… and so on…. (1)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Conditional Relations

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

52. Nahetuyā [V 2.0371] ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

52. Not by way of root condition: one; not by way of dominance condition: three; not by way of prenascence condition: three; not by way of postnascence condition: three; not by way of repetition condition: three; not by way of kamma condition: three; not by way of result condition: three; not by way of jhāna condition: one; not by way of path condition: one; not by way of dissociation condition: three (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative of Conditions.

53. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte napacchājāte naāsevane nakamme navipāke navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇatabbaṃ).

53. By way of root condition, not by way of dominance condition: three. Not by way of prenascence condition, not by way of postnascence condition, not by way of repetition condition, not by way of kamma condition, not by way of result condition, not by way of dissociation condition: three (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative Mode.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative of Conditions.

54. Nahetupaccayā [M 2.0323] ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ…pe… avigate eka (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

54. Not by way of root condition, by way of object condition: one; by way of contiguity condition: one… by way of non-disappearance condition: one (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Affirmative Mode.

Saṃsaṭṭhavāro.

The Chapter on Association.

6. Sampayuttavāro

6. The Chapter on Concomitance.

(Sampayuttavāro [V 2.0372] saṃsaṭṭhavārasadiso).

(The Chapter on Concomitance is similar to the Chapter on Association.)

7. Pañhāvāro

7. The Chapter on Questions.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Affirmative of Conditions.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

55. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parittā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

55. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of root condition—limited roots are a condition for the concomitant aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (1)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā).

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of root condition… three (to be applied to the course of existence and rebirth-linking).

Appamāṇo [T 2.0426] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of root condition… three.

Ārammaṇapaccayo

The Object Condition.

56. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ… paritte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassanti assādenti abhinandanti, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati [V 2.0373] …pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

56. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of object condition—having given a gift, undertaken virtue, performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on that; one reflects on good deeds previously done; noble ones reflect on change-of-lineage, reflect on purification, reflect on abandoned defilements, reflect on suppressed defilements, know defilements previously accumulated. The eye… the base… they discern limited aggregates as impermanent… they savor and delight in them; taking that as object, lust arises… grief arises. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. (1)

Paritto [M 2.0324] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena parittacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Parittā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition—with the divine eye, one sees a form; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound; with the knowledge of penetration of minds, one knows the mind of one who possesses a limited mind. Limited aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, and the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

57. Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetopariyañāṇena mahaggatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0427]. Mahaggatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

57. An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition—with the knowledge of penetration of minds, one knows the mind of one who possesses an exalted mind; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. Exalted aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, and the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paccavekkhati…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ paccavekkhati, iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Mahaggate khandhe aniccato…pe… vippassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of object condition—one reviews the first jhāna… reviews the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, reviews the divine eye, reviews the divine ear element, reviews the knowledge of psychic power, reviews the knowledge of penetration of minds, reviews the knowledge of recollection of past lives, reviews the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their kamma, reviews the knowledge of the future. They discern exalted aggregates as impermanent… they savor and delight in them; taking that as object, lust arises… grief arises. (2)

58. Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

58. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of object condition—Nibbāna is a condition for the path and for the fruit by way of object condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of object condition—noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, and for advertence by way of object condition. (2)

Appamāṇo [V 2.0374] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā cetopariyañāṇena appamāṇacittasamaṅgissa [T 2.0428] cittaṃ jānanti, appamāṇā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition—noble ones, with the knowledge of penetration of minds, know the mind of one who possesses an immeasurable mind; immeasurable aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of penetration of minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, and the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition.

59. Paritto [M 2.0325] dhammo parittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ… paritte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – parittādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

59. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascent dominance. Object-dominance—having given a gift, undertaken virtue, performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that, holding it in high esteem; one reflects upon good deeds previously done, holding them in high esteem. Trainees reflect on change-of-lineage, holding it in high esteem; they reflect on purification, holding it in high esteem. The eye… the base… one savors and delights in limited aggregates, holding them in high esteem; holding that in high esteem, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascent dominance—a limited dominant factor is a condition for the concomitant aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – mahaggatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance—the exalted dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ…pe… dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Mahaggate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati… diṭṭhi [T 2.0429] uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – mahaggatādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascent dominance. Object-dominance: having esteemed the first jhāna…pe… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception…pe… the divine eye…pe… the knowledge of the future, one reviews them. Having esteemed the exalted aggregates, one savors and delights in them; esteeming them, lust arises… wrong view arises. Co-nascent dominance: the exalted dominance is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – mahaggatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for both a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: the exalted dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (3)

60. Appamāṇo [V 2.0375] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa… phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – appamāṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

60. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascent dominance. Object-dominance: Nibbāna is a condition for the path… for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: the immeasurable dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo[M 2.0326]. Sahajātādhipati – appamāṇādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascent dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path with esteem, review the fruit with esteem, review Nibbāna with esteem; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: the immeasurable dominance is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – appamāṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena [T 2.0430] paccayo. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for both a limited and an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascent dominance: the immeasurable dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediately Contiguous Condition

61. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parittā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… āvajjanā parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

61. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the preceding limited aggregates are a condition for the succeeding limited aggregates by way of immediately contiguous condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification… adverting is a condition for the limited aggregates by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – parittaṃ cuticittaṃ mahaggatassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Parittā khandhā mahaggatassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ…pe… dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the limited death consciousness is a condition for the exalted rebirth consciousness by way of immediately contiguous condition. The limited aggregates are a condition for the exalted emergence by way of immediately contiguous condition. The preparatory consciousness for the first jhāna…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the divine eye…pe… the preparatory consciousness for the knowledge of the future is a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Paritto [V 2.0376] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path… adaptation is a condition for fruition attainment by way of immediately contiguous condition. (3)

62. Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā mahaggatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

62. An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the preceding exalted aggregates are a condition for the succeeding exalted aggregates by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [T 2.0431] – mahaggataṃ cuticittaṃ parittassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Mahaggataṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Mahaggatā khandhā parittassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the exalted death consciousness is a condition for the limited rebirth consciousness by way of immediately contiguous condition. The exalted life-continuum is a condition for adverting by way of immediately contiguous condition. The exalted aggregates are a condition for the limited emergence by way of immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Mahaggato [M 2.0327] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the fruition attainment of one emerging from cessation by way of immediately contiguous condition. (3)

63. Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā appamāṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

63. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the preceding immeasurable aggregates are a condition for the succeeding immeasurable aggregates by way of immediately contiguous condition. The path is a condition for the fruit… the fruit is a condition for the fruit by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – phalaṃ parittassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the fruit is a condition for the limited emergence by way of immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – phalaṃ mahaggatassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition—the fruit is a condition for the exalted emergence by way of immediately contiguous condition. (3)

(Samanantarapaccayaṃ anantarapaccayasadisaṃ.)

(The contiguity condition is similar to the immediately contiguous condition.)

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

64. Paritto [V 2.0377] dhammo parittassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paritto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa, vatthu khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ [T 2.0432] mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

64. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition—one limited aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of co-nascence condition…pe… two aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… the aggregates are a condition for the base, the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of co-nascence condition; one great element…pe… for non-percipient beings…pe…. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The limited state is a condition for the exalted state by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

65. Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

65. The exalted state is a condition for the exalted state by way of the co-nascence condition—one exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates…etc… two aggregates…etc… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc…. (1)

Mahaggato [M 2.0328] dhammo parittassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The exalted state is a condition for the limited state by way of the co-nascence condition—the exalted aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the exalted aggregates are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

The exalted state is a condition for both the limited and exalted states by way of the co-nascence condition—one exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition...etc... two aggregates...etc... at the moment of rebirth-linking...etc.... (3)

66. Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

66. The immeasurable state is a condition for the immeasurable state by way of the co-nascence condition—one immeasurable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition...etc.... (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The immeasurable state is a condition for the limited state by way of the co-nascence condition—the immeasurable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo [V 2.0378] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

The immeasurable state is a condition for the limited and immeasurable states by way of the co-nascence condition—one immeasurable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition...etc.... (3)

67. Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena [T 2.0433] paccayo. (1)

67. Both the limited and immeasurable states are a condition for the limited state by way of the co-nascence condition—the immeasurable aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Both the limited and exalted states are a condition for the limited state by way of the co-nascence condition—the exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (2)

Both the limited and exalted states are a condition for the exalted state by way of the co-nascence condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one exalted aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition…etc…. (2)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutual condition.

68. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paritto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. (1)

68. The limited phenomenon is a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of mutual condition—one limited aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…etc… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc… the aggregates are a condition for the base…etc… the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of mutual condition; one great element…etc… for non-percipient beings…etc…. (1)

Paritto [M 2.0329] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (2)

The limited phenomenon is a condition for the exalted phenomenon by way of mutual condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of mutual condition…etc…. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

The exalted phenomenon is a condition for the exalted phenomenon by way of mutual condition—one exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…etc… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc…. (1)

Mahaggato [V 2.0379] dhammo parittassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 2.0434] mahaggatā khandhā vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The exalted phenomenon is a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of mutual condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, the exalted aggregates are a condition for the base by way of mutual condition. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

The exalted phenomenon is a condition for both the limited and exalted phenomena by way of mutual condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and the base by way of mutual condition…etc…. (3)

Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

The immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for the immeasurable phenomenon by way of mutual condition—one immeasurable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…etc… two aggregates…etc…. (1)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

Both the limited and exalted phenomena are a condition for the exalted phenomenon by way of mutual condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one exalted aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of mutual condition…etc…. (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Dependence condition.

69. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – paritto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa… vatthu parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one limited aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition…etc… two aggregates…etc… at the moment of rebirth-linking…etc… the aggregates are a condition for the base…etc… the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dependence condition…etc… one great element…etc… for non-percipient beings, one great element…etc… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…etc… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the limited aggregates by way of dependence condition. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of dependence condition—the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of dependence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of dependence condition. (2)

Paritto [T 2.0435] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dependence condition—the base is a condition for the immeasurable aggregates by way of dependence condition. (3)

70. Mahaggato [M 2.0330][V 2.0380] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

70. An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one exalted aggregate for three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of relinking… and so on. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dependence condition—exalted aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition. At the moment of relinking, exalted aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of dependence condition. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited and an exalted phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one exalted aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on… at the moment of relinking… and so on. (3)

71. Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

71. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one immeasurable aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of dependence condition… and so on. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dependence condition—immeasurable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon and for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one immeasurable aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition… and so on. (3)

Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A limited and an immeasurable phenomenon are a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dependence condition—immeasurable aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition. (1)

Paritto [T 2.0436] ca appamāṇo ca dhammā appamāṇassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (2)

A limited and an immeasurable phenomenon are a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one immeasurable aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates by way of dependence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Paritto [V 2.0381] ca mahaggato ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A limited and an exalted phenomenon are a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of dependence condition—exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dependence condition. At the moment of relinking, exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of dependence condition. (1)

Paritto [M 2.0331] ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (2)

Limited and exalted phenomena are a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of dependence condition—one exalted aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates by way of dependence condition… and so on… At the moment of relinking, one exalted aggregate and the physical basis are a condition for three aggregates by way of dependence condition… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition.

72. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parittaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, parittaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathaṃ…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Parittā saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ parittāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya[T 2.0437], rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ). Mātughātikammaṃ mātughātikammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo (cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ kusalattikasadisaṃ). (1)

72. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support—relying on limited faith, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses insight, indulges in conceit, grasps a view; relying on limited virtue… and so on… wisdom… lust… aspiration… bodily pleasure… lodging, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue… observes the Uposatha… arouses insight, kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha. Limited faith… and so on… wisdom, lust… aspiration, bodily pleasure… lodging is a condition for limited faith… and so on… wisdom, for lust… aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. Wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of decisive support condition. Killing living beings is a condition for killing living beings by way of decisive support condition (the wheel should be completed). Matricide is a condition for matricide by way of decisive support condition (the wheel should be completed, similar to the wholesome triad). (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parittaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ mahaggatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena [V 2.0382] paccayo. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ…pe…. (2)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support—relying on limited faith, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment. Relying on limited virtue… and so on… wisdom… lust… lodging, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment. Limited faith… and so on… lodging is a condition for exalted faith… and so on… wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the first jhāna… and so on… the preliminary work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the divine eye… and so on… the preliminary work for knowledge of the future… and so on. (2)

Paritto dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo parittaṃ [M 2.0332] saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ appamāṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya, maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa [T 2.0438] maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support: relying on limited faith, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Relying on limited virtue, etc., wisdom, etc., lust, etc., aspiration, etc., bodily pleasure, etc., lodging, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Limited faith, etc., lodging is a condition for immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom, for the path, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the first path is a condition for the first path, etc., the preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (3)

73. Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mahaggataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mahaggatā saddhā…pe… paññā mahaggatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on exalted faith, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment. Relying on exalted virtue, etc., wisdom, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment. Exalted faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for exalted faith, etc., wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The first jhāna is a condition for the second jhāna, etc., the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, mahaggataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… vipassanaṃ uppādeti…pe… mahaggatā saddhā…pe… paññā parittāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya…pe… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on exalted faith, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses insight, indulges in conceit, or grasps a view. Relying on exalted virtue, etc., wisdom, one gives gifts, etc., arouses insight, etc. Exalted faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for limited faith, etc., wisdom, etc., bodily pleasure and bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Mahaggato [V 2.0383] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggataṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti[T 2.0439]. Mahaggataṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mahaggatā saddhā…pe… paññā appamāṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on exalted faith, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Relying on exalted virtue, etc., wisdom, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Exalted faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom, for the path, and for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (3)

74. Appamāṇo [M 2.0333] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya appamāṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇā saddhā…pe… paññā appamāṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa… maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on immeasurable faith, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Relying on immeasurable virtue, etc., wisdom, one produces immeasurable jhāna, the path, and fruition attainment. Immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The first path is a condition for the second path, etc., the third path is a condition for the fourth path, and the path is a condition for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ… vipassanaṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ… vipassanaṃ… appamāṇā saddhā…pe… paññā parittāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya…pe… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya [T 2.0440] saṅkhāre aniccato…pe… vipassanti, maggo ariyānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya…pe… paṭibhānappaṭisambhidāya… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on immeasurable faith, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, etc., observes the Uposatha, and arouses insight. Relying on immeasurable virtue, etc., wisdom, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, etc., observes the Uposatha, arouses insight, etc. Immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for limited faith, etc., wisdom, etc., bodily pleasure and bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. Fruition attainment is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of decisive support condition. The noble ones, relying on the path, contemplate formations as impermanent, etc. The path is a condition for the noble ones' analytical knowledge of meaning, etc., analytical knowledge of the Dhamma, analytical knowledge of language, analytical knowledge of ready wit, and skill in what is possible and impossible by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, appamāṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya [V 2.0384] mahaggataṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇā saddhā…pe… paññā mahaggatāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo, ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpajjanti. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, etc. Natural decisive support—relying on immeasurable faith, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment; relying on immeasurable virtue, etc., wisdom, one produces exalted jhāna, direct knowledge, and attainment. Immeasurable faith, etc., wisdom is a condition for exalted faith, etc., wisdom by way of decisive support condition. The noble ones, relying on the path, produce unarisen attainments and attain to arisen ones. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence condition

75. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… [M 2.0334] vipassati assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa… vatthu parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One discerns the eye as impermanent…pe… savors it, rejoices in it; taking that as object, lust arises…pe… grief arises. The ear…pe… the base is discerned as impermanent…pe… grief arises. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible-object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence. Base pre-nascence: The eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the limited aggregates by way of pre-nascence. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo [T 2.0441] – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence and base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: One sees a form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear-element. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of pre-nascence. (2)

Paritto dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an immeasurable dhamma by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: The base is a condition for the immeasurable aggregates by way of pre-nascence. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

76. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā parittā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

76. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of post-nascence condition: The post-nascent limited aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā mahaggatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of post-nascence condition: The post-nascent exalted aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Appamāṇo [V 2.0385] dhammo parittassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā appamāṇā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of post-nascence condition: The post-nascent immeasurable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

77. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parittā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

77. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of repetition condition: The preceding limited aggregates are a condition for the succeeding limited aggregates…pe… adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage, adaptation is a condition for purification, by way of repetition condition. (1)

Paritto [M 2.0335] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ tasseva paṭhamassa jhānassa (?) āsevanapaccayena paccayo…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ tasseva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa (?) aññesu tikesu oloketabbaṃ āsevanapaccayena [T 2.0442] paccayo. Dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of repetition condition: The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition for that same jhāna by way of repetition condition…pe… the preliminary work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for that same base by way of repetition condition. The preliminary work for the divine eye…pe… the preliminary work for knowledge of the future is a condition for knowledge of the future by way of repetition condition. (2)

Paritto dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an immeasurable dhamma by way of repetition condition: Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (3)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā mahaggatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of repetition condition: The preceding exalted aggregates are a condition for the succeeding exalted aggregates…pe… by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

78. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – parittā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – parittā cetanā vipākānaṃ parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

78. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of kamma condition—conascence and different-moment. Conascence: Limited volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, limited volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: Limited volition is a condition for the resultant limited aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (1)

Mahaggato [V 2.0386] dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – mahaggatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – mahaggatā cetanā vipākānaṃ mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena [T 2.0443] paccayo. (1)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of kamma condition—conascence and different-moment. Conascence: Exalted volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: Exalted volition is a condition for the resultant exalted aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – mahaggatā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – mahaggatā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of kamma condition—conascence and different-moment. Conascence: Exalted volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted volition is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: Exalted volition is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

Mahaggato [M 2.0336] dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – mahaggatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – mahaggatā cetanā vipākānaṃ mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma and for an exalted dhamma by way of kamma condition—conascence and different-moment. Conascence: Exalted volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, exalted volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. Different-moment: Exalted volition is a condition for the resultant exalted aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

79. Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – appamāṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – appamāṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

79. An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for an immeasurable dhamma by way of kamma condition—conascence and at different moments. Conascence: Immeasurable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At different moments: Immeasurable volition is a condition for the resultant immeasurable aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0444]. (2)

An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of kamma condition: Immeasurable volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – appamāṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma and an immeasurable dhamma by way of kamma condition: Immeasurable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Resultant Condition

80. Paritto [V 2.0387] dhammo parittassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko paritto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

80. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of resultant condition. A limited resultant one aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of resultant condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates are a condition for the base by way of resultant condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… (tisso pañhā, pavattipaṭisandhi kātabbā). (3)

An exalted dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of resultant condition… (three questions, to be treated under occurrence and rebirth-linking). (3)

Appamāṇo dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (pavattimeva).

An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for an immeasurable dhamma by way of resultant condition… three (only in the course of life).

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

81. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo…pe… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena [M 2.0337] paccayo… vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – parittā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ [T 2.0445] kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – parittā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: The limited aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the limited aggregates are a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of dissociation condition. The aggregates are a condition for the base… the base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The base is a condition for the limited aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: The limited aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of dissociation condition—conascence and prenascence. Conascence: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Paritto [V 2.0388] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an immeasurable dhamma by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The base is a condition for the immeasurable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

82. Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – mahaggatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… pacchājātā – mahaggatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

82. An exalted dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of dissociation condition—conascence and postnascence. Conascence: The exalted aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… Postnascence: The exalted aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – appamāṇā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appamāṇā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0446]. (1)

An immeasurable dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of dissociation condition—conascence and postnascence. Conascence: The immeasurable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: The immeasurable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

83. Paritto dhammo parittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – paritto eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhā vatthussa atthipaccayena [M 2.0338] paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… vipassati assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu parittānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – parittā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. A limited dhamma is a condition for a limited dhamma by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascence: A limited one aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the aggregates are a condition for the base by way of presence condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates by way of presence condition; one great element… for non-percipient beings… Prenascence: The eye… the base is contemplated as impermanent… one delights in and rejoices in it; taking that as object, lust arises… grief arises. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible-object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the base is a condition for the limited aggregates by way of presence condition. Postnascence: The limited aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. Physical food is a condition for this body by way of presence condition. The material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ [V 2.0389] – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, vatthu mahaggatānaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 2.0447] atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited dhamma is a condition for an exalted dhamma by way of presence condition—conascence and prenascence. Conascence: At the moment of rebirth-linking, the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of presence condition. Prenascence: One sees a form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear-element; the base is a condition for the exalted aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

Paritto dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu appamāṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The limited phenomenon is a condition for the measureless phenomenon by way of presence-condition. Pre-nascent: The base is a condition for the measureless aggregates by way of presence-condition. (3)

84. Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

84. The exalted phenomenon is a condition for the exalted phenomenon by way of presence-condition. One exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – mahaggatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – mahaggatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The exalted phenomenon is a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent: The exalted aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the exalted aggregates are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The exalted aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence-condition. (2)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – mahaggato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

The exalted phenomenon is a condition for both the limited and the exalted phenomena by way of presence-condition—one exalted aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (3)

85. Appamāṇo [M 2.0339] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

85. The measureless phenomenon is a condition for the measureless phenomenon by way of presence-condition—one measureless aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates…. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – appamāṇā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [T 2.0448] rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appamāṇā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The measureless phenomenon is a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent: The measureless aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The measureless aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of presence-condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – appamāṇo [V 2.0390] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

The measureless phenomenon is a condition for both the limited and the measureless phenomena by way of presence-condition—one measureless aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition…. (3)

86. Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – appamāṇā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appamāṇā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – appamāṇā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

86. The limited and measureless phenomena are a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent: The measureless aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The measureless aggregates and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The measureless aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of presence-condition. (1)

Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā appamāṇassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – appamāṇo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (2)

The limited and measureless phenomena are a condition for the measureless phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: One measureless aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence-condition… two aggregates…. (2)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ [T 2.0449] atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – mahaggatā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – mahaggatā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

The limited and exalted phenomena are a condition for the limited phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent: The exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence-condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the exalted aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The exalted aggregates and edible food are a condition for this body by way of presence-condition. Post-nascent: The exalted aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for kamma-born material phenomena by way of presence-condition. (1)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe [M 2.0340] mahaggato eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca…pe… natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The limited and exalted phenomena are a condition for the exalted phenomenon by way of presence-condition—co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent: One exalted aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence-condition… two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth-linking, one exalted aggregate and the base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence-condition… two aggregates and the base… by way of absence-condition… by way of disappearance-condition… by way of non-disappearance-condition. (2)
