1. The Positive Sequence

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

87. Hetuyā [V 2.0391] satta, ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā satta, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte ekādasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye terasa, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane cattāri, kamme satta, vipāke āhāre indriye jhāne magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate terasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

87. By root condition, seven; by object condition, seven; by predominance condition, seven; by proximity condition, nine; by contiguity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, eleven; by mutuality condition, seven; by support condition, thirteen; by decisive support condition, nine; by pre-nascence condition, three; by post-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, four; by kamma condition, seven; by result condition, seven; by nutriment condition, seven; by faculty condition, seven; by jhāna condition, seven; by path condition, seven; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, thirteen; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, thirteen (thus should be reckoned).

Anulomaṃ.

The Positive Sequence.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Section on the Negative

88. Paritto [T 2.0450] dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

88. A limited phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Paritto dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Paritto dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A limited phenomenon is a condition for a measureless phenomenon by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Mahaggato dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0392]… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by object condition… by co-nascence condition … by decisive support condition… by post-nascence condition… by kamma condition. (2)

Mahaggato [M 2.0341] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by decisive support condition. (3)

Mahaggato dhammo parittassa ca mahaggatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (4)

An exalted phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon and an exalted phenomenon by co-nascence condition… by kamma condition. (4)

89. Appamāṇo [T 2.0451] dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an immeasurable phenomenon by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition. (1)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by post-nascence condition. (2)

Appamāṇo dhammo mahaggatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for an exalted phenomenon by object condition… by decisive support condition. (3)

Appamāṇo dhammo parittassa ca appamāṇassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

An immeasurable phenomenon is a condition for a limited phenomenon and an immeasurable phenomenon by co-nascence condition. (4)

Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (1)

A limited phenomenon and an immeasurable phenomenon are conditions for a limited phenomenon by co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (1)

Paritto ca appamāṇo ca dhammā appamāṇassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (2)

A limited phenomenon and an immeasurable phenomenon are conditions for an immeasurable phenomenon by co-nascence and pre-nascence. (2)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā parittassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (1)

Limited and exalted phenomena are conditions for a limited phenomenon by co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (1)

Paritto ca mahaggato ca dhammā mahaggatassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (2)

Limited and exalted phenomena are conditions for an exalted phenomenon by co-nascence and pre-nascence. (2)

90. Nahetuyā [V 2.0393] pannarasa, naārammaṇe pannarasa, naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare pannarasa, nasahajāte dvādasa, naaññamaññe dvādasa, nanissaye dvādasa, naupanissaye cuddasa, napurejāte [T 2.0452] cuddasa, napacchājāte pannarasa, naāsevane pannarasa…pe… namagge pannarasa, nasampayutte dvādasa, navippayutte dasa, noatthiyā dasa, nonatthiyā pannarasa, novigate pannarasa, noavigate dasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

90. Fifteen are not by root condition; fifteen are not by object condition; fifteen are not by predominance condition, not by immediately proximate condition, not by contiguity condition; twelve are not by co-nascence condition; twelve are not by mutuality condition; twelve are not by support condition; fourteen are not by decisive support condition; fourteen are not by pre-nascence condition; fifteen are not by post-nascence condition; fifteen are not by repetition condition…pe… fifteen are not by path condition; twelve are not by association condition; ten are not by dissociation condition; ten are not by presence condition; fifteen are not by absence condition; fifteen are not by disappearance condition; ten are not by non-disappearance condition (thus should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative Section

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

91. Hetupaccayā [M 2.0342] naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta…pe… namagge satta, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

91. Seven are by way of root condition, but not by way of object condition; seven are not by way of predominance condition, not by way of immediately proximate condition, not by way of contiguity condition; three are not by way of mutuality condition; seven are not by way of decisive support condition; seven are not by way of pre-nascence condition…pe… seven are not by way of path condition; three are not by way of association condition; three are not by way of dissociation condition; seven are not by way of absence condition; seven are not by way of disappearance condition (thus should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Affirmative-Negative

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

92. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā satta, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte ekādasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye terasa, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte [V 2.0394] tīṇi, āsevane cattāri, kamme satta…pe… magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate terasa.

92. Seven are by way of non-root condition, by way of object condition; seven by way of predominance condition; nine by way of immediately proximate condition; nine by way of contiguity condition; eleven by way of co-nascence condition; seven by way of mutuality condition; thirteen by way of support condition; nine by way of decisive support condition; three by way of pre-nascence condition; three by way of post-nascence condition; four by way of repetition condition; seven by way of kamma condition…pe… seven by way of path condition; three by way of association condition; five by way of dissociation condition; thirteen by way of presence condition; nine by way of absence condition; nine by way of disappearance condition; thirteen by way of non-disappearance condition.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

Negative-Affirmative

Parittattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Limited Triad is concluded.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

1. Parittārammaṇaṃ [T 2.0453][M 2.0343][V 2.0395] dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

1. Dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object, a phenomenon with a limited object arises by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahaggatārammaṇaṃ…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate with a sublime object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, a sublime object…pe…. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of root condition—dependent on one aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

The Object Condition, and so forth.

2. Parittārammaṇaṃ [V 2.0396] dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… avigatapaccayā.

2. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of object condition… by way of predominance condition (abbreviated)… by way of non-disappearance condition.

3. Three by way of root condition, three by way of object condition, three by way of predominance condition…pe… three by way of non-disappearance condition (thus it should be counted).

Nahetupaccayo

The Non-Root Condition

4. Parittārammaṇaṃ [T 2.0454] dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve [M 2.0344] khandhā. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

4. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā, vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with a sublime object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates; dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ [V 2.0397] dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

The Non-Predominance Condition

5. Parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

5. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-predominance condition—dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of non-predominance condition—dependent on one aggregate with a sublime object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo [T 2.0455] uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-predominance condition—dependent on one aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Napurejātapaccayādi

The Non-Prenascence Condition, and so forth.

6. Parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

6. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā (mahaggatārammaṇe paṭisandhi natthi). (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one aggregate with a sublime object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates (there is no rebirth-linking with a sublime object). (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ [M 2.0345] dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā (napacchājātapaccayañca naāsevanapaccayañca naadhipatisadisaṃ).

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-prenascence condition—in the immaterial sphere, dependent on one aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates (it is not by way of postnascence condition, nor by way of repetition condition, nor is it similar to predominance condition).

Nakammapaccayo

The Non-Kamma Condition

7. Parittārammaṇaṃ [V 2.0398] dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – parittārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca parittārammaṇā cetanā. (1)

7. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-kamma condition—dependent on aggregates with a limited object, volition with a limited object arises. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – mahaggatārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of non-kamma condition—dependent on aggregates with a sublime object, volition with a sublime object arises. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo [T 2.0456] uppajjati nakammapaccayā – appamāṇārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇā cetanā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-kamma condition—dependent on aggregates with an immeasurable object, volition with an immeasurable object arises. (1)

Navipākapaccayādi

The Non-Resultant Condition, and so forth.

8. Parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paṭisandhi natthi)… najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā…namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… dve khandhā…pe….

8. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-resultant condition (there is no rebirth-linking)… by way of non-jhāna condition—dependent on one aggregate associated with five-sense consciousness, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates… by way of non-path condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking…pe… two aggregates…pe….

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with a sublime object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of non-path condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with a sublime object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-path condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates. (1)

Navippayuttapaccayo

Non-dissociation Condition.

9. Parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe parittārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

9. A phenomenon with a limited object arises dependent on a phenomenon with a limited object by way of non-dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with a limited object, three aggregates...pe.... (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe mahaggatārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon with an exalted object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an exalted object by way of non-dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with an exalted object, three aggregates...pe.... (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ [M 2.0346][V 2.0399] dhammaṃ paṭicca appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe appamāṇārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object arises dependent on a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of non-dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate with an immeasurable object, three aggregates...pe... two aggregates. (1)

2. The Numerical Section.

10. Nahetuyā [T 2.0457] tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi…pe… napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

10. Not by root, three; not by dominance, three...pe... not by prenascence, three; not by postnascence, three; not by habitual recurrence, three; not by kamma, three; not by result, three; not by jhāna, one; not by path, three; not by dissociation, three (thus should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negation.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative Section of Conditions.

11. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

11. By way of root condition: not by dominance, three; not by prenascence, three; not by postnascence, three; not by habitual recurrence, three; not by kamma, three; not by result, three; not by dissociation, three (thus should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Affirmative-Negation.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative Section of Conditions.

Nahetudukaṃ

The No-Root Dyad.

12. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge dve, sampayutte [V 2.0400] tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

12. By way of no-root condition: by object condition, three; by contiguity condition, three; by immediate contiguity condition, three; by co-nascence condition, three; by reciprocity condition, three; by support condition, three; by strong support condition, three; by prenascence condition, three; by habitual recurrence condition, two; by kamma condition, three; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, three; by faculty condition, three; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, two; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, three; by presence condition, three; by absence condition, three; by cessation condition, three; by non-cessation condition, three (thus should be reckoned).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

Negative-Affirmative.

Paṭiccavāro.

The Conditional Section.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

13. Parittārammaṇo [T 2.0458][M 2.0347] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – parittārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe parittārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

13. A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition by way of the root condition for a phenomenon with a limited object. Roots with a limited object are conditions by way of the root condition for the associated aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, roots with a limited object are conditions by way of the root condition for the associated aggregates. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – mahaggatārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

A phenomenon with an exalted object is a condition by way of the root condition for a phenomenon with an exalted object. Roots with an exalted object are conditions by way of the root condition for the associated aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking...pe.... (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – appamāṇārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition by way of the root condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object. Roots with an immeasurable object are conditions by way of the root condition for the associated aggregates. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

14. Parittārammaṇo [V 2.0401] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, ariyā parittārammaṇe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Parittārammaṇe paritte khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parittārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena parittārammaṇaparittacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Parittārammaṇā parittā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa[T 2.0459], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

14. A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of the object condition: having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it; one reflects on past good conduct; noble ones reflect on defilements abandoned with a limited object; they reflect on suppressed defilements; they know defilements previously accumulated. One contemplates limited aggregates having a limited object as impermanent, suffering, and not-self; one savors and delights in them, and based on that, lust having a limited object arises…pe… sorrow arises. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a limited consciousness having a limited object. Limited aggregates having a limited object are conditions for the knowledge of discerning minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ paccavekkhati, parittārammaṇaṃ [M 2.0348] iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Parittārammaṇe mahaggate khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha mahaggatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena parittārammaṇamahaggatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Parittārammaṇā mahaggatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with an exalted object by way of the object condition: one reflects on the divine eye, reflects on the divine ear element, reflects on the knowledge of psychic powers having a limited object, reflects on the knowledge of discerning minds…pe… reflects on the knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… reflects on the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings…pe… reflects on the knowledge of the future. One contemplates exalted aggregates having a limited object as impermanent…pe…; one savors and delights in them, and based on that, lust having an exalted object arises…pe… sorrow arises. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with an exalted consciousness having a limited object. Exalted aggregates having a limited object are conditions for the knowledge of discerning minds, the knowledge of recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (2)

15. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, mahaggatārammaṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Mahaggatārammaṇe mahaggate khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha mahaggatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena mahaggatārammaṇamahaggatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Mahaggatārammaṇā mahaggatā khandhā [T 2.0460] cetopariyañāṇassa[V 2.0402], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

15. A phenomenon with an exalted object is a condition for a phenomenon with an exalted object by way of the object condition: one reviews the base of infinite consciousness, reviews the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, reviews the knowledge of psychic powers having an exalted object, reviews the knowledge of discerning minds…pe… reviews the knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… reviews the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings…pe… reviews the knowledge of the future. One contemplates with insight the exalted aggregates having an exalted object as impermanent…pe…; one savors and delights in them, and taking that as object, lust having an exalted object arises…pe… grief arises. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with an exalted consciousness having an exalted object. Exalted aggregates having an exalted object are a condition for the knowledge of discerning minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – paṭhamajjhānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati, dibbacakkhupaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati, dibbasotadhātupaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati, iddhividhañāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā mahaggatārammaṇe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Mahaggatārammaṇe paritte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parittārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Cetopariyañāṇena mahaggatārammaṇaparittacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Mahaggatārammaṇā parittā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa[M 2.0349], anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an exalted object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of the object condition: one reviews the reviewing of the first jhāna…pe… one reviews the reviewing of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, one reviews the reviewing of the divine eye, one reviews the reviewing of the divine ear element, one reviews the reviewing of the knowledge of psychic powers…pe… one reviews the reviewing of the knowledge of discerning minds…pe… one reviews the reviewing of the knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… one reviews the reviewing of the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings…pe… one reviews the reviewing of the knowledge of the future. The noble ones review the defilements abandoned in relation to an exalted object; they review suppressed defilements; they know previously accumulated defilements. One contemplates with insight the limited aggregates having an exalted object as impermanent…pe…; one savors and delights in them, and taking that as object, lust having a limited object arises…pe… grief arises. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a limited consciousness having an exalted object. Limited aggregates having an exalted object are a condition for the knowledge of discerning minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (2)

16. Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti. Cetopariyañāṇena appamāṇārammaṇaappamāṇacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Appamāṇārammaṇā appamāṇā khandhā [T 2.0461] cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

16. A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of the object condition: noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with an immeasurable consciousness having an immeasurable object. Immeasurable aggregates having an immeasurable object are a condition for the knowledge of discerning minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, maggapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ paccavekkhanti. Appamāṇārammaṇe paritte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena appamāṇārammaṇaparittacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Appamāṇārammaṇā parittā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[V 2.0403], yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of the object condition: noble ones review the change-of-lineage, review purification, review the reviewing of the path, review the reviewing of the fruit, review the reviewing of Nibbāna. One contemplates with insight the limited aggregates having an immeasurable object as impermanent…pe…. With the knowledge of discerning minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a limited consciousness having an immeasurable object. Limited aggregates having an immeasurable object are a condition for the knowledge of discerning minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (2)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā appamāṇārammaṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇaṃ paccavekkhanti, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ paccavekkhanti, anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ paccavekkhanti. Cetopariyañāṇena appamāṇārammaṇamahaggatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ mahaggatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with an exalted object by way of the object condition: the noble ones review the knowledge of discerning minds having an immeasurable object, review the knowledge of recollection of past lives, review the knowledge of the future. With the knowledge of discerning minds, they know the mind of one endowed with an exalted consciousness having an immeasurable object. Exalted aggregates having an immeasurable object are a condition for the knowledge of discerning minds, for the knowledge of recollection of past lives, for the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of the object condition. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

17. Parittārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, parittārammaṇe paritte [M 2.0350] khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ [T 2.0462] katvā parittārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – parittārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

17. A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of the dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Having given a gift, undertaken the precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews that, holding it as important. One reviews past good deeds, holding them as important. One savors and delights in the limited aggregates with a limited object, holding them as important. Holding that as important, lust with a limited object arises, or wrong view arises. Co-nascence-dominance: A dominant factor with a limited object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ…pe… parittārammaṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Parittārammaṇe mahaggate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā mahaggatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with an exalted object by way of the dominance condition. Object-dominance: One reviews the divine eye, holding it as important; the divine ear element…pe… a knowledge of psychic powers with a limited object…pe… the knowledge of discerning minds…pe… the knowledge of recollection of past lives…pe… the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings…pe… the knowledge of the future, holding it as important. One savors and delights in the exalted aggregates with a limited object, holding them as important. Holding that as important, lust with an exalted object arises, or wrong view arises. (2)

18. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ…pe… mahaggatārammaṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ [V 2.0404] …pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Mahaggatārammaṇe mahaggate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā mahaggatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – mahaggatārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

18. A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascence-dominance. Object-dominance: One reflects on the base of the infinity of consciousness, holding it as important; on the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... on the exalted-object knowledge of psychic powers... on the knowledge of the penetration of minds... on the knowledge of the recollection of past lives... on the knowledge of the passing away and reappearing of beings according to their actions... on the knowledge of the future, holding it as important. One delights in and rejoices in the exalted aggregates that have an exalted object, holding them as important. Holding that as important, lust with an exalted object arises, or wrong view arises. Co-nascence-dominance: A dominant factor with an exalted object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – paṭhamajjhānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇapaccavekkhaṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Mahaggatārammaṇe [T 2.0463] paritte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā parittārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: One reflects on the reviewing of the first jhāna, holding it as important... on the reviewing of the knowledge of the future, holding it as important. One delights in and rejoices in the limited aggregates that have an exalted object, holding them as important. Holding that as important, lust with a limited object arises, or wrong view arises. (2)

19. Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – appamāṇārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

19. A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of dominance condition—object-dominance and co-nascence-dominance. Object-dominance: Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it as important; they review the fruit, holding it as important. Co-nascence-dominance: A dominant factor with an immeasurable object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo [M 2.0351] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, maggapaccavekkhaṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalapaccavekkhaṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (2)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: The trainees reflect on change-of-lineage, holding it as important; they reflect on purification, holding it as important; they reflect on the reviewing of the path, holding it as important; they reflect on the reviewing of the fruition, holding it as important; they reflect on the reviewing of Nibbāna, holding it as important. (2)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sekkhā appamāṇārammaṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (3)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: The trainees reflect on the knowledge of the penetration of minds with an immeasurable object, holding it as important. They reflect on the knowledge of the recollection of past lives... on the knowledge of the future, holding it as important. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

20. Parittārammaṇo [V 2.0405] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parittārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parittārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

20. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of proximity condition—preceding aggregates with a limited object are a condition for succeeding aggregates with a limited object by way of proximity condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 2.0464] paccayo – parittārammaṇaṃ cuticittaṃ mahaggatārammaṇassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Parittārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ mahaggatārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Parittārammaṇā khandhā mahaggatārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of proximity condition—the death consciousness with a limited object is a condition for the rebirth consciousness with an exalted object by way of proximity condition. The life-continuum with a limited object is a condition for the adverting with an exalted object by way of proximity condition. The aggregates with a limited object are a condition for the emergence with an exalted object by way of proximity condition. (2)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – parittārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ appamāṇārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Parittārammaṇaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition—the life-continuum with a limited object is a condition for the adverting with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition. The conformity with a limited object is a condition for change-of-lineage... conformity is a condition for purification... conformity is a condition for fruition attainment by way of proximity condition. (3)

21. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā mahaggatārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ mahaggatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

21. A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of proximity condition—preceding aggregates with an exalted object are a condition for succeeding aggregates with an exalted object by way of proximity condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ cuticittaṃ parittārammaṇassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena [M 2.0352] paccayo. Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ parittārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Mahaggatārammaṇā khandhā parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of proximity condition—the death consciousness with an exalted object is a condition for the rebirth consciousness with a limited object by way of proximity condition. The life-continuum with an exalted object is a condition for the adverting with a limited object by way of proximity condition. The aggregates with an exalted object are a condition for the emergence with a limited object by way of proximity condition. (2)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ appamāṇārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ [T 2.0465] vodānassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition—the life-continuum with an exalted object is a condition for the adverting with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition. The conformity with an exalted object is a condition for change-of-lineage... conformity is a condition for purification... conformity is a condition for fruition attainment... for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of proximity condition. (3)

22. Appamāṇārammaṇo [V 2.0406] dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā appamāṇārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ appamāṇārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition—preceding aggregates with an immeasurable object are a condition for succeeding aggregates with an immeasurable object by way of proximity condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path... purification is a condition for the path... the path is a condition for the fruit... the fruit is a condition for the fruit, by way of proximity condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – maggapaccavekkhaṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… phalapaccavekkhaṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… nibbānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… appamāṇārammaṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ parittārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of proximity condition—reviewing of the path is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… reviewing of the fruit is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… reviewing of Nibbāna is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… knowledge of the penetration of minds with an immeasurable object is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… knowledge of the recollection of past lives is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… knowledge of the future is a condition for the emergence with a limited object… fruition is a condition for the emergence with a limited object by way of proximity condition. (2)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – maggapaccavekkhaṇaṃ mahaggatārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… phalapaccavekkhaṇaṃ mahaggatārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… nibbānapaccavekkhaṇaṃ mahaggatārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ mahaggatārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of proximity condition—reviewing of the path is a condition for the emergence with an exalted object… reviewing of the fruit is a condition for the emergence with an exalted object… reviewing of Nibbāna is a condition for the emergence with an exalted object… fruition is a condition for the emergence with an exalted object by way of proximity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

23. Parittārammaṇo [T 2.0466] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ).

23. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of contiguity condition (similar to the proximity condition).

Sahajātapaccayādi

Co-nascence Condition, etc.

24. Parittārammaṇo [M 2.0353] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (paṭiccavārasadisā kātabbā).

24. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of co-nascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… three (to be elaborated similarly to the dependent section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

25. Parittārammaṇo [V 2.0407] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parittārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Parittārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ…pe… uposathakammaṃ…pe… parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Parittārammaṇā saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… parittārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with a limited object, one gives a gift, undertakes virtue… performs the Uposatha observance… produces jhāna with a limited object, insight… direct knowledge… an attainment, fosters conceit, grasps a view. Depending on virtue with a limited object… wisdom… greed, hate… delusion… conceit… a view… aspiration… bodily pleasure… bodily pain, one gives a gift, undertakes virtue… performs the Uposatha observance… produces jhāna with a limited object, insight… direct knowledge… an attainment, kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha. Faith with a limited object… wisdom, greed… aspiration, bodily pleasure… bodily pain… is a condition for faith with a limited object… for wisdom, for greed… for aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parittārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti[T 2.0467], mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Parittārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Parittārammaṇā saddhā…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, mahaggatārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with a limited object, one produces jhāna with an exalted object, insight… direct knowledge… an attainment, fosters conceit, grasps a view. Depending on virtue with a limited object… wisdom… greed… aspiration… bodily pleasure, bodily pain, one produces jhāna with an exalted object, insight… direct knowledge… an attainment, fosters conceit, grasps a view. Faith with a limited object… bodily pleasure, bodily pain, is a condition for faith with an exalted object… for wisdom, for greed… for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Parittārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – parittārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti[M 2.0354], maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya [V 2.0408] appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Parittārammaṇā saddhā…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ appamāṇārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of decisive support condition—proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with a limited object, one produces jhāna with an immeasurable object, the path… direct knowledge… an attainment. Depending on virtue with a limited object… wisdom, greed… bodily pleasure, bodily pain, one produces jhāna with an immeasurable object, the path… direct knowledge… an attainment. Faith with a limited object… bodily pleasure, bodily pain is a condition for faith with an immeasurable object… for wisdom by way of decisive support condition. (3)

26. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ, rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti[T 2.0468]. Mahaggatārammaṇā saddhā…pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā mahaggatārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

26. A state with an exalted object is a condition for a state with an exalted object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with an exalted object, one produces jhāna with an exalted object, insight… direct knowledge… an attainment, fosters conceit, grasps a view. Depending on virtue with an exalted object… wisdom, greed… aspiration, one produces jhāna with an exalted object… grasps a view. Faith with an exalted object… wisdom, greed… aspiration is a condition for faith with an exalted object… for aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Mahaggatārammaṇā saddhā…pe… patthanā parittārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a sublime object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with a sublime object, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the observance day duties, generates absorption with a limited object, insight… direct knowledges… meditative attainments; one generates conceit, grasps a view. Depending on virtue with a sublime object… and so on… aspiration, one gives a gift… and so on… grasps a view. Faith with a sublime object… and so on… aspiration is a condition for faith with a limited object… and so on… for aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mahaggatārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mahaggatārammaṇā saddhā…pe… patthanā appamāṇārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo (3)

A phenomenon with a sublime object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of decisive support condition—proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with a sublime object, one generates absorption with an immeasurable object, the path… direct knowledges… meditative attainments. Depending on virtue with a sublime object… and so on… aspiration, one generates absorption with an immeasurable object… and so on… meditative attainments. Faith with a sublime object… and so on… aspiration is a condition for faith with an immeasurable object… and so on… for wisdom by way of decisive support condition. (3)

27. Appamāṇārammaṇo [M 2.0355] dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0409] – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo[T 2.0469], pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya appamāṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti. Maggaṃ…pe… abhiññaṃ…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti appamāṇārammaṇā saddhā…pe… paññā appamāṇārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with an immeasurable object, one generates absorption with an immeasurable object, the path… direct knowledges… meditative attainments. Depending on virtue with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom, one generates absorption with an immeasurable object. The path… and so on… direct knowledges… and so on… one generates meditative attainments. Faith with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom is a condition for faith with an immeasurable object… and so on… for wisdom, for the path, for the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇārammaṇā saddhā…pe… paññā parittārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with an immeasurable object, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the observance day duties, generates absorption with a limited object, insight… direct knowledges… meditative attainments. Depending on virtue with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom, one gives a gift… and so on… generates meditative attainments. Faith with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom is a condition for faith with a limited object… and so on… for wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – appamāṇārammaṇaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇārammaṇaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya mahaggatārammaṇaṃ [T 2.0470] jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Appamāṇārammaṇā saddhā…pe… paññā mahaggatārammaṇāya saddhāya…pe… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: depending on faith with an immeasurable object, one generates absorption with a sublime object, insight… direct knowledges… meditative attainments. Depending on virtue with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom, one generates absorption with a sublime object, insight… direct knowledges… meditative attainments. Faith with an immeasurable object… and so on… wisdom is a condition for faith with a sublime object… and so on… for wisdom by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

28. Parittārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā parittārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ parittārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of repetition condition. Preceding, preceding aggregates with a limited object are a condition for succeeding, succeeding aggregates with a limited object by way of repetition condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo [M 2.0356][V 2.0410] dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – parittārammaṇaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of repetition condition. Conformity with a limited object is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification by way of repetition condition. (2)

29. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā mahaggatārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ mahaggatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. A phenomenon with a sublime object is a condition for a phenomenon with a sublime object by way of repetition condition. Preceding, preceding aggregates with a sublime object are a condition for succeeding, succeeding aggregates with a sublime object by way of repetition condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – mahaggatārammaṇaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a sublime object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of repetition condition. Conformity with a sublime object is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification by way of repetition condition. (2)

30. Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā appamāṇārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ appamāṇārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena [T 2.0471] paccayo. Gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A phenomenon with an immeasurable object is a condition for a phenomenon with an immeasurable object by way of repetition condition. Preceding, preceding aggregates with an immeasurable object are a condition for succeeding, succeeding aggregates with an immeasurable object by way of repetition condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

31. Parittārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – parittārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – parittārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ parittārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A phenomenon with a limited object is a condition for a phenomenon with a limited object by way of kamma condition: conascent, asynchronous. Conascent: volition with a limited object is a condition for associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on…. Asynchronous: volition with a limited object is a condition for resultant aggregates with a limited object by way of kamma condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – mahaggatārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – mahaggatārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ mahaggatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state with a sublime object is a condition for a state with a sublime object by way of kamma condition: by way of co-nascence and by way of different moments. By way of co-nascence: volition with a sublime object is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… etc. By way of different moments: volition with a sublime object is a condition for the resultant aggregates with a sublime object by way of kamma condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā [V 2.0411] – mahaggatārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ parittārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a sublime object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of kamma condition. By way of different moments: volition with a sublime object is a condition for the resultant aggregates with a limited object by way of kamma condition. (2)

32. Appamāṇārammaṇo [M 2.0357] dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – appamāṇārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – appamāṇārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ appamāṇārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

32. A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of kamma condition: by way of co-nascence and by way of different moments. By way of co-nascence: volition with an immeasurable object is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. By way of different moments: volition with an immeasurable object is a condition for the resultant aggregates with an immeasurable object by way of kamma condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo [T 2.0472] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – appamāṇārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ parittārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of kamma condition. By way of different moments: volition with an immeasurable object is a condition for the resultant aggregates with a limited object by way of kamma condition. (2)

Vipākapaccayādi

Result Condition, and so forth.

33. Parittārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccaya… atthipaccayena paccayo… natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccaya… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

33. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of result condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of presence condition… by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition.

34. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā satta, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye nava, āsevane pañca, kamme pañca, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye jhāne magge sampayutte atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

34. By way of root condition, three; by way of object condition, seven; by way of predominance condition, seven; by way of contiguity condition, nine; by way of immediate contiguity condition, nine; by way of co-nascence condition, three; by way of mutuality condition, three; by way of support condition, three; by way of decisive support condition, nine; by way of repetition condition, five; by way of kamma condition, five; by way of result condition, three; by way of nutriment condition, three; by way of faculty condition, three; by way of jhāna condition, three; by way of path condition, three; by way of association condition, three; by way of presence condition, three; by way of absence condition, nine; by way of disappearance condition, nine; by way of non-disappearance condition, three (thus it should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Forward.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Negative Section

35. Parittārammaṇo [V 2.0412] dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (1)

Parittārammaṇo [M 2.0358] dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with a sublime object by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Parittārammaṇo [T 2.0473] dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with a limited object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of decisive support condition. (3)

36. Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

36. A state with a sublime object is a condition for a state with a sublime object by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with a sublime object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with a sublime object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of decisive support condition. (3)

37. Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo appamāṇārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with an immeasurable object by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo parittārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with a limited object by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo mahaggatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with an immeasurable object is a condition for a state with a sublime object by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

38. Nahetuyā [V 2.0413] nava, naārammaṇe nava, naadhipatiyā nava, naanantare nava, nasamanantare nava, nasahajāte nava, naaññamaññe nava[T 2.0474], nanissaye nava, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte nava, napacchājāte nava, naāsevane nava…pe… namagge nava, nasampayutte nava, navippayutte nava, noatthiyā nava, nonatthiyā nava, novigate nava, noavigate nava (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

38. Not by way of root condition, nine; not by way of object condition, nine; not by way of predominance condition, nine; not by way of contiguity condition, nine; not by way of immediate contiguity condition, nine; not by way of co-nascence condition, nine; not by way of mutuality condition, nine; not by way of support condition, nine; not by way of decisive support condition, seven; not by way of pre-nascence condition, nine; not by way of post-nascence condition, nine; not by way of repetition condition, nine…and so on… not by way of path condition, nine; not by way of association condition, nine; not by way of dissociation condition, nine; not by way of presence condition, nine; not by way of absence condition, nine; not by way of disappearance condition, nine; not by way of non-disappearance condition, nine (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Pair

39. Hetupaccayā [M 2.0359] naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare naupanissaye napurejāte napacchājāte naāsevane tīṇi…pe… namagge navippayutte nonatthiyā novigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

39. By way of root condition, not by way of object condition, three; not by way of predominance condition, not by way of contiguity condition, not by way of immediate contiguity condition, not by way of decisive support condition, not by way of pre-nascence condition, not by way of post-nascence condition, not by way of repetition condition, three…and so on… not by way of path condition, not by way of dissociation condition, not by way of absence condition, not by way of disappearance condition, three (thus it should be counted).

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Pair

40. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā satta, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye nava, āsevane pañca, kamme [V 2.0414] pañca, vipāke tīṇi…pe… sampayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate tīṇi (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

40. Not by way of root condition; by way of object condition, seven; by way of dominance condition, seven; by way of contiguity condition, nine; by way of immediate contiguity condition, nine; by way of co-nascence condition, three; by way of mutuality condition, three; by way of support condition, three; by way of decisive support condition, nine; by way of repetition condition, five; by way of kamma condition, five; by way of result condition, three…and so on… by way of association condition, three; by way of presence condition, three; by way of absence condition, nine; by way of disappearance condition, nine; by way of non-disappearance condition, three (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Triad on Limited Objects is concluded.

14. Hīnattikaṃ

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

1. Hīnaṃ [T 2.0475][M 2.0360][V 2.0415] dhammaṃ paṭicca hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – hīnaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

1. Dependent on an inferior phenomenon, an inferior phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one inferior aggregate, three aggregates arise…and so on… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – hīne khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on an inferior phenomenon, a middling phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on inferior aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hīno ca majjhimo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – hīnaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on an inferior phenomenon, both inferior and middling phenomena arise by way of root condition: dependent on one inferior aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…and so on… dependent on two aggregates…and so on…. (3)

2. Majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – majjhimaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

2. Dependent on a middling phenomenon, a middling phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one middling aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…and so on… dependent on two aggregates…and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking…and so on… dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element…and so on… dependent on great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

3. Paṇītaṃ [V 2.0416] dhammaṃ paṭicca paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.

3. Dependent on a superior phenomenon, a superior phenomenon arises by way of root condition… three cases.

4. Majjhimañca paṇītañca dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṇīte khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

4. Dependent on a middling phenomenon and a superior phenomenon, a middling phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on superior aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

5. Hīnañca majjhimañca dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 2.0476] – hīne khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

5. Dependent on an inferior phenomenon and a middling phenomenon, a middling phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on inferior aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

(Hīnattikaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhattikasadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ.)

(The Inferior Triad should be fully elaborated, similar to the Triad on Defilement.)

Hīnattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Inferior Triad is concluded.

1. Dependent on a wrongly-fixed phenomenon, a wrongly-fixed phenomenon arises by way of root condition: dependent on one wrongly-fixed aggregate, three aggregates arise…and so on… dependent on two aggregates. (1)

Micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – micchattaniyate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)
