1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

1. Maggārammaṇaṃ [T 2.0506][M 2.0385][V 2.0447] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

1. Dependent on a phenomenon with the path as object, a phenomenon with the path as object arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with the path as object, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon with the path as object, a phenomenon that is path-dominant arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with the path as object, three aggregates that are path-dominant arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises. Two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon with the path as object, phenomena that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate with the path as object, three aggregates that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

2. Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

2. Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted, a phenomenon that is path-rooted arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Maggahetukaṃ [V 2.0448] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted, a phenomenon that is path-dominant arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted, three aggregates that are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggahetukaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted, phenomena that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted, three aggregates that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

3. Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

3. Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-dominant, a phenomenon that is path-dominant arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-dominant, three aggregates arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 2.0507] – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-dominant, a phenomenon with the path as object arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-dominant, three aggregates with the path as object arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggahetukā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-dominant, a phenomenon that is path-rooted arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-rooted arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (4)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-dominant, phenomena that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-dominant, three aggregates that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (4)

Maggādhipatiṃ [M 2.0386] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (5)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-dominant, phenomena that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (5)

4. Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

4. Dependent on a phenomenon that has the path as object and is path-dominant, a phenomenon that has the path as object arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that has the path as object and is path-dominant, three aggregates that have the path as object arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Maggārammaṇañca [V 2.0449] maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that has the path as object and is path-dominant, a phenomenon that is path-dominant arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that has the path as object and is path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that has the path as object and is path-dominant, phenomena that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that has the path as object and is path-dominant, three aggregates that have the path as object and are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

5. Maggahetukañca [T 2.0508] maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggahetukā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

5. Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted and path-dominant, a phenomenon that is path-rooted arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted and path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-rooted arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted and path-dominant, a phenomenon that is path-dominant arises by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted and path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (2)

Maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is path-rooted and path-dominant, phenomena that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate that is path-rooted and path-dominant, three aggregates that are path-rooted and path-dominant arise… and so on… two aggregates… and so on. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

Object Condition, and so on

6. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā… anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā… āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

6. Dependent on a phenomenon with the path as object, a phenomenon with the path as object arises by way of object condition, dominance condition, contiguity condition, immediate contiguity condition, co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, decisive support condition, pre-nascence condition, repetition condition, kamma condition, nutriment condition, faculty condition, jhāna condition, path condition, association condition, dissociation condition, presence condition, absence condition, disappearance condition, or non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Concordant Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

7. Hetuyā [M 2.0387][V 2.0450] sattarasa, ārammaṇe adhipatiyā anantare samanantare sahajāte aññamaññe nissaye upanissaye purejāte āsevane kamme āhāre indriye jhāne magge sampayutte vippayutte atthiyā natthiyā vigate avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

7. By root condition, seventeen; by object condition, dominance condition, contiguity condition, immediate contiguity condition, co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, decisive support condition, pre-nascence condition, repetition condition, kamma condition, nutriment condition, faculty condition, jhāna condition, path condition, association condition, dissociation condition, presence condition, absence condition, disappearance condition, or non-disappearance condition—seventeen (thus it should be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Concordant

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Discordant Order of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Not by Root Condition

8. Maggārammaṇaṃ [T 2.0509] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

8. A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon by way of non-root condition—three aggregates arise dependent on one rootless path-object aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-dominance condition.

9. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

9. A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three aggregates arise dependent on one path-object aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-dominance aggregates arise dependent on one path-object aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā [V 2.0451] – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-object phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-object and path-dominance aggregates arise dependent on one path-object aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (3)

10. Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggahetukādhipati. (1)

10. A path-rooted phenomenon arises dependent on a path-rooted phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—a path-rooted dominant phenomenon arises dependent on path-rooted aggregates. (1)

Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati adhipati. (2)

A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-rooted phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—dependent on path-rooted aggregates, path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise. (2)

Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca adhipati. (3)

Path-rooted and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-rooted phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—dependent on path-rooted aggregates, path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise. (3)

11. Maggādhipatiṃ [M 2.0388] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggādhipatī khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati adhipati. Maggādhipatiṃ [T 2.0510] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

11. A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-dominance aggregates. Three aggregates arise dependent on one path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-object aggregates arise dependent on one path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggādhipatī khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko adhipati. (3)

A path-rooted phenomenon arises dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-rooted aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-dominance aggregates. (3)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (4)

Path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-object and path-dominance aggregates arise dependent on one path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (4)

Maggādhipatiṃ [V 2.0452] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – maggādhipatī khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca adhipati. (5)

Path-rooted and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-dominance aggregates. (5)

12. Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

12. A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-object aggregates arise dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-dominance aggregates arise dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo [T 2.0511] khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—three path-object and path-dominance aggregates arise dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate…pe…two aggregates…pe…. (3)

13. Maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke ca maggādhipatī ca khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko adhipati. (1)

13. A path-rooted phenomenon arises dependent on a path-rooted and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-rooted aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates. (1)

Maggahetukañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke ca maggādhipatī ca khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati adhipati. (2)

A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-rooted and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates. (2)

Maggahetukañca [M 2.0389] maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – maggahetuke ca maggādhipatī ca khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca adhipati. (3)

Path-rooted and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-rooted and path-dominance phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition—path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates, which are dominant, arise dependent on path-rooted and path-dominance aggregates. (3)

Napurejātapaccayādi

Not by way of pre-nascence condition, etc.

14. Maggārammaṇaṃ [V 2.0453] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā… napacchājātapaccayā (paripuṇṇā dvepi).

14. A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon not by way of pre-nascence condition… not by way of post-nascence condition (both are complete).

Naāsevanapaccayo

Not by way of repetition condition.

15. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

15. A path-object phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object aggregate, three aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates arise…pe…. (1)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

A path-dominance phenomenon arises dependent on a path-object phenomenon not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object aggregate, three path-dominance aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates arise…pe…. (2)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise dependent on a path-object phenomenon not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object aggregate, three path-object and path-dominance aggregates arise…pe… two aggregates arise…pe…. (3)

16. Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā [T 2.0512] – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

16. Dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon, a path-dominance phenomenon arises, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-dominance aggregate, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-dominance aggregate, three path-object aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – maggādhipatiṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon, both path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-dominance aggregate, three path-object and path-dominance aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

17. Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā [V 2.0454] – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

17. Dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate, three path-object aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Maggārammaṇañca [M 2.0390] maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggādhipatī tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (2)

Dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon, a path-dominance phenomenon arises, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate, three path-dominance aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (2)

Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti naāsevanapaccayā – maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (3)

Dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon, both path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise, not by way of repetition condition—dependent on one path-object and path-dominance aggregate, three path-object and path-dominance aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (3)

Nakammapaccayo

Not-kamma condition

18. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – maggārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca maggārammaṇā cetanā. (1)

18. Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-object aggregates, path-object volition arises. (1)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – maggārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati [T 2.0513] cetanā. (2)

Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, a path-dominance phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-object aggregates, path-dominance volition arises. (2)

Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti nakammapaccayā – maggārammaṇe khandhe paṭicca maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipati ca cetanā. (3)

Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, both path-object and path-dominance phenomena arise, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-object aggregates, path-object and path-dominance volition arises. (3)

19. Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggahetukā cetanā. (1)

19. Dependent on a path-root phenomenon, a path-root phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-root aggregates, path-root volition arises. (1)

Maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati cetanā. (2)

Dependent on a path-root phenomenon, a path-dominance phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-root aggregates, path-dominance volition arises. (2)

Maggahetukaṃ [V 2.0455] dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti nakammapaccayā – maggahetuke khandhe paṭicca maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca cetanā. (3)

Dependent on a path-root phenomenon, both path-root and path-dominance phenomena arise, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-root aggregates, path-root and path-dominance volition arises. (3)

20. Maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – maggādhipatī khandhe paṭicca maggādhipati cetanā (pañca pañhā).

20. Dependent on a path-dominance phenomenon, a path-dominance phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition—dependent on path-dominance aggregates, path-dominance volition arises. (Five questions.)

Maggārammaṇañca maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā (paṭhamaghaṭane tīṇi).

Dependent on a path-object and path-dominance phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition (three in the first combination).

Maggahetukañca [M 2.0391] maggādhipatiñca dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā (dutiyaghaṭane tīṇi pañhā).

Dependent on a path-root and path-dominance phenomenon, a path-root phenomenon arises, not by way of kamma condition (three questions in the second combination).

Navipākapaccayo

Non-result condition

21. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ).

21. Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises by way of non-result condition (complete).

Namaggapaccayo

Not-path condition

22. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo [T 2.0514] khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe…. (1)

22. Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises by way of not-path condition—dependent on one rootless path-object aggregate, three aggregates…pe… two aggregates…pe…. (1)

Navippayuttapaccayo

Not-dissociation condition

23. Maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ, arūpanti niyāmetabbaṃ).

23. Dependent on a path-object phenomenon, a path-object phenomenon arises by way of not-dissociation condition (complete, to be specified as formless).

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Mode of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

24. Nahetuyā [V 2.0456] ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā sattarasa, napurejāte sattarasa, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane nava, nakamme sattarasa, navipāke sattarasa, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

24. By way of not-root condition: one; by way of not-dominance condition: seventeen; by way of not-prenascence condition: seventeen; by way of not-postnascence condition: seventeen; by way of not-repetition condition: nine; by way of not-kamma condition: seventeen; by way of not-result condition: seventeen; by way of not-path condition: one; by way of not-dissociation condition: seventeen (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative Mode of Conditions

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

25. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā sattarasa, napurejāte sattarasa, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane nava, nakamme sattarasa, navipāke navippayutte sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

25. By way of root condition, not by way of dominance condition: seventeen; not by way of prenascence condition: seventeen; not by way of postnascence condition: seventeen; not by way of repetition condition: nine; not by way of kamma condition: seventeen; not by way of result condition, not by way of dissociation condition: seventeen (thus it should be reckoned).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative Mode.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative Mode of Conditions

Nahetudukaṃ

The Not-Root Dyad

26. Nahetupaccayā [M 2.0392] ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ…pe… jhāne sampayutte vippayutte atthiyā natthiyā vigate avigate ekaṃ (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

26. By way of not-root condition: in object condition: one; in immediate condition: one; in contiguous condition: one…pe… in jhāna condition, in association condition, in dissociation condition, in presence condition, in absence condition, in disappearance condition, in non-disappearance condition: one (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccayānulomaṃ.

The Affirmative Mode of Conditions

Paṭiccavāro.

The Section on Dependent Origination

2-6. Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6. The Sections on Co-nascence, Condition, Dependence, Conjunction, and Association

(Sahajātavāropi [V 2.0457] paccayavāropi nissayavāropi saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi paṭiccavārasadiso.)

The Co-nascence Section, the Condition Section, the Dependence Section, the Conjunction Section, and the Association Section are similar to the Dependent Origination Section.

7. The Question Section

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Affirmative Mode of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

27. Maggārammaṇo [T 2.0515] dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – maggārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of root condition. Path-object roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – maggārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of root condition. Path-object roots are a condition for the associated path-dominant aggregates by way of root condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo (iminā kāraṇena sattarasa pañhā kātabbā).

A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of root condition (for this reason, seventeen questions should be formulated).

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

28. Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, cetopariyañāṇena maggahetukacittasamaṅgissa [M 2.0393] cittaṃ jānanti, maggahetukā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path; with mind-penetrating knowledge, they know the mind of one endowed with path-root consciousness; path-root aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Maggahetuko [V 2.0458] dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (2)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (2)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ [T 2.0516] katvā paccavekkhanti. (3)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (3)

29. Maggādhipati dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (1)

29. A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (1)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, cetopariyañāṇena maggādhipaticittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti, maggādhipatī khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path; with mind-penetrating knowledge, they know the mind of one endowed with path-dominant consciousness; path-dominant aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (2)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (3)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (3)

30. Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, cetopariyañāṇena maggahetukamaggādhipaticittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti, maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path; with mind-penetrating knowledge, they know the mind of one endowed with path-root and path-dominant consciousness; path-root and path-dominant aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of past lives, knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (1)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ [T 2.0517] garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (2)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (2)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (3)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of object condition. The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it in respect. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

31. Maggārammaṇo [M 2.0394][V 2.0459] dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: Path-object dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: Path-object dominance is a condition for the associated path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A path-object phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: Path-object dominance is a condition for the associated path-object and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (3)

32. Maggahetuko dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

32. A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-root phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence Dominance: Path-root dominance is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (2)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object Dominance: The noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. (2)

Maggahetuko [T 2.0518] dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: a path-root dominance is a condition for associated path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (3)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (4)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. (4)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo[V 2.0460]. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggahetukānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (5)

A path-root phenomenon is a condition for a path-root phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: a path-root dominance is a condition for associated path-root aggregates and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (5)

33. Maggādhipati [M 2.0395] dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – maggādhipati adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: a path-dominant dominance is a condition for associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati [T 2.0519] – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – maggādhipati adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: a path-dominant dominance is a condition for associated path-object aggregates by way of dominance condition. (2)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggādhipati adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-root phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: a path-dominant dominance is a condition for associated path-root aggregates by way of dominance condition. (3)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – maggādhipati adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: a path-dominant dominance is a condition for associated path-object aggregates and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (4)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggādhipati adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggāhetukānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (5)

A path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for a path-root phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: a path-dominant dominance is a condition for associated path-root aggregates and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (5)

34. Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. Path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: path-object and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-object aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo [V 2.0461] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa [T 2.0520] adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: path-object and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

Path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: path-object and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-object aggregates and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (3)

35. Maggahetuko [M 2.0396] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (1)

35. Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. (1)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-root phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: path-root and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-root aggregates by way of dominance condition. (2)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: object-dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: path-root and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (3)

Maggahetuko [T 2.0521] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (4)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-object phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: noble ones, having arisen from the path, review the path, regarding it as weighty. (4)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – maggahetukā ca maggādhipatī ca adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ maggahetukānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (5)

Path-root and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for a path-root phenomenon and for a path-dominant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: path-root and path-dominant dominance are a condition for associated path-root aggregates and path-dominant aggregates by way of dominance condition. (5)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

36. Maggārammaṇo [V 2.0462] dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

36. A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as object by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object by way of contiguity condition. Adverting is a condition for aggregates with path as object by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. Adverting is a condition for aggregates with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca [M 2.0397] maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā maggārammaṇānañca [T 2.0522] maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as object and for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. Adverting is a condition for aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (3)

37. Maggādhipati dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggādhipatī khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A state with path as dominant factor is a condition for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggādhipatī khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with path as dominant factor is a condition for a state with path as object by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggādhipatī khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with path as dominant factor is a condition for a state with path as object and for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (3)

38. Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0463] – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

38. States with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for a state with path as object by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggādhipatīnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

States with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo [T 2.0523] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā ca maggādhipatī ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānañca maggādhipatīnañca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

States with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for a state with path as object and for a state with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition: preceding aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor are a condition for subsequent aggregates with path as object and with path as dominant factor by way of contiguity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayādi

Contiguity Condition, etc.

39. Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… (anantarasadisaṃ) sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo… (tīsupi sattarasa pañhā kātabbā).

39. A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as object by way of contiguity condition… and so on… (similar to the contiguity condition) by way of conascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… (in all three cases, the seventeen questions should be applied).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

40. Maggārammaṇo [M 2.0398] dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as object by way of decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as dominant factor by way of decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0464] – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya [T 2.0524] upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with path as object is a condition for a state with path as object and for a state with path as dominant factor by way of decisive support condition: immediate decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (3)

41. Maggahetuko dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

41. A state with path as root is a condition for a state with path as root by way of decisive support condition. Natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path by way of decisive support condition… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (2)

A state with path as root is a condition for a state with path as object by way of decisive support condition. Object decisive support: the noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, treating it as weighty. (2)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state with path as root is a condition for a state with path as dominant factor by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on…. Natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (4)

A state with path as root is a condition for a state with path as object and for a state with path as dominant factor by way of decisive support condition. Object decisive support: the noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, treating it as weighty. (4)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

The path-rooted phenomenon is a condition for the path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena by way of decisive support condition. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (5)

42. Maggādhipati [M 2.0399] dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…[T 2.0525]. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

42. The path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: by way of object decisive support, by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition; reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[V 2.0465], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: by way of object decisive support, by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for the path-rooted phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

The path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for the path-object and path-dominant phenomena by way of decisive support condition: by way of object decisive support, by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (4)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

The path-dominant phenomenon is a condition for the path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena by way of decisive support condition. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (5)

43. Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena [T 2.0526] paccayo. (1)

43. The path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo [M 2.0400] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccavekkhaṇā paccavekkhaṇāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The path-object and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-object and path-dominant phenomena by way of decisive support condition: by way of immediate decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: reflection is a condition for reflection by way of decisive support condition. (3)

44. Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena [V 2.0466] paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (1)

44. The path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. By way of object decisive support: noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path with respect. (1)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-rooted phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo[T 2.0527]. (3)

The path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: by way of object decisive support, by way of natural decisive support… and so on…. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (4)

The path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-object phenomenon and for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. By way of object decisive support: noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path with respect. (4)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

The path-rooted and path-dominant phenomena are a condition for the path-rooted phenomenon and for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. By way of natural decisive support: the first path is a condition for the second path… and so on… the third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. (5)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

45. Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā maggārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ maggārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo.

45. The path-object phenomenon is a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of repetition condition: preceding path-object aggregates are a condition for succeeding path-object aggregates by way of repetition condition.

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ. Nava pañhā kātabbā, āvajjanā na kātabbā).

The path-object phenomenon is a condition for the path-dominant phenomenon by way of repetition condition (similar to the proximity condition. Nine questions are to be formulated; adverting is not to be formulated).

Kammapaccayādi

Kamma Condition, etc.

46. Maggārammaṇo [M 2.0401][V 2.0467] dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā…pe… (nānākkhaṇikā natthi, sattarasa pañhā kātabbā).

46. The path-object phenomenon is a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent… and so on… (there is no different-moment kamma; seventeen questions are to be formulated).

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

47. Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo… jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo… atthipaccayena paccayo (ime satta paccayā [T 2.0528] sattarasa pañhā hetusadisā)… natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisā)… avigatapaccayena paccayo (sattarasa pañhā).

47. The path-object phenomenon is a condition for the path-object phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of presence condition (these seven conditions are similar to the root condition; seventeen questions are to be formulated)… by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition (similar to the proximity condition)… by way of non-disappearance condition (seventeen questions).

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conditions in Forward Order

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section.

48. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā ekavīsa, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe sattarasa, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye ekavīsa, āsevane nava, kamme sattarasa, āhāre indriye jhāne magge sampayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

48. By root condition, seventeen; by object condition, nine; by predominance condition, twenty-one; by contiguity condition, nine; by immediate contiguity condition, nine; by co-nascence condition, seventeen; by mutuality condition, seventeen; by dependence condition, seventeen; by decisive support condition, twenty-one; by repetition condition, nine; by kamma condition, seventeen; by nutriment condition, by faculty condition, by jhāna condition, by path condition, and by association condition, seventeen; by presence condition, seventeen; by absence condition, nine; by disappearance condition, nine; by non-disappearance condition, seventeen (thus is to be counted).

Anulomaṃ.

Positive Order.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Negative Section.

49. Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

49. A path-object state is a condition for a path-object state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo [V 2.0468] dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-object state is a condition for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A path-object state is a condition for a path-object state and for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

50. Maggahetuko [M 2.0402] dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

50. A path-root state is a condition for a path-root state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 2.0529] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-root state is a condition for a path-object state by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A path-root state is a condition for a path-object state and for a path-predominant state by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (4)

Maggahetuko dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A path-root state is a condition for a path-root state and for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (5)

51. Maggādhipati dhammo maggādhipatissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

51. A path-predominant state is a condition for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A path-predominant state is a condition for a path-object state by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggādhipati [V 2.0469] dhammo maggahetukassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A path-predominant state is a condition for a path-root state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A path-predominant state is a condition for a path-object state and for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (4)

Maggādhipati dhammo maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A path-predominant state is a condition for a path-root state and for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (5)

52. Maggārammaṇo [T 2.0530] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

52. Path-object and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-object state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggārammaṇo ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Path-object and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggārammaṇo [M 2.0403] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Path-object and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-object state and for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

53. Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

53. Path-root and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-object state by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Path-root and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-root state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggādhipatissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Path-root and path-predominant states are a condition for a path-predominant state by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Maggahetuko [V 2.0470] ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggārammaṇassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

Maggahetuko ca maggādhipati ca dhammā maggahetukassa ca maggādhipatissa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (5)

Suddhaṃ

The Unmixed.

54. Nahetuyā ekavīsa, naārammaṇe sattarasa (naārammaṇe gahite pakatārammaṇampi upanissayārammaṇampi dvepi chijjanti), naadhipatiyā [T 2.0531] ekavīsa, naanantare nasamanantare nasahajāte naaññamaññe nanissaye naupanissaye napurejāte napacchājāte naāsevane nakamme navipāke naāhāre naindriye najhāne namagge nasampayutte navippayutte noatthiyā nonatthiyā novigate noavigate ekavīsa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

54. Not by root condition, twenty-one; not by object condition, seventeen (for when 'not by object condition' is taken, both the object itself and the object as decisive support are cut off); not by predominance condition, twenty-one; not by contiguity condition, not by immediate contiguity condition, not by co-nascence condition, not by mutuality condition, not by dependence condition, not by decisive support condition, not by pre-nascence condition, not by post-nascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, not by result condition, not by nutriment condition, not by faculty condition, not by jhāna condition, not by path condition, not by association condition, not by dissociation condition, not by presence condition, not by absence condition, not by disappearance condition, not by non-disappearance condition, twenty-one (thus is to be counted).

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

55. Hetupaccayā [M 2.0404] naārammaṇe sattarasa, naadhipatiyā naanantare nasamanantare naupanissaye napurejāte napacchājāte naāsevane nakamme navipāke naāhāre naindriye najhāne namagge navippayutte nonatthiyā novigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

55. In relation to root condition: not by way of object condition, seventeen; not by way of predominance condition, not by way of contiguity condition, not by way of immediate contiguity condition, not by way of decisive support condition, not by way of pre-nascence condition, not by way of post-nascence condition, not by way of repetition condition, not by way of kamma condition, not by way of result condition, not by way of nutriment condition, not by way of faculty condition, not by way of jhāna condition, not by way of path condition, not by way of dissociation condition, not by way of absence condition, not by way of disappearance condition, seventeen (thus should it be counted).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative Mode

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

56. Nahetupaccayā [V 2.0471] ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā ekavīsa, anantare nava, samanantare nava, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe sattarasa, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye ekavīsa, āsevane nava, kamme sattarasa, āhāre sattarasa, indriye jhāne magge sampayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā nava, vigate nava, avigate sattarasa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

56. In relation to non-root condition: by way of object condition, nine; by way of predominance condition, twenty-one; by way of contiguity condition, nine; by way of immediate contiguity condition, nine; by way of co-nascence condition, seventeen; by way of mutuality condition, seventeen; by way of support condition, seventeen; by way of decisive support condition, twenty-one; by way of repetition condition, nine; by way of kamma condition, seventeen; by way of nutriment condition, seventeen; by way of faculty, jhāna, path, and association conditions, seventeen; by way of presence condition, seventeen; by way of absence condition, nine; by way of disappearance condition, nine; by way of non-disappearance condition, seventeen (thus should it be counted).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Affirmative Mode

Maggārammaṇattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Triad of Path-Object is concluded.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ
