Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

19. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – atītārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena [M 2.0423] paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe atītārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

19. A past-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of root condition. Past-object roots are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, past-object roots are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anāgatārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A future-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of root condition. Future-object roots are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo [T 2.0555] dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – paccuppannārammaṇā [V 2.0495] hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe paccuppannārammaṇā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a present-object phenomenon by way of root condition. Present-object roots are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, present-object roots are a condition for associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

20. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – atītaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati. Atītārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā atītārammaṇe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Atītārammaṇe atīte khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Atītārammaṇā atītā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

20. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of object condition: one reviews the past sphere of infinite consciousness, the sphere of neither perception nor non-perception. One reviews past knowledge of supernormal power that has a past object, knowledge of the penetration of minds… knowledge of the recollection of past lives… knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma. Noble ones review abandoned defilements that have a past object, review suppressed defilements, know defilements previously accumulated. One discerns past aggregates that have a past object as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, enjoys and delights in them; taking that as object, lust that has a past object arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… displeasure arises. Past aggregates that have a past object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Atītārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – anāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ paccavekkhati. Atītārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Atītārammaṇe anāgate khandhe aniccato…pe… [T 2.0556] vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Atītārammaṇā anāgatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of object condition: one reviews the future sphere of infinite consciousness, the sphere of neither perception nor non-perception. One reviews future knowledge of supernormal power that has a past object, knowledge of the penetration of minds… knowledge of the recollection of past lives… knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma. One discerns future aggregates that have a past object as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; taking that as object, lust that has a future object arises… displeasure arises. Future aggregates that have a past object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (2)

Atītārammaṇo [M 2.0424] dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetopariyañāṇena atītārammaṇapaccuppannacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Atītārammaṇā paccuppannā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of object condition: through knowledge of the penetration of minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a present mind that has a past object. Present aggregates that have a past object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds and for adverting, by way of object condition. (3)

21. Anāgatārammaṇo [V 2.0496] dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – anāgatārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgatārammaṇe anāgate khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Anāgatārammaṇā anāgatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

21. A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of object condition: one reviews future knowledge of supernormal power that has a future object, knowledge of the penetration of minds… knowledge of the future… One discerns future aggregates that have a future object as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; taking that as object, lust that has a future object arises… displeasure arises. Future aggregates that have a future object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – anāgatārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ…pe… ariyā anāgatārammaṇe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti. Pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Anāgatārammaṇe atīte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati[T 2.0557], assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Anāgatārammaṇā atītā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of object condition: one reviews past knowledge of supernormal power that has a future object, knowledge of the penetration of minds… knowledge of the future… Noble ones review abandoned defilements that have a future object, review suppressed defilements. They know defilements previously accumulated. One discerns past aggregates that have a future object as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; taking that as object, lust that has a past object arises… displeasure arises. Past aggregates that have a future object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (2)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetopariyañāṇena anāgatārammaṇapaccuppannacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Anāgatārammaṇā paccuppannā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of object condition: through knowledge of the penetration of minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a present mind that has a future object. Present aggregates that have a future object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds and for adverting, by way of object condition. (3)

22. Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cetopariyañāṇena paccuppannārammaṇapaccuppannacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Paccuppannārammaṇā paccuppannā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

22. A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of object condition: through knowledge of the penetration of minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a present mind that has a present object. Present aggregates that have a present object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds and for adverting, by way of object condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo [M 2.0425] dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – atītaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ paccavekkhati, paccuppannārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā paccuppannārammaṇe pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti[V 2.0497]. Paccuppannārammaṇe atīte khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati, assādeti abhinandati[T 2.0558]; taṃ ārabbha atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Paccuppannārammaṇā atītā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of object condition: one reviews the past divine eye, reviews the past divine ear-element; one reviews past knowledge of supernormal power that has a present object, reviews knowledge of the penetration of minds. Noble ones review abandoned defilements that have a present object, review suppressed defilements, know defilements previously accumulated. One discerns past aggregates that have a present object as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; taking that as object, lust that has a past object arises… displeasure arises. Past aggregates that have a present object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (2)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – anāgataṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ paccavekkhati, paccuppannārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… paccuppannārammaṇe anāgate khandhe aniccato…pe… vipassati…pe… taṃ ārabbha anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Paccuppannārammaṇā anāgatā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of object condition: one reviews the future divine eye, reviews the future divine ear-element, reviews future knowledge of supernormal power with a present object, knowledge of the penetration of minds… One discerns future aggregates with a present object as impermanent… based on that, lust with a future object arises… displeasure arises. Future aggregates with a present object are a condition for knowledge of the penetration of minds, knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by way of object condition. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

23. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – atītaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Atītārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Atītārammaṇe atīte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati[T 2.0559]. Sahajātādhipati – atītārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

23. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of dominance condition—either object dominance or co-arisen dominance. Object dominance: one reviews the past base of infinite consciousness, having made it important; or the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, having made it important. One reviews past knowledge of supernormal power with a past object, having made it important; or knowledge of others’ minds... knowledge of recollection of past lives... knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, having made it important. One delights in and enjoys past aggregates with a past object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a past object arises, or wrong view arises. Co-arisen dominance: a dominance phenomenon with a past object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Atītārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – anāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ [M 2.0426] …pe… atītārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ…pe… yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ…pe… atītārammaṇe anāgate khandhe garuṃ [V 2.0498] katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of dominance condition. Object dominance: having made the future base of infinite consciousness important... the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... having made future knowledge of supernormal power with a past object important... knowledge of others’ minds... knowledge of recollection of past lives... knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma... one savors and enjoys future aggregates with a past object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a future object arises, or wrong view arises. (2)

24. Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – anāgatārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Anāgatārammaṇe anāgate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – anāgatārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

24. A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of dominance condition—either object dominance or co-arisen dominance. Object dominance: having made future knowledge of supernormal power with a future object important... knowledge of others’ minds... one reviews knowledge of the future, having made it important. One relishes and enjoys future aggregates with a future object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a future object arises, or wrong view arises. Co-arisen dominance: a dominance phenomenon with a future object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – anāgatārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ…pe… [T 2.0560] anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… anāgatārammaṇe atīte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of dominance condition. Object dominance: having made past knowledge of supernormal power with a future object important... knowledge of others’ minds... knowledge of the future, having made it important... one savors and enjoys past aggregates with a future object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a past object arises, or wrong view arises. (2)

25. Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – paccuppannārammaṇādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of dominance condition. Co-arisen dominance: a dominance phenomenon with a present object is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – atītaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ sotadhātuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, paccuppannārammaṇaṃ atītaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… paccuppannārammaṇe atīte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā atītārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of dominance condition. Object dominance: one reviews the past divine eye, having made it important; or the divine ear-element, having made it important; or past knowledge of supernormal power with a present object, having made it important... knowledge of others’ minds, having made it important... one delights in and enjoys past aggregates with a present object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a past object arises, or wrong view arises. (2)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – anāgataṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, dibbaṃ [M 2.0427] sotadhātuṃ garuṃ katvā [V 2.0499] …pe… paccuppannārammaṇaṃ anāgataṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… paccuppannārammaṇe anāgate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā anāgatārammaṇo rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (3)

A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of dominance condition. Object dominance: one reviews the future divine eye, having made it important; or the divine ear-element, having made it important... future knowledge of supernormal power with a present object, having made it important... knowledge of others’ minds, having made it important... one savors and enjoys future aggregates with a present object, having made them important; having made that important, lust with a future object arises, or wrong view arises. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediacy Condition

26. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena [T 2.0561] paccayo – purimā purimā atītārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ atītārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

26. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of immediacy condition—the preceding aggregates with a past object are a condition for the succeeding aggregates with a past object by way of immediacy condition. (1)

Atītārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – atītārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ anāgatārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of immediacy condition—the life-continuum with a past object is a condition for adverting with a future object by way of immediacy condition. (2)

Atītārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – atītārammaṇaṃ cuticittaṃ paccuppannārammaṇassa paṭisandhicittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Atītārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ paccuppannārammaṇāya āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of immediacy condition—the death consciousness with a past object is a condition for the rebirth-linking consciousness with a present object by way of immediacy condition. The life-continuum with a past object is a condition for adverting with a present object by way of immediacy condition. (3)

27. Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anāgatārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anāgatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of contiguity condition—the preceding aggregates with a future object are a condition for the succeeding aggregates with a future object by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – anāgatārammaṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ atītārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa…pe… cetopariyañāṇaṃ atītārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa…pe… anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ atītārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa…pe… anāgatārammaṇā khandhā atītārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of contiguity condition—the knowledge of psychic power with a future object is a condition for the emergence with a past object…pe… the knowledge of others’ minds with a future object is a condition for the emergence with a past object…pe… the knowledge of the future with a future object is a condition for the emergence with a past object…pe… the aggregates with a future object are a condition for the emergence with a past object by way of contiguity condition. (2)

28. Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa [T 2.0562] anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā paccuppannārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ paccuppannārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Paccuppannārammaṇaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ paccuppannārammaṇassa bhavaṅgassa…pe… paccuppannārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ paccuppannārammaṇassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

28. A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of contiguity condition—the preceding aggregates with a present object are a condition for the succeeding aggregates with a present object by way of contiguity condition. The rebirth-linking consciousness with a present object is a condition for the life-continuum with a present object…pe… the life-continuum with a present object is a condition for the life-continuum with a present object by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo [M 2.0428][V 2.0500] dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – paccuppannārammaṇaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ atītārammaṇassa bhavaṅgassa…pe… paccuppannārammaṇaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ atītārammaṇassa bhavaṅgassa…pe… paccuppannārammaṇā khandhā atītārammaṇassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of contiguity condition—the rebirth-linking consciousness with a present object is a condition for the life-continuum with a past object…pe… the life-continuum with a present object is a condition for the life-continuum with a past object…pe… the aggregates with a present object are a condition for the emergence with a past object by way of contiguity condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

29. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ).

29. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of proximity condition (similar to contiguity).

Sahajātapaccayādi

Conascence Condition, etc.

30. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo…(tayopi paccayā paṭiccavārasadisā).

30. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of conascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition… (These three conditions are similar to the dependent section).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

31. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – atītārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā atītārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Atītārammaṇo [T 2.0563] dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – atītārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā anāgatārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Atītārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo[V 2.0501], pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – atītārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā paccuppannārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a past object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (3)

32. Anāgatārammaṇo [M 2.0429] dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – anāgatārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā anāgatārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

32. A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a future object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – anāgatārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā atītārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya[T 2.0564], dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a past object by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – anāgatārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā paccuppannārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon with a future object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of decisive support condition. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (3)

33. Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccuppannārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā paccuppannārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A phenomenon with a present object is a condition for a phenomenon with a present object by way of decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support: contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paccuppannārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā atītārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of decisive support condition – object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: Contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, and contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a past object, contemplation of suffering, and contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Paccuppannārammaṇo [V 2.0502] dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…[T 2.0565]. Pakatūpanissayo – paccuppannārammaṇā aniccānupassanā, dukkhānupassanā, anattānupassanā anāgatārammaṇāya aniccānupassanāya, dukkhānupassanāya, anattānupassanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of decisive support condition – object decisive support, natural decisive support… and so on. Natural decisive support: Contemplation of impermanence with a present object, contemplation of suffering, and contemplation of non-self are a condition for contemplation of impermanence with a future object, contemplation of suffering, and contemplation of non-self by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

34. Atītārammaṇo [M 2.0430] dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā atītārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ atītārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. A past-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Earlier and earlier past-object aggregates are a condition for later and later past-object aggregates by way of repetition condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anāgatārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anāgatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A future-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Earlier and earlier future-object aggregates are a condition for later and later future-object aggregates by way of repetition condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā paccuppannārammaṇā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ paccuppannārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a present-object phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Earlier and earlier present-object aggregates are a condition for later and later present-object aggregates by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

35. Atītārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – atītārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – atītārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ atītārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

35. A past-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent and asynchronous. Co-nascent: past-object volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Asynchronous: past-object volition is a condition for the resultant past-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Atītārammaṇo [T 2.0566] dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – atītārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ anāgatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A past-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: past-object volition is a condition for the resultant future-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (2)

Atītārammaṇo [V 2.0503] dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – atītārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ paccuppannārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A past-object phenomenon is a condition for a present-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: past-object volition is a condition for the resultant present-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (3)

36. Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – anāgatārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – anāgatārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ anāgatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

36. A future-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent and asynchronous. Co-nascent: future-object volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: future-object volition is a condition for the resultant future-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Anāgatārammaṇo [M 2.0431] dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – anāgatārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ atītārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A future-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: future-object volition is a condition for the resultant past-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (2)

Anāgatārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – anāgatārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ paccuppannārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A future-object phenomenon is a condition for a present-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: future-object volition is a condition for the resultant present-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (3)

37. Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo paccuppannārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā [T 2.0567] – paccuppannārammaṇā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… nānākkhaṇikā – paccuppannārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ paccuppannārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a present-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent and asynchronous. Co-nascent: present-object volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. Asynchronous: present-object volition is a condition for the resultant present-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo atītārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – paccuppannārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ atītārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a past-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: present-object volition is a condition for the resultant past-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (2)

Paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo anāgatārammaṇassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā [V 2.0504] – paccuppannārammaṇā cetanā vipākānaṃ anāgatārammaṇānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A present-object phenomenon is a condition for a future-object phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: present-object volition is a condition for the resultant future-object aggregates by way of kamma condition. (3)

By way of non-root condition, nine for object condition, seven for predominance condition, seven for contiguity condition, seven for immediate contiguity condition, three for co-nascence condition, three for reciprocity condition, three for support condition, nine for decisive support condition, three for repetition condition, nine for kamma condition, three for result condition, three each for nutriment condition, faculty condition, jhāna condition, path condition, association condition, and presence condition; seven for absence condition, seven for disappearance condition, and three for non-disappearance condition (thus should be counted).

The Root Condition

1. Ajjhattaṃ [M 2.0434][V 2.0507] dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – ajjhattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe ajjhattaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ [T 2.0571] paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

1. An internal phenomenon arises dependent on an internal phenomenon by way of root condition—dependent on one internal aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality... dependent on two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one internal aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality... dependent on two aggregates... aggregates dependent on the base, the base dependent on aggregates. Dependent on one great element, three great elements... dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality. (1)

Bahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – bahiddhā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe bahiddhā ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An external phenomenon arises dependent on an external phenomenon by way of root condition—dependent on one external aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality... dependent on two aggregates... at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one external aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality... dependent on two aggregates... aggregates dependent on the base, the base dependent on aggregates. Dependent on one great element, three great elements... dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality. (1)

Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. Dependent on one great element…pe… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…pe… Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one internal aggregate conditions three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality... two aggregates... aggregates condition the base, the base conditions the aggregates. One great element conditions... nutriment-produced... temperature-produced... for non-percipient beings....
