Nahetupaccayo

Not by Root Condition

17. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ [V 2.0552] dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ. Anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca anidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, mahābhūte paṭicca…pe….

17. A non-manifesting and resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-manifesting and resistant phenomenon not by way of root condition. Dependent on one non-manifesting and resistant great element, two great elements arise; dependent on two great elements, one great element arises. Dependent on non-manifesting and resistant great elements, non-manifesting and resistant mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. Dependent on the tangible sense base, the eye sense base arises… and so on… the taste sense base. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on one non-manifesting and resistant great element, two great elements arise; dependent on two great elements, one great element arises; dependent on the great elements… and so on….

(Anidassanasappaṭighamūlake iminā kāraṇena sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(In the section rooted in the non-manifesting and resistant, the seven questions should be analyzed in this way.)

18. Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ [M 2.0473] dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ anidassanaappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā anidassanaappaṭighañca cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe…pe… ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā anidassanaappaṭighañca kaṭattārūpaṃ…pe… khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca [T 2.0621] itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ āpodhātuṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho.

18. A non-manifesting and non-resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-manifesting and non-resistant phenomenon not by way of root condition. Dependent on one rootless, non-manifesting, and non-resistant aggregate, three aggregates and non-manifesting and non-resistant mind-originated materiality arise… and so on…; dependent on two aggregates… and so on… At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-manifesting and non-resistant aggregate, three aggregates and non-manifesting and non-resistant kamma-originated materiality arise… and so on… Dependent on the aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, the aggregates arise. Dependent on the water element, non-manifesting and non-resistant mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. Dependent on the water element, the female faculty arises… and so on… edible food. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, non-manifesting and non-resistant kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. Dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and aggregates accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and delusion accompanied by restlessness arise.

(Anidassanaappaṭighamūlakā iminā kāraṇena satta pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(In the section rooted in the non-manifesting and non-resistant, the seven questions should be analyzed in this way.)

19. Anidassanasappaṭighañca anidassanaappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo [V 2.0553] uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. Anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca rūpāyatanaṃ. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

19. A manifest and resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-manifesting and resistant phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-resistant phenomenon not by way of root condition. Dependent on rootless, non-manifesting, and non-resistant aggregates and on the great elements, manifest and resistant mind-originated materiality arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on non-manifesting and non-resistant aggregates and on the great elements, manifest and resistant kamma-originated materiality arises. Dependent on non-manifesting and resistant great elements and the water element, manifest and resistant mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the visible form base arises. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on non-manifesting and resistant great elements and the water element, manifest and resistant kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise.

(Iminā kāraṇena satta pañhā vitthāretabbā asammohantena.)

(In this way, the seven questions should be elaborated by one who is not confused.)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Not by Object Condition

20. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ. Anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca anidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 2.0622] rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ…[M 2.0474], utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

20. A non-visible, resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, resistant phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on one non-visible, resistant great element, two great elements arise; dependent on two great elements, one great element arises. Dependent on non-visible, resistant great elements, non-visible, resistant mind-originated material form, kamma-born material form, and derived material form arise. Dependent on the tangible base, the eye base arises …pe… the taste base. External … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … For non-percipient beings, dependent on one non-visible, resistant great element, two great elements arise; dependent on two great elements, one great element arises …pe….

(Anidassanasappaṭighamūlakā iminā kāraṇena sattapi pañhā vitthāretabbā.)

(For this reason, the seven questions rooted in the non-visible and resistant should be elaborated in detail.)

21. Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. Khandhe paṭicca vatthu…pe… āpodhātuṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca itthindriyaṃ…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ āpodhātuṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

21. A non-visible, non-resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, non-resistant phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on the non-visible, non-resistant aggregates, non-visible, non-resistant mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the non-visible, non-resistant aggregates, non-visible, non-resistant kamma-born material form arises. Dependent on the aggregates, the base …pe… Dependent on the water element, non-visible, non-resistant mind-originated material form, kamma-born material form, and derived material form arise. Dependent on the water element, the female faculty …pe… edible food arises. External … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … For non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, non-visible, non-resistant kamma-born material form and derived material form arise.

(Anidassanaappaṭighamūlake [V 2.0554] iminā kāraṇena sattapi pañhā vitthāretabbā.)

(For this reason, the seven questions rooted in the non-visible and non-resistant should be elaborated in detail.)

22. Anidassanasappaṭighañca anidassanaappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ. Anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte [T 2.0623] ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca āpodhātuñca paṭicca rūpāyatanaṃ. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

22. A visible, resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, resistant phenomenon and a non-visible, non-resistant phenomenon by way of non-object condition: dependent on the non-visible, non-resistant aggregates and the non-visible, resistant great elements, visible, resistant mind-originated material form arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the non-visible, non-resistant aggregates and the non-visible, resistant great elements, visible, resistant kamma-born material form arises. Dependent on the non-visible, resistant great elements and the water element, visible, resistant mind-originated material form, kamma-born material form, and derived material form arise. Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the visible-form base arises. External … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … For non-percipient beings, dependent on the non-visible, resistant great elements and the water element, visible, resistant kamma-born material form and derived material form arise.

(Ghaṭane iminā kāraṇena sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(In the section on combination, the seven questions should be analyzed for this reason.)

Naadhipatipaccayādi

Non-dominance Condition, etc.

23. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (sahajātasadisaṃ)… naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā – anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca anidassanasappaṭighaṃ [M 2.0475] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… rasāyatanaṃ… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca anidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

23. A non-visible, resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, resistant phenomenon by way of non-dominance condition (similar to conascence) … by way of non-proximity condition … by way of non-contiguity condition … by way of non-mutuality condition: dependent on the non-visible, resistant great elements, non-visible, resistant mind-originated material form, kamma-born material form, and derived material form arise. Dependent on the tangible base, the eye base arises …pe… the taste base … external … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … For non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, non-visible, resistant kamma-born material form and derived material form arise.

(Iminā kāraṇena ekavīsa pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(For this reason, twenty-one questions should be analyzed.)

Naupanissayapaccayā… napurejātapaccayā… napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, dve mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ. Anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca anidassanasappaṭighaṃ upādārūpaṃ (kammaṃ vibhajitvā nakammeneva ekavīsa pañhā [V 2.0555] kātabbā), navipākapaccayā (paṭisandhipi kaṭattāpi natthi, pañcavokāreyeva kātabbā), naāhārapaccayā [T 2.0624] – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ…pe… (iminā kāraṇena vibhajitabbā ekavīsāpi).

By way of non-decisive support condition … by way of non-prenascence condition … by way of non-postnascence condition … by way of non-repetition condition … by way of non-kamma condition: external … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … dependent on one non-visible, resistant great element, two great elements arise; dependent on two great elements, one great element arises. Dependent on the non-visible, resistant great elements, non-visible, resistant derived material form arises (having analyzed kamma, the twenty-one questions should be formulated with non-kamma condition); by way of non-result condition (there is neither rebirth-linking nor kamma-born matter; this should be done only in the five-constituent existence); by way of non-nutriment condition: external … temperature-originated … for non-percipient beings …pe… (for this reason the twenty-one should be analyzed).

Naindriyapaccayādi

Not by Faculty Condition, etc.

24. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbe pañhā vibhajitabbā)… najhānapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ, sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā).

24. A non-visible, resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, resistant phenomenon, not by faculty condition: external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… one non-visible, resistant great element…pe… for non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty arises… (in brief, all questions should be analyzed). Not by jhāna condition: external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element… (in brief, the seven questions should be analyzed).

Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ āpodhātuṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

A non-visible, non-resistant phenomenon arises dependent on a non-visible, non-resistant phenomenon, not by jhāna condition: dependent on one aggregate accompanied by the five kinds of consciousness, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates…pe… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, non-visible, non-resistant kamma-born material form and derived material form arise.

(Evaṃ sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(Thus the seven questions should be analyzed.)

25. Anidassanasappaṭighañca anidassanaappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ…[M 2.0476], asaññasattānaṃ…pe… anidassanasappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñca paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

25. Dependent on a non-manifest and resistant phenomenon and a non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon, a manifest and resistant phenomenon arises, not by jhāna condition: external… arisen from nutriment… arisen from temperature… for non-percipient beings… (and so on)… dependent on the non-manifest and resistant great elements and the water element, manifest and resistant derived materiality produced by kamma arises.

(Evaṃ sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā), namaggapaccayā… (nahetusadisaṃ kātabbaṃ. Paripuṇṇaṃ. Moho natthi). Nasampayuttapaccayā… navippayuttapaccayā (paripuṇṇaṃ)… nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā.

(Thus all seven questions should be analyzed.) Not by path condition… (This is not like the root condition. Complete. There is no delusion.) Not by associated condition… not by dissociated condition (complete)… not by absence condition… not by disappearance condition.

Suddhaṃ

Pure

26. Nahetuyā [V 2.0556] ekavīsa, naārammaṇe ekavīsa, naadhipatiyā ekavīsa [T 2.0625] (saṃkhittaṃ, sabbattha ekavīsa), nonatthiyā ekavīsa, novigate ekavīsa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

26. By not-root condition: twenty-one. By not-object condition: twenty-one. By not-dominance condition: twenty-one (in brief, twenty-one in every case). By not-absence condition: twenty-one. By not-disappearance condition: twenty-one (thus it should be reckoned).

Paccanīyaṃ.

Negative

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Conditional-Affirmative-Negative

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

27. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe ekavīsa, naadhipatiyā ekavīsa…pe… nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekavīsa, nasampayutte ekavīsa, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā ekavīsa, novigate ekavīsa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

27. By root condition, not by object condition: twenty-one. Not by dominance condition: twenty-one… (and so on)… Not by kamma condition: one. Not by result condition: twenty-one. Not by associated condition: twenty-one. Not by dissociated condition: one. Not by absence condition: twenty-one. Not by disappearance condition: twenty-one (thus it should be counted).

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Affirmative-Negative

4. Conditional-Negative-Affirmative

Nahetudukaṃ

The Not-Root Dyad

28. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekavīsa [V 2.0557] …pe… jhāne ekavīsa, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ[M 2.0477], vippayutte ekavīsa, atthiyā ekavīsa, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekavīsa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

28. By not-root condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by conascence condition: twenty-one… (and so on)… by jhāna condition: twenty-one; by path condition: one; by associated condition: one; by dissociated condition: twenty-one; by presence condition: twenty-one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: twenty-one (thus it should be counted).

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

2-6. Sahajāta-paccaya-nissaya-saṃsaṭṭha-sampayuttavāro

2-6. Conascence, Mutuality, Dependence, Association, and Associated Sections

(Sahajātavāropi paccayavāropi nissayavāropi paṭiccavārasadisā, saṃsaṭṭhavāropi sampayuttavāropi arūpeyeva kātabbā.)

(The Conascence Section, Mutuality Section, and Dependence Section are similar to the Dependence Section. The Association Section and the Associated Section are to be done only in regard to the immaterial.)

7. Question Section

1. Analysis Section

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

29. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena [T 2.0626] paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. A non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon by way of root condition: non-manifest and non-resistant roots are a condition by way of root condition for the associated aggregates and for the non-manifest and non-resistant materiality arisen from mind. At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-manifest and non-resistant roots are a condition by way of root condition for the associated aggregates and for the non-manifest and non-resistant materiality produced by kamma. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā hetū sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

A non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a manifest and resistant phenomenon by way of root condition: non-manifest and non-resistant roots are a condition by way of root condition for the manifest and resistant materiality arisen from mind. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (and so on). (2)

(Anidassanaappaṭighamūlakeyeva [V 2.0558] iminā kāraṇena satta pañhā vibhajitabbā.)

(For this reason, the seven questions should be analyzed with the non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon as the basis.)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

30. Sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – rūpe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā [M 2.0478] rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sanidassanasappaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

30. A manifest and resistant phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon by way of object condition: one contemplates form as impermanent, as suffering, and as non-self; one enjoys it and delights in it; taking that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. One sees form with the divine eye. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of object condition. The manifest and resistant aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of the kinds of supernormal power, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… anidassanasappaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa[T 2.0627], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifest and resistant phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon by way of object condition: one contemplates the eye… (and so on)… the body… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles as impermanent… (and so on)… displeasure arises. One hears a sound with the divine ear-element. The sound base is a condition for ear-consciousness by way of object condition… (and so on)… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition… (and so on). The non-manifest and resistant aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of the kinds of supernormal power, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

31. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti…pe… vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ… anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena anidassanaappaṭighacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… anidassanaappaṭighā [V 2.0559] khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

31. A non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifest and non-resistant phenomenon by way of object condition: having given a gift, undertaken the moral precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews it. One reviews one's previously well-done deeds. Having emerged from jhāna… (and so on)… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting. Noble ones review the abandoned defilements, they review the suppressed defilements, they know the defilements formerly practiced… (and so on)… one contemplates the physical basis… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element… edible food… the non-manifest and non-resistant aggregates as impermanent… (and so on)… displeasure arises. With the knowledge of encompassing the minds of others, one knows the mind of one who possesses a non-manifest and non-resistant consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition by way of object condition for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition by way of object condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… (and so on). The non-manifest and non-resistant aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for the knowledge of the kinds of supernormal power, the knowledge of encompassing the minds of others, the knowledge of the recollection of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

32. Sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – rūpaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

32. A visible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. By object-dominance: having regarded a form as important, one savors and rejoices in it; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho [T 2.0628][M 2.0479] dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. By object-dominance: having regarded the eye ... body ... sounds ... smells ... tastes ... tangibles as important, one savors and rejoices in them. Regarding them as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

33. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalā vuṭṭhahitvā…pe… phalaṃ garuṃ katvā…pe… nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā… nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ… anidassanaappaṭighe khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – anidassanaappaṭighādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of dominance condition—by object-dominance and conascence-dominance. By object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken the precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, one regards that as important ... having emerged from jhāna ... having emerged from the noble path ... having emerged from fruition ... regarding the fruition as important ... regarding Nibbāna as important ... Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, for the path, and for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Having regarded the heart-base ... the female faculty ... the male faculty ... the life faculty ... the water element ... edible food ... the invisible and non-resistant aggregates as important, one savors and rejoices in them; regarding them as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. By conascence-dominance: an invisible and non-resistant dominant factor is a condition for the associated aggregates and for invisible and non-resistant mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – anidassanaappaṭighādhipati sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. By conascence-dominance: an invisible and non-resistant dominant factor is a condition for visible and resistant mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

(Anidassanaappaṭighamūlake sattapi pañhā vibhajitabbā, adhipati tividharūpasaṅgahena.)

(The seven questions rooted in the invisible and non-resistant should be analyzed, with the dominance [condition] by way of the threefold classification of matter.)

Anantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

34. Anidassanaappaṭigho [T 2.0629][V 2.0560] dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of proximity condition: preceding invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for subsequent invisible and non-resistant aggregates by way of proximity condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage ... adaptation is a condition for purification ... change-of-lineage is a condition for the path ... purification is a condition for the path ... the path is a condition for the fruit ... the fruit is a condition for the fruit ... adaptation is a condition for fruition attainment ... For one emerging from cessation, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of proximity condition. (1)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

35. Anidassanaappaṭigho [M 2.0480] dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ).

35. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of contiguity condition (this is similar to the proximity condition).

Sahajātapaccayādi

Conascence Condition, etc.

36. Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ sādhukaṃ kātabbaṃ. Aññamaññapaccaye paṭiccavāre aññamaññasadisaṃ, nissayapaccaye paṭiccavārasadisaṃ).

36. An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and resistant phenomenon by way of conascence condition. (This should be done well, similar to the section on conditionality. In the mutuality condition, it is similar to the mutuality [section] of the conditionality section; in the support condition, it is similar to the conditionality section.)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

37. Sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – vaṇṇasampadaṃ patthayamāno dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ…pe… vaṇṇasampadā saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

37. A visible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—by object decisive support and natural decisive support ... By natural decisive support: desiring perfection of form, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the Uposatha observance ... Perfection of form is a condition by way of decisive support for faith ... for wisdom, for lust ... for aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, and for fruition attainment. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa [T 2.0630] upanissayapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0561] – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – cakkhusampadaṃ patthayamāno…pe… kāyasampadaṃ… saddasampadaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbasampadaṃ patthayamāno dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ… utuṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti sīlaṃ samādiyati. Uposathakammaṃ, jhānaṃ… vipassanaṃ… maggaṃ… abhiññaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Cakkhusampadā…pe… phoṭṭhabbasampadā, utu, senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya, rāgassa…pe… patthanāya, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—by object decisive support and natural decisive support ... By natural decisive support: aspiring to perfection of the eye ... perfection of the body ... perfection of sound ... perfection of tangibles, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the Uposatha observance ... Depending on the climate ... on the lodging, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the Uposatha observance, develops jhāna ... insight ... the path ... direct knowledge ... an attainment; one kills living beings ... splits the Sangha. Perfection of the eye ... perfection of tangibles, climate, and lodging are a condition by way of decisive support for faith ... for wisdom, for lust ... for aspiration, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, and for fruition attainment. (1)

38. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ… jhānaṃ… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ [M 2.0481] jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ…pe… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhojanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Saddhā …pe… paññā, rāgo…pe… patthanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhojanaṃ saddhāya…pe… paññāya, maggassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

38. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition—by object decisive support, proximity decisive support, and natural decisive support ... By natural decisive support: depending on faith, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, performs the Uposatha observance ... develops jhāna ... an attainment; one cherishes conceit, grasps a view. Depending on virtue ... wisdom ... lust ... aspiration, bodily pleasure ... bodily pain ... food, one gives a gift ... splits the Sangha. Faith ... wisdom, lust ... aspiration, bodily pleasure ... bodily pain ... food is a condition by way of decisive support for faith ... for wisdom, for the path, and for fruition attainment. (1)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

39. Sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – rūpe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi…pe… vicikicchā…pe… uddhaccaṃ…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā [T 2.0631] rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

39. A visible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition. Object-prenascence: One contemplates form as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; one enjoys it and delights in it. Taking that as object, lust arises, wrong view … doubt … restlessness … displeasure arises. With the divine eye one sees a form. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… sadde…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena [V 2.0562] paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence and base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: One contemplates the eye … body … sounds … tangibles as impermanent … displeasure arises. With the divine ear-element one hears a sound. The sound base is a condition for ear-consciousness … the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. Base-prenascence: The eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness … the body base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ… aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence and base-prenascence. Object-prenascence: One contemplates the physical basis … the femininity faculty … the masculinity faculty … the life faculty … the water element … physical nutriment as impermanent … displeasure arises. Base-prenascence: The physical basis is a condition for the invisible and non-resistant aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (1)

40. Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

40. A visible and resistant phenomenon and an invisible and resistant phenomenon are a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence and base-prenascence. The form base and the physical basis are a condition for the invisible and non-resistant aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho [M 2.0482] ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ[T 2.0632], vatthupurejātaṃ. Cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and resistant phenomenon and an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon are a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence and base-prenascence. The eye base and the physical basis … the tangible base and the physical basis are a condition for the invisible and non-resistant aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A visible and resistant phenomenon and an invisible and resistant phenomenon are a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object-prenascence and base-prenascence. The form base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Postnascence Condition

41. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanaappaṭighassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

41. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of postnascence condition. Subsequently arisen invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for this prenascent invisible and non-resistant body by way of postnascence condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo [V 2.0563] – pacchājātā anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanasappaṭighassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of postnascence condition. Subsequently arisen invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for this prenascent visible and resistant body by way of postnascence condition. (2)

(Evaṃ satta pañhā vibhajitabbā, tividharūpasaṅgaho.) (7)

(Thus seven questions are to be analyzed. The collection of form is threefold.) (7)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

42. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu [T 2.0633] maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

42. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Preceding, preceding invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for succeeding, succeeding invisible and non-resistant aggregates by way of repetition condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage … conformity for purification … change-of-lineage for the path … purification for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

43. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – anidassanaappaṭighā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [M 2.0483] rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – anidassanaappaṭighā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

43. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascence and asynchronicity. Conascence: Invisible and non-resistant volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for the mind-originated invisible and non-resistant material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking … . Asynchronicity: Invisible and non-resistant volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for the kamma-produced invisible and non-resistant material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – anidassanaappaṭighā cetanā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – anidassanaappaṭighā cetanā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of kamma condition: conascence and asynchronicity. Conascence: Invisible and non-resistant volition is a condition for the mind-originated visible and resistant material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking … . Asynchronicity: Invisible and non-resistant volition is a condition for the kamma-produced visible and resistant material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

(Evaṃ satta pañhā sahajātā nānākkhaṇikā iminā kāraṇena vibhajitabbā, tividharūpasaṅgaho.) (7)

(Thus seven questions—conascent and asynchronous—are to be analyzed for this reason. The collection of form is threefold.) (7)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

44. Anidassanaappaṭigho [V 2.0564] dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko anidassanaappaṭigho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭigho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… khandhā vatthussa [T 2.0634] vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

44. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of result condition. A resultant invisible and non-resistant single aggregate is a condition for the three invisible and non-resistant aggregates and for consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of result condition... two aggregates... At the moment of rebirth-linking, a resultant invisible and non-resistant single aggregate is a condition for the three invisible and non-resistant aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of result condition... the aggregates are a condition for the base by way of result condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of result condition. Resultant invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for visible and resistant consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, invisible and non-resistant aggregates are a condition for visible and resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. (2)

(Evaṃ satta pañhā vitthāretabbā, pavattipaṭisandhi.) (7)

Thus, seven questions should be elaborated concerning the course of existence and rebirth-linking. (7)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

45. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 2.0484] anidassanaappaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa anidassanaappaṭighassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

45. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Invisible and non-resistant nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for invisible and non-resistant consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, invisible and non-resistant nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for invisible and non-resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. Edible food is a condition for this invisible and non-resistant body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā āhārā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā āhārā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena [V 2.0565] paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa sanidassanasappaṭighassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Invisible and non-resistant nutriments are a condition for visible and resistant consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, invisible and non-resistant nutriments are a condition for visible and resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. Edible food is a condition for this visible and resistant body by way of nutriment condition. (2)

(Evaṃ satta pañhā [T 2.0635] pavattipaṭisandhi vibhajitabbā, sattasupi kabaḷīkāro āhāro kātabbo.) (7)

Thus, seven questions concerning the course of existence and rebirth-linking should be analyzed, and in all seven, edible food should be included. (7)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

46. Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

46. An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of faculty condition: the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness... the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Invisible and non-resistant faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for invisible and non-resistant consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, invisible and non-resistant faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for invisible and non-resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. The material life faculty is a condition for invisible and non-resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā indriyā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā indriyā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for a visible and resistant phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Invisible and non-resistant faculties are a condition for visible and resistant consciousness-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, invisible and non-resistant faculties are a condition for visible and resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. The material life faculty is a condition for visible and resistant kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (2)

(Evaṃ pavattipaṭisandhi satta pañhā vibhajitabbā, rūpajīvitindriyañca ante ante.) (7)

Thus, seven questions concerning the course of existence and rebirth-linking should be analyzed, and the material life faculty should be added at the end of each. (7)

47. Anidassanasappaṭigho [T 2.0636][M 2.0485] ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ [V 2.0566] indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca kāyaviññāṇañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

47. An invisible and resistant phenomenon and an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon are a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of faculty condition. The eye faculty and eye-consciousness are a condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition... the body faculty and body-consciousness are a condition for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (1)

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna Condition, etc.

48. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – anidassanaappaṭigho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe….

48. An invisible and non-resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of jhāna condition … by way of path condition … by way of association condition. One invisible and non-resistant aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of association condition … two aggregates … at the moment of rebirth-linking ….

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

49. Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

49. An invisible and resistant phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-resistant phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascently: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness … the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ [T 2.0637] khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanaappaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascently, prenascently, postnascently. Conascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition. The physical base is a condition for aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascently: the physical base is a condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for this prenascent, non-manifesting, and non-impinging body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanaappaṭighā [M 2.0486][V 2.0567] khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanasappaṭighassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a manifesting and impinging phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: conascently, postnascently. Conascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for manifesting and impinging, mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for manifesting and impinging, kamma-produced material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Postnascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition for this prenascent, manifesting, and impinging body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

(Avasesā pañca pañhā evaṃ vitthāretabbā. Sahajātā, pacchājātā.)

(The remaining five questions should be elaborated in the same way: conascently, postnascently.)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

50. Sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – rūpe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

50. A manifesting and impinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascently: contemplating form as impermanent … grief arises; one sees form with the divine eye; the form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition. (1)

51. Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Anidassanasappaṭighā mahābhūtā anidassanasappaṭighānaṃ [T 2.0638] cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ cakkhāyatanassa…pe… rasāyatanassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Utusamuṭṭhānā mahābhūtā anidassanasappaṭighānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Asaññasattānaṃ anidassanasappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā…pe…. (1)

51. A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition. One non-manifesting and non-impinging great element is a condition for two great elements by way of presence condition. Two great elements are a condition for one great element by way of presence condition. Non-manifesting and non-impinging great elements are a condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-originated material phenomena, kamma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of presence condition. The tangible-base is a condition for the eye-base … for the taste-base by way of presence condition. External … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … one great element is a condition for two great elements by way of presence condition. Two great elements are a condition for one great element by way of presence condition. Temperature-originated great elements are a condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging derived material phenomena by way of presence condition. For non-percipient beings, one non-manifesting and non-impinging great element is a condition for two great elements by way of presence condition. Two great elements …. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a manifesting and impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition. (2)

(Paṭiccavāre nissayapaccayasadisaṃ.)

(In the section on conditionality, it is similar to the dependence condition.)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanasappaṭighā mahābhūtā anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [V 2.0568] rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (yāva asaññasattā vitthāretabbā). Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ…pe… kāyaṃ, sadde…pe… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascently, prenascently. Conascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging great elements are a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-originated material phenomena, kamma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena (to be elaborated up to non-percipient beings). Prenascently: contemplating the eye … the body, sounds … tangibles as impermanent … grief arises; the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness … the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. (3)

(Avasesā [M 2.0487] cattāro pañhā vitthāretabbā. Paṭiccavāre sahajātapaccayasadisā, ninnānākaraṇā.) (7)

(The remaining four questions should be elaborated. In the section on conditionality, they are similar to the conascence condition, without differentiation.) (7)

52. Anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa [T 2.0639] atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – anidassanaappaṭigho eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… āpodhātu anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ…pe… āpodhātu itthindriyassa…pe… kabaḷīkārāhārassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ āpodhātu anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthuṃ… itthindriyaṃ… purisindriyaṃ… jīvitindriyaṃ… āpodhātuṃ… kabaḷīkāraṃ āhāraṃ… aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, vatthu anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanaappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa anidassanaappaṭighassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo (evaṃ avasesā cha pañhā vibhajitabbā. Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyampi kātabbā). (7)

52. A non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon is a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: as conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascently: one non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregate is a condition by way of presence condition for the other three non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates and for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-produced material phenomena. Two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking… the water element is a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-produced material phenomena, kamma-produced material phenomena, and derived material phenomena… the water element is a condition by way of presence condition for the femininity faculty… and for physical nutriment. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, the water element is a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, kamma-produced material phenomena and derived material phenomena. Prenascently: the physical base… the femininity faculty… the masculinity faculty… the life faculty… the water element… physical nutriment… as impermanent… grief arises; the physical base is a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates. Postnascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates are a condition by way of presence condition for this prenascent, non-manifesting, and non-impinging body. Physical nutriment is a condition by way of presence condition for this non-manifesting and non-impinging body. The material life faculty is a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, kamma-produced material phenomena. (Thus the remaining six questions should be analyzed. Conascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty should also be applied.) (7)

53. Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo[T 2.0640]. (1)

53. A manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon are a condition by way of presence condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon. Prenascently: the form-base and the physical base are a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena [V 2.0569] paccayo – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca sanidassanasappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe… (saṃkhittaṃ, asaññasattānañca kātabbā). (1)

A non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon are a condition by way of presence condition for a manifesting and impinging phenomenon. Non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates and the great elements are a condition by way of presence condition for manifesting and impinging, mind-originated material phenomena. At the moment of rebirth-linking… (In brief; and also for non-percipient beings.) (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon are a condition by way of presence condition for a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon. (In brief.) (2)

54. Anidassanasappaṭigho [M 2.0488] ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā – anidassanaappaṭighā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… (yāva asaññasattā kātabbā). Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanañca vatthu ca…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca anidassanaappaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3) (Avasesā catasso pañhā vibhajitabbā.) (7)

54. A non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon are a condition by way of presence condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon: as conascence, prenascence. Conascently: non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates and the great elements are a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging, mind-originated material phenomena… (This should be done up to non-percipient beings.) Prenascently: the eye-base and the physical base… the tangible-base and the physical base are a condition by way of presence condition for non-manifesting and non-impinging aggregates. (3) (The remaining four questions should be analyzed.) (7)

55. Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanasappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

55. A manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon are a condition by way of presence condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon. Prenascently: the form-base and the eye-base are a condition by way of presence condition for eye-consciousness. (1)

Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho [T 2.0641] ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Manifesting and impinging, non-manifesting and impinging, and non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomena are a condition for a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon by way of presence condition: as conascence, prenascence. The form-base, the eye-base, and eye-consciousness are a condition by way of presence condition for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness. (1)

(Natthivigatapaccayaṃ anantarasadisaṃ. Avigatapaccayaṃ atthisadisaṃ.)

The absence and disappearance conditions are similar to the contiguity condition. The non-disappearance condition is similar to the presence condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Enumeration Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

56. Hetuyā [V 2.0570] satta, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekavīsa, aññamaññe cha, nissaye ekavīsa, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte cha, pacchājāte satta, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme satta, vipāke satta, āhāre satta, indriye nava, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte aṭṭha, atthiyā pañcavīsa, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate pañcavīsa.

56. By root condition, seven; by object condition, three; by predominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, one; by immediate contiguity condition, one; by conascence condition, twenty-one; by mutuality condition, six; by support condition, twenty-one; by decisive support condition, three; by prenascence condition, six; by postnascence condition, seven; by repetition condition, one; by kamma condition, seven; by result condition, seven; by nutriment condition, seven; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, seven; by path condition, seven; by association condition, one; by dissociation condition, eight; by presence condition, twenty-five; by absence condition, one; by disappearance condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, twenty-five.

Hetusabhāgaṃ

Combinations with Root

57. Hetupaccayā adhipatiyā satta, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye satta, vipāke satta, indriye satta, magge satta, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte satta, atthiyā satta, avigate satta.

57. With root condition: by predominance, seven; by conascence, seven; by mutuality, one; by support, seven; by result, seven; by faculty, seven; by path, seven; by association, one; by dissociation, seven; by presence, seven; by non-disappearance, seven.

Hetusāmaññaghaṭanā (9)

General Combinations with Root (9)

58. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-atthi-avigatanti [M 2.0489] satta. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamaññanissaya-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-sampayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vippayutta-atthi [T 2.0642] -avigatanti satta (avipākaṃ-4).

58. Root, conascence, support, presence, non-disappearance—seven. Root, conascence, mutuality, support, presence, non-disappearance—one. Root, conascence, mutuality, support, association, presence, non-disappearance—one. Root, conascence, support, dissociation, presence, non-disappearance—seven (without result—four).

Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipāka-atthi-avigatanti satta. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissayavipāka-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-vipāka-sampayutta-atthiavigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti satta. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ (savipākaṃ-5).

Root, conascence, support, result, presence, non-disappearance—seven. Root, conascence, mutuality, support, result, presence, non-disappearance—one. Root, conascence, mutuality, support, result, association, presence, non-disappearance—one. Root, conascence, support, result, dissociation, presence, non-disappearance—seven. Root, conascence, mutuality, support, result, dissociation, presence, non-disappearance—one (with result—5).

(Evaṃ sabbo gaṇanavāro gaṇetabbo.)

(Thus the entire enumeration section should be calculated.)

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order.

2. Paccanīyuddhāro

2. Exposition of the Negative.

59. Sanidassanasappaṭigho [V 2.0571] dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

59. A visible and impingent phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-impingent phenomenon by object condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An invisible and impingent phenomenon is a condition for another invisible and impingent phenomenon by co-nascence condition. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An invisible and impingent phenomenon is a condition for a visible and impingent phenomenon by co-nascence condition. (2)

Anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An invisible and impingent phenomenon is a condition for an invisible and non-impingent phenomenon by object condition… by co-nascence condition… by decisive support condition… by pre-nascence condition. (3)

61. Sanidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa purejātaṃ. (1)

Anidassanasappaṭigho ca anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)
