2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

Simple Enumeration

63. Nahetuyā [M 2.0492] pañcavīsa, naārammaṇe dvāvīsa, naadhipatiyā pañcavīsa, naanantare pañcavīsa, nasamanantare pañcavīsa, nasahajāte dvādasa, naaññamaññe catuvīsa, nanissaye nava, naupanissaye pañcavīsa, napurejāte bāvīsa, napacchājāte pañcavīsa, naāsevane pañcavīsa, nakamme pañcavīsa, navipāke catuvīsa, naāhāre pañcavīsa, naindriye tevīsa, najhāne pañcavīsa, namagge pañcavīsa, nasampayutte catuvīsa, navippayutte bāvīsa, noatthiyā [T 2.0646] nava, nonatthiyā pañcavīsa, novigate pañcavīsa, noavigate nava.

63. Not by root condition, twenty-five; not by object condition, twenty-two; not by dominance condition, twenty-five; not by contiguity condition, twenty-five; not by immediate contiguity condition, twenty-five; not by co-nascence condition, twelve; not by mutuality condition, twenty-four; not by dependence condition, nine; not by decisive support condition, twenty-five; not by pre-nascence condition, twenty-two; not by post-nascence condition, twenty-five; not by repetition condition, twenty-five; not by kamma condition, twenty-five; not by result condition, twenty-four; not by nutriment condition, twenty-five; not by faculty condition, twenty-three; not by jhāna condition, twenty-five; not by path condition, twenty-five; not by association condition, twenty-four; not by dissociation condition, twenty-two; not by presence condition, nine; not by absence condition, twenty-five; not by disappearance condition, twenty-five; not by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Not-Root Dyad

Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇe bāvīsa (paṭhamagamanasadisaṃ), noavigate nava.

Not by root condition and not by object condition, twenty-two (similar to the first section); not by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Nahetutikaṃ

The Not-Root Triad

Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatiyā bāvīsa, naanantare bāvīsa, nasamanantare bāvīsa, nasahajāte nava, naaññamaññe bāvīsa, nanissaye nava, naupanissaye ekavīsa, napurejāte bāvīsa, napacchājāte bāvīsa…pe… nasampayutte bāvīsa, navippayutte bāvīsa[V 2.0575], noatthiyā nava, nonatthiyā bāvīsa, novigate bāvīsa, noavigate nava (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

Not by root condition, not by object condition, and not by dominance condition, twenty-two; not by contiguity condition, twenty-two; not by immediate contiguity condition, twenty-two; not by co-nascence condition, nine; not by mutuality condition, twenty-two; not by dependence condition, nine; not by decisive support condition, twenty-one; not by pre-nascence condition, twenty-two; not by post-nascence condition, twenty-two …pe… not by association condition, twenty-two; not by dissociation condition, twenty-two; not by presence condition, nine; not by absence condition, twenty-two; not by disappearance condition, twenty-two; not by non-disappearance condition, nine. (This is how it should be calculated.)

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative ends.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Conditional-Positive-Negative

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

64. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe satta, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte satta…pe… nasampayutte satta, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta.

64. By root condition: not by object condition, seven; not by dominance condition, seven; not by contiguity condition, seven; not by immediate contiguity condition, seven; not by mutuality condition, seven; not by decisive support condition, seven; not by pre-nascence condition, seven; not by post-nascence condition, seven …pe… not by association condition, seven; not by dissociation condition, one; not by absence condition, seven; not by disappearance condition, seven.

Hetusāmaññaghaṭanā

Combination with General Root Conditions

65. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-atthi-avigatanti [M 2.0493] naārammaṇe satta…pe… naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe satta (idhāpi saṃkhittaṃ), nasampayutte satta, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta.

65. Root, co-nascence, dependence, presence, and non-disappearance conditions are related thus: not by object condition, seven …pe… not by contiguity condition, seven; not by immediate contiguity condition, seven; not by mutuality condition, seven (here too it is abbreviated); not by association condition, seven; not by dissociation condition, one; not by absence condition, seven; not by disappearance condition, seven.

Hetu [T 2.0647] -sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-atthi-avigatanti naārammaṇe ekaṃ (sabbattha ekaṃ), novigate ekaṃ (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

Root, co-nascence, mutuality, dependence, presence, and non-disappearance conditions are related thus: not by object condition, one (one in all cases); … not by disappearance condition, one. (This is how it should be calculated.)

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Positive-Negative ends.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Conditional-Negative-Positive

Nahetudukaṃ

The Not-Root Dyad

66. Nahetupaccayā [V 2.0576] ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekavīsa, aññamaññe cha, nissaye ekavīsa, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte cha, pacchājāte satta, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme satta, vipāke satta, āhāre satta, indriye nava, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte aṭṭha, atthiyā pañcavīsa, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate pañcavīsa (evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ).

66. Not by root condition: by object condition, three; by dominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, one; by immediate contiguity condition, one; by co-nascence condition, twenty-one; by mutuality condition, six; by dependence condition, twenty-one; by decisive support condition, three; by pre-nascence condition, six; by post-nascence condition, seven; by repetition condition, one; by kamma condition, seven; by result condition, seven; by nutriment condition, seven; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, seven; by path condition, seven; by association condition, one; by dissociation condition, eight; by presence condition, twenty-five; by absence condition, one; by disappearance condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, twenty-five. (This is how it should be calculated.)

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Positive ends.

Pañhāvāro niṭṭhito.

The Question Section is concluded.

Sanidassanasappaṭighattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Triad on the Visible and Resistant is concluded.

Dhammānulome tikapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Paṭṭhāna of Triads in the Positive Enumeration is concluded.

Dutiyo bhāgo niṭṭhito.

The second part is concluded.
